thesis.insider_ownership: Founder Gábor Bojár served as Chairman of the Board through 2021 and remains a major shareholder (~15.85% per main shareholders on file) ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/G%C3%A1bor_Boj%C3%A1r))

thesis.business_description: MLP SE is a financial services provider operating through brands such as Deutschland.Immobilien, DOMCURA, FERI, MLP, RVM, and TPC, offering independent advice and brokerage in insurance (pension, health, property), wealth management, financing, real estate, and banking to private, corporate, and institutional clients in Germany.
thesis.competitive_position: Strong: Largest network for academics/professionals (2,110 advisors, 590k family clients); top-rated advisor tools (SWI Institut); comprehensive holistic advisory model with bank integration; record AUM €63.1B, insurance premiums €751M; resilient diversified model.
thesis.main_shareholders: Lautenschläger family (27.56%), HanseMerkur Krankenversicherung AG (10.03%), Barmenia Versicherungen a.G./Gothaer Versicherungsbank VVaG (9.39%), free float (46.84%).
thesis.red_flags: Immobilien segment EBIT loss -€11.7M (under restructuring); managed risks (credit €429M exposure, market/interest rate €11.5M); no existential threats or major lawsuits identified.
thesis.insider_ownership: Lautenschläger family holds approximately 27.51% of shares via a voting trust/pooling agreement (Dr. h.c. Manfred Lautenschläger 2.09%, Angelika Lautenschläger Beteiligungs Verwaltungs GmbH 20.85%, Manfred Lautenschläger Stiftung GmbH 4.57%); sons Maximilian and Matthias Lautenschläger sit on the Supervisory Board, consistent with main shareholders on file ([MLP Aktionärsstruktur](https://mlp-se.de/investoren/mlp-aktie/aktionaersstruktur/))

thesis.business_description: Vente-Unique.com SA is a French pure-play online retailer selling furniture, decorative items and home equipment (sofas, bedroom/dining/office furniture, garden and DIY products) directly to consumers with no physical stores or intermediaries.
thesis.competitive_position: The company describes itself as the European No. 1 online seller of furniture and decoration items, operating across France, Spain, Germany, Belgium, Switzerland, Austria, Italy, Portugal, Luxembourg and the Netherlands. It is a subsidiary of the CAFOM SA retail group, which gives it group-level scale and sourcing support.
thesis.main_shareholders: Centrale d'Achat Française pour l'Outre-Mer (CAFOM SA) is the controlling parent shareholder (largest single holder, 6,157,593 shares); an employee share scheme (ESOP) holds 11.2%; general public holds 21.6% ([MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/VENTE-UNIQUE-COM-42547900/company-shareholders/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders reported at approximately 0.5% separate from parent CAFOM's controlling stake ([SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fr/retail/epa-alvu/vente-uniquecom-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

The Automation Components Business operates factories in Italy, Lithuania, Malta and China, producing sensors, monitoring relays, timers, energy management systems, solid-state-relays, electronic motor controllers, safety devices and fieldbus systems. Under the umbrella of a publicly quoted holding compa
thesis.competitive_position: Positioned as a niche player in electronic control components with global presence (23 sales companies, 60 distributors, R&D centers in EMEA and Asia-Pacific), emphasis on R&D for differentiated products targeting growing industries, strong gross margins (55%), no single customer >10% revenue, long-term customer relationships, and consistent innovation (new products like DCT1 DC sensors, PD30 IO-L
thesis.main_shareholders: Valeria Gavazzi (indirectly via Barguzin Participation SA): 73.85%; Uberta Gavazzi Estate: 4.95% (as of March 31, 2024)
thesis.red_flags: None material: no pending litigation with financial impact, no customer/supplier concentration (>10% revenue), sound governance (Compliance Committee established, whistleblower system), low insider ownership but high family control (79% voting rights); minor tax loss carry-forwards not fully capital
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 44.6% of shares per one methodology (Valeria Gavazzi ~41% directly, board member Stefano Trovati ~3.3%); note main shareholders on file show Valeria Gavazzi at 73.85% via Barguzin Participation SA (indirect/voting-rights measure) ([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/carlo-gavazzi-holding-ag-vtx-083123089.html))

thesis.business_description: Dr. Martens plc is an iconic British footwear brand that designs, manufactures, and sells boots, shoes, sandals, and accessories through direct-to-consumer and wholesale channels in over 60 countries.
thesis.insider_ownership: Insiders hold approximately 1.0-2.0% of shares (Individual Insiders ~1.01%, Employee Share Scheme ~0.21%); majority owner is PE firm Permira (38.2%) ([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/one-dr-martens-insider-raised-083836389.html))

thesis.business_description: CENIT AG is an internationally leading IT company specializing in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Enterprise Information Management (EIM), and Application Management Services. It supports manufacturing and other industries with digital transformation through consulting, software implementation from partners like Dassault Systèmes, SAP, and IBM, and proprietary solutions. The company serves over 6,000 clients globally, focusing on sustainable digitalization in sectors like automotive, aerospa
thesis.competitive_position: CENIT holds a strong position as a leading integrator and Platinum Partner for Dassault Systèmes and SAP PLM platforms, with competitive advantages including proprietary software (cenitCONNECT, FASTSUITE), high recurring revenue (67%), active M&A strategy for expansion, and a 'one-stop shop' model for end-to-end digital processes in stable manufacturing sectors.
thesis.main_shareholders: PRIMEPULSE SE (~25%), Baden-Württembergische Versorgungsanstalt (5.61%), Universal-Investment (3.04%), Mainfirst SICAV (2.98%); free float ~63%; insider (Mgmt+Supervisory Board) 0.72%.
thesis.red_flags: EBIT miss in 2024 due to acquisition costs and market challenges; Q1 2025 restructuring (€3.8M costs); dependency on key partners (mitigated by own software); no litigation, governance issues, or regulatory concerns reported; clean audits.
thesis.insider_ownership: PRIMEPULSE SE, whose Chair Regina Weinmann also serves as Deputy Chair of CENIT's Supervisory Board, holds approximately 28.07% of shares (up from 25.01% in 2021) ([automationspraxis.industrie.de](https://automationspraxis.industrie.de/news/primepulse-neuer-ankerinvestor-bei-cenit/))

thesis.business_description: Tokmanni Group Oyj is Finland's largest discount retail chain by net sales, selling a broad assortment of everyday goods (home products, cleaning supplies, food, clothing, beauty, tools, garden and seasonal items) through roughly 200 stores and an online store.
thesis.competitive_position: Tokmanni is the market-leading discount retailer in Finland, competing on low prices, a very wide assortment, and scale-driven direct sourcing; a meaningful share of sales comes from private-label and exclusive brands, supporting margin control ([Tokmanni company overview](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokmanni)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Takoa Invest Oy (19%, largest single shareholder), Keskinäinen Työeläkevakuutusyhtiö Varma (4.175%), Keskinäinen Eläkevakuutusyhtiö Ilmarinen (2.592%), Keskinäinen Eläkevakuutusyhtiö Elo (1.789%) ([Tokmanni largest shareholders](https://ir.tokmanni.fi/en/investors/share-and-shareholders/largest-shareholders))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: The SIMONA Group develops, manufactures and markets a range of semi-finished thermoplastics, pipes and fittings as well as profiles. Materials include PE, PP, PVC, PVDF and others. Key markets: industry (chemicals, semiconductors), infrastructure (piping, cable protection), building (PVC foam sheets), mobility, aquaculture. Production sites worldwide.
thesis.competitive_position: Leading global producer of thermoplastic semi-finished products, pipes & fittings. High customer satisfaction (89.4%), innovation leader (Top 100 Innovator, unique certifications like DIBT for PP-DWU). Global production footprint, strategic acquisitions strengthening aquaculture/infrastructure. Goal: best customer centricity in sector.
thesis.main_shareholders: Dr. Wolfgang und Anita Bürkle Stiftung (31.19%), Kreissparkasse Biberach (15.04%), Dirk Möller (11.64%), Rossmann Beteiligungs GmbH (11.42%), Regine Tegtmeyer (11.25%), SIMONA Vermögensverwaltungsgesellschaft der Belegschaft mbH (10.00%), free float (remainder). Bürkle Stiftung, Möller, Tegtmeyer fo
thesis.red_flags: Declining revenue (2024: €581M -3.1%, 2023: €600M -15.7%), order backlog drop, deteriorating risk situation (macro, geopolitical, procurement volatility €10-20M impact, cyber risks). Pension provisions increased (€80.6M). No existential threats; outlook modest growth.
thesis.insider_ownership: Executive Board (Vorstand) member Dirk Möller personally holds approximately 11.64% of shares; Bürkle-Stiftung (foundation) holds ~31.27%, consistent with main shareholders on file ([SIMONA Vorstand und Aufsichtsrat](https://www.simona.de/de/unternehmen/investor-relations/fakten-zu-simona/vorstand-und-aufsichtsrat/))

thesis.business_description: Braime Group PLC (formerly T.F. & J.H. Braime (Holdings) PLC) is a UK engineering group headquartered in Leeds, manufacturing metal presswork (via Braime Pressings) for automotive/industrial customers and bulk-material-handling components — elevator buckets, conveyor chain, level/hazard monitors and electronic sensors (via its 4B and Electronics divisions) — for agricultural and industrial customers worldwide.
thesis.competitive_position: Braime operates in a specialized niche (bulk material handling components, e.g. elevator buckets and monitoring systems) with international distribution across the UK, Europe, Middle East, US, Africa, Australia and Asia; it is a small, family-influenced AIM-listed company rather than a scale leader ([Braime Group investor information](https://braimegroup.com/investor-information)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Hargreaves Lansdown Asset Management Ltd. (24.6% - nominee/platform holding), Canaccord Genuity Wealth (International) Ltd. (14.7% - nominee/platform holding), Oliver Nicholas Braime (9.96%), Alan Braime (2.44%), Carl Braime (2.44%) ([Braime Group shareholders page](https://braimegroup.com/shareholders))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 24% of the company; the Braime family holds board seats (Nicholas, Carl and Alan Braime among the executive directors) with direct named holdings for several family members in the mid-single digits to ~10% each ([SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/capital-goods/aim-bmt/braime-group-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Savencia SA produces dairy products including cheese, butters, creams for retail and catering, and dairy ingredients for food, nutrition, and healthcare industries. Formerly Bongrain SA, renamed in 2015. Pioneer in cheese specialties with strong brands worldwide, focused on innovation, sustainability, and positive food.
thesis.competitive_position: Pioneer of cheese specialties; builds strong brands worldwide; 13th largest dairy group, 5th largest cheese group; present in 120+ countries; focuses on innovation and local adaptation. Savencia Annual Report 2024
thesis.main_shareholders: Savencia Holding SCA (majority shareholder)
thesis.red_flags: Declining sales (-2.6%), COP (-9%), net income (-30%); rising net debt (+20%); increased other operating costs (€48.5M); vulnerability to milk prices and FX (South America, USD). No major governance issues noted.
thesis.insider_ownership: Bongrain family holding company Soparind holds approximately 66.6% of share capital and over 82% of voting rights, consistent with main shareholders on file (Savencia Holding SCA) ([PESTEL Analysis](https://pestel-analysis.com/blogs/owners/savencia-fromagedairy))

thesis.business_description: Tarczyński S.A. is a Polish producer of processed meat products (kabanos, premium sausages, frankfurters, cold cuts) and, more recently, plant-based alternatives under its 'Vege Story' line, headquartered in Trzebnica, Poland.
thesis.competitive_position: Market leader in the pre-packed kabanos/premium meat-snack category in Poland, with a reported market share of over 70% in that niche ([Bebop Value](https://bebopvalue.substack.com/p/tarczynski-sa-tarwa)). The company has been expanding internationally, with roughly 30% of 1H24 revenue coming from abroad, mainly Germany, the UK, Ireland and Sweden.
thesis.main_shareholders: EJT Investment S.à r.l. (38.3%), EJT Spółka z o.o. (27.3%), PTE Allianz Polska SA (14.4%), Nationale-Nederlanden PTE (8.81%), Elżbieta Tarczyńska (4.7%), Jacek Tarczyński (4.7%) ([Bankier.pl akcjonariat](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/TARCZYNSKI/akcjonariat))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders (Tarczyński family members, ex-EJT vehicles) reported at ~9.4% of shares directly, with the EJT entities (65.6% combined) understood to be founder/family-linked holding vehicles ([Bankier.pl akcjonariat](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/TARCZYNSKI/akcjonariat))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources reviewed; company has been the subject of positive growth-strategy coverage rather than governance or litigation concerns.

thesis.business_description: Maschinenfabrik Berthold Hermle AG manufactures premium 5-axis CNC milling machines, machining centers, and complete automation solutions. With over 30,000 machines installed worldwide and 1,600 employees, it serves high-tech sectors including aerospace, medical technology, electronics, and automotive suppliers from its bases in Germany. The company emphasizes precision, vertical integration, and digitalization through its GEN2 platform and automation components.
thesis.competitive_position: One of the world's leading manufacturers of high-quality 5-axis milling machines, setting benchmarks in precision and quality. Competitive advantages include high vertical integration, modular product lines (Performance/High Performance), full-range automation (>25 years experience), and a diversified customer base with 63% export ratio. Outperformed industry average order decline in 2024 (-7.8% v
thesis.main_shareholders: Not publicly disclosed in official reports; likely family-influenced (Hermle family members in management/Supervisory Board). Share capital consists of 4 million ordinary shares and 1 million non-voting preference shares (ISIN DE0006052830 for MBH3).
thesis.red_flags: No major red flags: no litigation, regulatory issues, or governance scandals reported. Standard risks include economic cycles, supply chain disruptions, competition from low-cost imitators, cyber threats (mitigated), and skilled labor shortages. Minor deviations from German Corporate Governance Code

thesis.business_description: Piscines Desjoyaux SA designs, manufactures and markets private residential swimming pools (kits and equipped luxury pools), pool equipment, and related garden/leisure products (paving stones, shelters, heat pumps, spas, saunas, water treatment), headquartered in La Fouillouse, France.
thesis.competitive_position: Net sales are concentrated in France (58.8%) with Europe representing 32.6% and other markets 8.6%; the company is a long-established (founded 1966) specialist pool manufacturer, though small in scale with roughly $114M trailing revenue and 288 employees.
thesis.main_shareholders: Desjoyaux Finance SAS (66.1%, the Desjoyaux family holding company), Jean-Louis Desjoyaux (~5% additional/direct, per some sources up to 66.10% combined with Finance SAS), Catherine Jandros (4.90%), Lazard Frères Gestion SAS (4.90%) ([TradingSat actionnariat](https://www.tradingsat.com/piscines-desjoyaux-FR0000061608/actionnariat.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Desjoyaux family control via Desjoyaux Finance SAS (66.1%) plus direct family holdings; overall private-company/insider ownership category totals about 66-76% depending on classification ([TradingSat actionnariat](https://www.tradingsat.com/piscines-desjoyaux-FR0000061608/actionnariat.html))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Texaf S.A. is a Belgian holding company listed on Euronext Brussels, unique as the only listed firm with all its activities concentrated in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). It focuses on real estate (high-end rentals in Kinshasa with 100% occupancy), quarrying (leading gravel producer Carrigrès), and digital sector (Silikin Village co-working hub and data center). The group aims to contribute to Congo's development through formal economy operations, good governance, local partnerships, an
thesis.competitive_position: Market leader in Kinshasa's premium real estate (100% occupancy, diverse international tenants), #1 gravel supplier (Carrigrès with 600kT capacity), largest digital hub in Central Africa (Silikin Village supporting 285+ startups). Unique position as sole Euronext-listed pure DRC play enables long-term local expertise and growth capture.[Texaf Profile](https://www.texaf.be/en/about-us/profile-and-s

thesis.red_flags: Ongoing land spoliation/squatting disputes (legal victories but slow enforcement, high costs); elevated DRC risks (governance deficits, power outages, no FX hedging, geopolitical tensions); judgmental asset valuations (properties, quarry deposit). No major governance/litigation/regulatory issues; mi
thesis.insider_ownership: Chairman Philippe Croonenberghs and family control the company via Société Financière Africaine (62.88%, main shareholder on file); the Croonenberghs family also holds board/operational roles (e.g. Gerald and William Croonenberghs) ([Texaf Board of Directors](https://www.texaf.be/en/about-us/board-of-directors))

thesis.business_description: BasicNet S.p.A. is the parent company of a group that operates a networked business model in the design, marketing, and distribution of sportswear, footwear, and accessories through owned brands like Kappa, Robe di Kappa, K-Way, Superga, Briko, Jesus Jeans, Sabelt, and Sebago. It manages the global supply chain via a network of licensees, providing IT platforms, coordination, and strategic services, earning commissions on added value while licensees handle local distribution and logistics. Produ
thesis.competitive_position: Strong global leadership via iconic heritage brands and innovative 'network' model enabling agile expansion without heavy capex. Licensee partnerships cover key markets; proprietary IT platform optimizes supply chain. Retail via plug@sell® stores. Collaborations with Warner Bros, Heinz enhance visibility. Lean structure supports scalability.
thesis.main_shareholders: Marco Boglione (38% share capital, 50% voting rights via multi-vote shares), Francesco Boglione (6.9%), treasury shares (13%), Helikon Investments Ltd. (11.7%). Family-controlled.
thesis.red_flags: Slight net debt increase to €142M (2024); parent net profit drop to €8M (post-2023 impairment reversal). Ongoing tax disputes (favorable rulings appealed). Recent partial sale of K-Way stake to Permira (retained 60%). Geopolitical/currency risks, licensee dependency, brand erosion potential. No form
thesis.insider_ownership: Boglione family (Chairman Marco Boglione, with Alessandro and Lorenzo Boglione as Managing Directors on the board) holds approximately 44.9% combined (Marco Boglione 38% + Francesco Boglione 6.9%), consistent with main shareholders on file ([BasicNet Azionisti Rilevanti](http://www.basicnet.com/contenuti/gruppo/azionistirilevanti.asp))

thesis.business_description: Nabaltec AG produces specialty mineral products based on aluminum hydroxide and aluminum oxide, sold as flame-retardant fillers for plastics/cables and as technical ceramics materials, headquartered in Schwandorf, Germany.
thesis.competitive_position: The company operates two segments — Functional Fillers (72% of FY25 revenue, its largest and most profitable division) and Specialty Oxides — serving industrial customers in plastics, coatings, cables, electronics and refractory/technical ceramics applications; Q1 2026 revenue was €53.2 million, down 2.7% y/y, with EBIT margin pressured by higher gas costs and softer volumes.
thesis.main_shareholders: CEO Johannes Heckmann (28%), Gerhard Witzany (27%), Allianz Asset Management GmbH (3.3%) ([SimplyWall.st / Yahoo Finance ownership](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/55-ownership-nabaltec-ag-etr-065154862.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 55% of the company, led by CEO Johannes Heckmann (28%) and Gerhard Witzany (27%) ([Yahoo Finance ownership summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/55-ownership-nabaltec-ag-etr-065154862.html))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed; Q1 2026 results showed margin pressure from higher energy (gas) costs and softer volumes, though full-year guidance was maintained.

thesis.business_description: Groupe SFPI SA designs, manufactures and distributes equipment for the construction and manufacturing industries, headquartered in Paris, through two segments: Construction (joinery, shutters, locks, access-security and alarm systems) and Manufacturing (heat exchangers, sterilizers, air-conditioning units, pneumatic transport and dust-extraction systems).
thesis.competitive_position: France accounts for about 70.2% of net sales, with the group positioned as a diversified supplier of building-access and security equipment plus industrial process equipment, giving it exposure to both construction and manufacturing end markets rather than a single-product moat ([Groupe SFPI investor relations](https://www.sfpi-group.com/global/en/investor-relations)).
thesis.main_shareholders: ARC Management SAS (55.70%), free float (22.43%), Crédit Mutuel Equity SCR (10.53%), Henri Morel (4.85%), BNP Paribas Développement SA (4.21%), Autocontrôle (2.28%) ([TradingSat actionnariat](https://www.tradingsat.com/groupe-sfpi-FR0004155000/actionnariat.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Henri Morel holds approximately 4.85% directly; ARC Management SAS, the majority holding vehicle at 55.70%, is understood to be management/founder-linked, though the specific individual ownership within ARC Management was not confirmed in sources reviewed ([TradingSat actionnariat](https://www.tradingsat.com/groupe-sfpi-FR0004155000/actionnariat.html))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Emak S.p.A. is an Italian group headquartered in Bagnolo in Piano that develops, manufactures and markets outdoor power equipment (chainsaws, brush cutters, lawnmowers under Oleo-Mac, Efco, Bertolini, Nibbi brands), pumps and water-jetting equipment (Comet, Lavor, Valley), and related components and accessories (Tecomec) for gardening, agriculture, forestry, cleaning and industrial applications.
thesis.competitive_position: Emak operates across three segments (Outdoor Power Equipment, Pumps and Water Jetting, Components and Accessories) with a multi-brand portfolio and international presence across Europe and the Americas, giving it diversified end-market exposure versus single-category competitors ([Emak Group overview](https://www.emakgroup.com/emak-group/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Yama S.p.A. is the controlling shareholder with 68.9% of share capital; as of December 31, 2025, it is the only shareholder holding a stake above the 5% disclosure threshold ([Emak 2025 Annual Report](https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-03/20260330_180510.pdf))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Laurent-Perrier S.A. is a French Champagne house headquartered in Tours-sur-Marne, producing and marketing high-end champagne under the Laurent-Perrier, Salon, Delamotte and Champagne de Castellane brands, exporting to over 120 countries.
thesis.competitive_position: Laurent-Perrier is one of the few family-controlled, pure-play champagne houses still listed on the stock market, focused exclusively on the high-end segment, with relationships with over 1,200 grape growers; FY2024-25 operating profit was €74.4 million, down from a record prior year but still reflecting a high operating margin.
thesis.main_shareholders: The Nonancourt Family Trust holds approximately 65.2% of share capital (roughly 78.5% of voting rights under French double-voting-rights rules); institutions hold 19.9%, general public 13.3%, employee share scheme 0.685% ([MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/LAURENT-PERRIER-5092/company-shareholders/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Family-controlled via the Nonancourt Family Trust at ~65.2% of capital / ~78.5% of voting rights; co-CEOs Alexandra Pereyre de Nonancourt and Stéphanie Meneux de Nonancourt are family members ([MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/LAURENT-PERRIER-5092/company-shareholders/))
thesis.red_flags: Note: press coverage in 2026 discussed the possibility of the Nonancourt family taking Laurent-Perrier private, which could affect minority shareholders' liquidity ([Wine-Searcher](https://www.wine-searcher.com/m/2026/05/laurent-perrier-flirts-with-going-private)).

thesis.business_description: Ifirma SA (formerly Power Media S.A.) is a Polish provider of online accounting and business-management software, offering both a full-service online accounting office with dedicated accountants and a self-service bookkeeping platform, headquartered in Wrocław.
thesis.competitive_position: Ifirma serves SMEs, freelancers and sole proprietors (including programmers, e-commerce sellers, healthcare and legal professionals) with an integrated suite covering invoicing, tax settlements (PIT/CIT/VAT), ZUS declarations, and an e-commerce integrator connecting to marketplaces and couriers — a niche SaaS/fintech positioning in the Polish micro-business accounting market ([ad-hoc-news coverage](https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/ueberblick/ifirma-s-a-niche-polish-saas-play-that-global-tech-investors-overlook/68614798)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Wojciech Narczyński (26.8%, 1,717,500 shares), Marta Przewłocka (13.6%, 870,398 shares), Seven Canyons Advisors, LLC (6.81%, 436,079 shares), Agnieszka Kozłowska (6.42%, 411,000 shares) ([Bankier.pl akcjonariat](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/IFIRMA/akcjonariat))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 46.9% of the company in aggregate ([SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/software/wse-ifi/ifirma-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Generic Sweden AB (publ) is a Stockholm-based wireless-communication and messaging technology company operating two divisions: Consultancy (engineering/product-development services for defense, civil security, energy, telecom, transport and medtech clients) and Telecom (operator of its own critical-communication network offering Minicall and Messit messaging products, and CPaaS digital-communication services). Note: despite the name, it is not a generic pharmaceutical company.
thesis.competitive_position: Generic Sweden is a small-cap niche player (market cap ~$50.9M, ~$18.7M trailing revenue) combining engineering consultancy with a legacy critical-communications telecom network, giving it a defense/security-sector customer niche distinct from mainstream telecom operators.
thesis.main_shareholders: Martin Gren (24.5%, 3,010,000 shares), Hans Krantz (13.3%, 1,631,555 shares), John Löfström (7.29%, 895,510 shares), JCE Asset Management AB (6.71%), Avanza Fonder AB (4.79%) ([MarketScreener / SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/software/sto-geni/generic-sweden-shares/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 48.6% of the company in aggregate, led by Martin Gren (24.5%) and Hans Krantz (13.3%) ([SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/software/sto-geni/generic-sweden-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Surteco Group SE develops, manufactures and sells paper- and plastic-based surface materials (decorative foils, edge bandings, technical profiles) for the furniture, flooring and wood-based materials industries, headquartered in Buttenwiesen, Germany.
thesis.competitive_position: Surteco operates globally (Europe, Americas, Australia, Asia) across Paper and Plastics segments serving furniture, kitchen, sanitary and wood-board manufacturers, giving it a diversified customer base within a specialized surface-materials niche ([Surteco company overview](https://ir.surteco.com/websites/surteco/English/0/home.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Pkg Schürfeld GmbH is the largest shareholder with approximately 24% of shares outstanding; private companies collectively hold about 36% of the company ([Finance Yahoo ownership summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/surteco-group-se-etr-sur-134554022.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 22% of the company ([Finance Yahoo ownership summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/surteco-group-se-etr-sur-134554022.html))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: ProCook Group plc is the UK's leading direct-to-consumer specialist kitchenware brand, designing, developing, and retailing high-quality cookware, kitchenware, and tableware through its website www.procook.co.uk and over 60 own-brand stores across the UK. It employs a direct-sourced, own-brand model that delivers significant value for money with outstanding multi-channel service. The company started as a family business selling cookware sets by direct mail and has grown into a multi-channel spec
thesis.competitive_position: Market leader in UK direct-to-consumer kitchenware with strong moats including direct-sourced own-brand model enabling 65%+ gross margins, 135k+ 5-star Trustpilot reviews, B Corp certification, rapid store expansion (target 100 stores), and product innovation; outperformed market by 7% in FY25 with ambitions for £100m revenue and 10% margins.
thesis.main_shareholders: O'Neill family concert party (Michael O'Neill 33%, Daniel O'Neill ~16%, Sarah O'Neill 14%, family settlement ~6%; total ~69%); Fackelmann GmbH + Co. KG (~11% as of 2023)
thesis.red_flags: High insider ownership (~69% by O'Neill family concert party) may limit liquidity and external influence; seasonal H1 losses; past covenant waivers and going concern uncertainties (FY23); low board diversity (recently all-male); no recent dividends; dependency on UK consumer spending and freight/FX
thesis.insider_ownership: O'Neill family concert party holds approximately 70.46% of issued share capital, with Deputy Chair Daniel O'Neill personally holding approximately 35.65% ([TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/procooks-deputy-chair-transfers-1-5m-shares-with-no-change-to-35-65-stake))

thesis.business_description: AB Žemaitijos pienas is a Lithuanian dairy producer (founded 1924, headquartered in Telšiai) that manufactures and distributes milk, yogurt, kefir and cheese, including its flagship DŽIUGAS hard cheese which holds EU Protected Geographical Indication status.
thesis.competitive_position: Žemaitijos pienas is the second-largest dairy products company in Lithuania, with exports to the EU, Baltic states, CIS countries and the US; it also holds an 87.82% stake in fellow dairy producer Šilutės Rambynas, giving it additional scale in the Lithuanian dairy sector. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C5%BDemaitijos_pienas)
thesis.main_shareholders: The company is widely held (2,847 shareholders as of a 2020 count) and holds 0.53% of its own shares in treasury; specific controlling shareholder percentages beyond treasury holdings were not found in sources reviewed. Not disclosed in public filings reviewed beyond treasury-share data. [Company Annual Report 2024](https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/ab152cb04aba67427ec6264693b2b6d32)
thesis.insider_ownership: Specific management/board insider ownership percentage was not found in public sources reviewed. Not disclosed in public filings reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: DATRON AG is a German high-tech manufacturer headquartered in Mühltal-Traisa near Darmstadt, developing, producing and selling high-speed CNC milling machines (40,000-60,000 rpm), dental milling machines, high-performance dosing/dispensing machines, milling tools, and related software and after-sales services.
thesis.competitive_position: DATRON is a specialist niche player in high-speed CNC milling for future-oriented materials (aluminum, composites), employing about 235 people with a worldwide distribution network in over 20 countries; nearly 25% of employees work in R&D, supporting rapid adaptation to new materials and market trends ([Edison Group research](https://www.edisongroup.com/research/a-strong-niche-player/19667/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Specific named major shareholders were not confirmed in sources reviewed; approximately 3,942,209 shares are in free float (Streubesitz) per exchange data ([finanzen.net Datron](https://www.finanzen.net/nachricht/aktien/fuehrungskraft-erwirbt-mehr-datron-anteile-15934187))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Einhell Germany AG is a German manufacturer and distributor of power tools and garden/leisure equipment, headquartered in Bavaria (founded 1964), with a strategic focus on its Power X-Change cordless battery platform (one battery fitting over 350 tools), operating through Tools and Garden & Leisure segments across 51 subsidiaries worldwide.
thesis.competitive_position: The Power X-Change battery platform now represents 53% of group revenue, a key differentiator versus competitors' fragmented battery ecosystems; group sales reached €1,157.7 million in 2025 (8% FX-adjusted growth, 11.4% CAGR since 2019) with EBT of €107.9 million (~9% margin), and 2026 guidance targets €1,200 million in sales ([Einhell 2025 financial report](https://www.einhell.com/fileadmin/com/investor-relations/reports/business-reports/en/einhell-business-report-2025-en.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: The Thannhuber family (descendants of founder Josef Thannhuber) has historically held approximately 86-90% of ordinary shares, with the remainder in free float; specific current percentage was not independently reconfirmed in sources reviewed beyond this historical (2018) figure ([German Wikipedia / company history](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Einhell_Germany))
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder family (Thannhuber) control historically around 86-90% of ordinary (voting) shares ([German Wikipedia / company history](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Einhell_Germany))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Investment holding company coordinating the manufacture, sale, rental of fire protection equipment and provision of maintenance services across Europe (UK, Belgium, Netherlands, Austria, France, Germany, Denmark, Luxembourg) for 315,000+ customers via brands Nu-Swift, Ansul, Premier, Master.
thesis.competitive_position: Industry-leading margins (15.6% adj. 2024), established brands, superior quality/training, local presence, loyal base, in-house mfg. Barriers: reputation, compliance-driven recurring revenue.
thesis.main_shareholders: EOI Fire SARL (80.44%), Tristar Fire Corp. (18.40%) as of May 2025. Directors linked to Tristar (J-J Murray, J-P Murray, M-C Leon).
thesis.red_flags: None material. Transitory receivables rise from IT transition (high recoverability). Supply chain/competition/inflation risks mitigated. Very low free float (1.16%). Early-stage climate risk disclosures.
thesis.insider_ownership: All Executive Directors, plus Non-Executive Directors J-P Murray and M-C Leon, are connected with majority shareholder EOI Fire SARL (80.44% of shares, per main shareholders on file); individual director shareholding percentages are not separately disclosed ([London Security Corporate Governance](https://www.londonsecurity.org/about-us/corporate-governance/))

thesis.business_description: Bloomsbury Publishing Plc is a UK-based independent publishing house (founded 1986, London-headquartered) operating two divisions: Consumer publishing (adult and children's trade books) and Academic & Professional publishing (specialist content and digital resources for higher education).
thesis.competitive_position: Bloomsbury is one of the UK's leading independent trade and academic publishers, with authors accessing global markets via print, ebook, audiobook, digital download and online educational database channels; FY revenue reached £325.9 million with profit of £44.9 million, up 7% year on year, reflecting success in combining general and academic publishing ([Bloomsbury preliminary results](https://www.bloomsbury-ir.co.uk/media/press_releases/2026/200526.asp)).
thesis.main_shareholders: BlackRock, Inc. (9.7%, largest shareholder), plus other institutional holders in the 7-8% range; institutions collectively hold about 86% of the company, with the top 11 shareholders owning a combined 52% (no single majority holder) ([Yahoo Finance ownership summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/87-ownership-shares-bloomsbury-publishing-061728130.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO/founder-linked management holds a modest stake; the CEO (referred to in sources as John/Nigel Newton) directly holds approximately 2.0% of shares outstanding ([Yahoo Finance ownership summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/87-ownership-shares-bloomsbury-publishing-061728130.html))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

name: Arbuthnot Banking Group PLC
gmSourceUrl: [Arbuthnot Banking Group 2024 Annual Report](https://www.arbuthnotlatham.co.uk/sites/default/files/documents/ABG-Annual-Report-2024-26March2025.pdf), [ABG Report and Accounts 2024](https://www.arbuthnotlatham.co.uk/sites/default/files/documents/ABG_Report_and_Accounts_2024.pdf)

thesis.business_description: Arbuthnot Banking Group PLC is a UK banking group best known for its private bank, Arbuthnot Latham, providing private and commercial banking, lending and wealth management services to wealthy individuals, families, entrepreneurs and small-to-mid-sized businesses, alongside specialist finance subsidiaries (Renaissance Asset Finance, Arbuthnot Commercial Asset Based Lending, Arbuthnot Specialist Finance, Asset Alliance Group).
thesis.competitive_position: Arbuthnot positions itself as a relationship-driven private bank/wealth manager, an alternative to mass-market banks for high-net-worth and commercial clients, with a diversified set of specialist lending subsidiaries providing multiple revenue streams beyond core private banking.
thesis.main_shareholders: Sir Henry Angest (Chairman & CEO) is the controlling shareholder ([Yahoo Finance insider purchase report](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/chairman-ceo-arbuthnot-banking-group-050137027.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Insiders collectively own approximately 60% of the company, led by Chairman & CEO Sir Henry Angest ([Yahoo Finance / SimplyWall.st ownership](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/chairman-ceo-arbuthnot-banking-group-050137027.html))
thesis.red_flags: Governance note: Henry Angest holds the combined role of Chairman and CEO along with majority insider control (~60%), which is a departure from standard UK governance best practice of separating the chairman and CEO roles; no litigation or accounting concerns identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: DFDS A/S is a Danish integrated shipping and logistics company operating over 20 ferry routes across the North Sea, Baltic Sea, Channel and Mediterranean (Turkey-Europe), plus a Logistics division offering full-load transport and contract logistics/warehousing in Northern Europe.
thesis.competitive_position: DFDS describes itself as Northern Europe's largest integrated shipping and logistics company, owning/operating port terminals at strategic hubs (Immingham, Rotterdam, Gothenburg, Istanbul, Trieste) that support a scale advantage on its ro-ro/ro-pax freight and passenger routes ([Lauritzen Fonden business activities](https://lauritzenfonden.com/en/about-us/business-activities/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Lauritzen Fonden Holding ApS, a subsidiary of the Lauritzen Fonden foundation, is the controlling shareholder with 40.4% of share capital as of end-2024; the company had 25,235 registered shareholders holding 92.7% of capital in total ([DFDS shares page](https://www.dfds.com/en/about/investors/shares)).
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: STEICO SE is described as the world market leader in bio-based wood-fibre insulation materials and a leading provider of innovative timber-construction products, headquartered in Germany, with products (STEICOflex, STEICOtherm, STEICOuniversal, STEICOfloor, STEICOglulam, etc.) used for roof, wall, ceiling and floor construction in new-build and renovation.
thesis.competitive_position: STEICO holds the largest range of wood-fibre insulation products in the industry and sells to the wood/building-materials trade, timber construction companies, prefab-house manufacturers, flooring manufacturers and DIY stores; it sources wood from PEFC-certified sustainable forestry. FY guidance called for revenue growth of ~3-6% to around €388-399 million ([STEICO 2024 annual report](https://www.steico.com/fileadmin/user_upload/Investor_Relations/2025_Veroffentlichungen/2025_Financial_Reports/STEICO_annual-report_2024_INT_en_i.pdf)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Kingspan Group plc acquired a 51% majority stake from Schramek GmbH in a deal completed January 2024 (€250 million), with Schramek GmbH retaining approximately 10.1%; Kingspan holds an option to acquire a further ~10% in the future ([Kingspan Group announcement](https://www.kingspangroup.com/en/news-insights/kingspan-announces-acquisition-of-majority-stake-in-steico-se/))
thesis.red_flags: Note the significant 2023-2024 change of control: Irish building-materials group Kingspan acquired majority ownership (51%) from founding shareholder Schramek GmbH, which minority shareholders should be aware materially changed the company's ownership/strategic direction ([Kingspan Group announcement](https://www.kingspangroup.com/en/news-insights/kingspan-announces-acquisition-of-majority-stake-in-steico-se/)).

thesis.business_description: World’s biggest cork processing group, transforming cork into high-value products for wine stoppers, aerospace, automotive, construction, sports, energy, and more. Operates agroforestry units, raw material preparation, industrial plants, and distribution in over 100 countries. Family-controlled, listed since 1988, ~5,000 employees, 92.5% sales exports.
thesis.competitive_position: Global leader: World’s largest cork processor, biggest producer/distributor of cork stoppers, largest cork distribution network (51 companies), forefront of innovation/sustainability in cork industry.
thesis.main_shareholders: Amorim family entities (~64% combined: Amorim Investimentos e Participações SGPS SA 51%, Amorim Sociedade Gestora 10%; controlled by António Ferreira de Amorim family and Maria Fernanda Oliveira Ramos Amorim & daughters). Santander funds ~2.3%.
thesis.red_flags: Recent sales declines: -8.3% in 2025FY, -4.7% in 2024FY due to adverse global environment. No major risks identified in overviews.
thesis.insider_ownership: President of the Board António Rios de Amorim personally holds approximately 13.78% of shares/voting rights; family holding company Amorim Investimentos e Participações holds a further ~10.09%, part of the ~64% combined Amorim family control already reflected in main shareholders on file ([cgov.pt](https://cgov.pt/images/ficheiros/cgs-nacionais/2024/Corticeira_Amorim.pdf))

thesis.business_description: TOMA, a.s. is a Czech industrial-estate operator and utilities company (founded 1991, based in Otrokovice) that leases office, warehouse and industrial space, distributes electricity, gas, water and steam, runs a wastewater treatment plant, and provides related facility, leasing and property-development services.
thesis.competitive_position: TOMA operates a regional industrial-park/utilities niche in the Otrokovice area of the Czech Republic rather than competing nationally; it also wholly owns several subsidiaries (A.B.Titan, Averium Plastics, Belgrade Invest) extending into related services. [stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/pra/TOMA/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Prosperita Holding (a Czech investment group) has been reported as a significant long-term shareholder; precise current percentage ownership was not found in up-to-date public sources reviewed. Not disclosed in public filings reviewed.
thesis.insider_ownership: Specific management/board insider ownership percentage was not found in public sources reviewed. Not disclosed in public filings reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Forrás nyRt. is a Hungarian investment holding company with shareholdings across commercial real estate, renewable energy and manufacturing, and has indicated a possible expansion into metal parts/CNC machining in German-speaking Western Europe.
thesis.competitive_position: Forrás's business risk profile is described by Scope Ratings as constrained by limited geographic diversification (Hungary-focused) and an opportunistic investment philosophy with rapid changes in acquisition/divestment targets across years, rather than a focused operating-company moat ([Scope Group analysis](https://www.scopegroup.com/ScopeGroupApi/api/analysis?id=14b35da2-fa10-4561-8f2f-27eb0391d932)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Historical filings (as of 2011) showed Arago Befektetési Holding Zrt. holding 86.72% of share capital; current ownership structure was not confirmed in sources reviewed and this figure may be outdated ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FORR-S-NYRT-64304790/company/))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed, though note the opportunistic/shifting investment strategy flagged by Scope Ratings as a business-risk constraint rather than a governance red flag per se.

thesis.business_description: Railcare Group AB is a Swedish provider of specialized railway-maintenance services and equipment (re-ballasting, snow clearing, vacuum excavation, locomotive/wagon rental and workshop services) operating primarily in Scandinavia and the UK, headquartered in Skelleftehamn.
thesis.competitive_position: Railcare operates through Contracting, Transport and Technology segments, developing and selling its own specialized machinery (vacuum excavators, ballast feeders, multi-purpose rail vehicles); it targets SEK 1,000 million net sales and a 13% operating margin by 2027 and is pursuing a new UK framework agreement with Network Rail ([Railcare investor relations](https://www.railcare.se/en/investors/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Norra Västerbotten Fastighets AB (29.8%, after acquiring the founding Marklund and Dahlqvist families' entire holding), Swedia Capital AB (10.1%), Avanza Fonder AB (3.29%), Bernt Larsson (3.11%) ([Railcare ownership change release](https://www.railcare.se/en/release/information-about-ownership-changes-in-railcare-group-ab-publ/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 9.46% of the company; note the founding families (Marklund, Dahlqvist) sold their entire stake to Norra Västerbotten Fastighets AB, so founder ownership has been substantially reduced ([SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/transportation/sto-rail/railcare-group-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: The founding families (Marklund and Dahlqvist) sold their entire holding to Norra Västerbotten Fastighets AB, marking an exit of the original founder-owners; not necessarily negative but a governance/ownership change worth noting ([Railcare ownership change release](https://www.railcare.se/en/release/information-about-ownership-changes-in-railcare-group-ab-publ/)).

thesis.business_description: Groupe Partouche is a French casino operator founded in 1973 that operates casinos (gaming tables, slot machines), hotels, restaurants, spas and golf courses, with online gaming and pari-mutuel betting activities as well.
thesis.competitive_position: Groupe Partouche describes itself as the leading French casino operator and a market leader in Europe in its sector, operating 43 casinos (39 in France, plus Switzerland, Belgium, Tunisia and Benin) as of October 2025, with France representing about 88% of net sales. [GlobeNewswire H1 2025 results](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/06/10/3097003/0/en/GROUPE-PARTOUCHE-Solid-growth-in-turnover-in-the-first-half-of-2025-5-7-at-233-3-M-Key-step-towards-exiting-Financi%C3%A8re-Partouche-safeguard-plan.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: Financière Partouche SA (the Partouche family holding company) controls approximately 66.8% of Groupe Partouche; Butler Capital Partners SA holds approximately 13.3%; other named holders include Isidore Partouche, HMG Finance and Sunny Asset Management, with public free float around 13.8%. [Zonebourse](https://www.zonebourse.com/actualite-bourse/groupe-partouche-liste-des-actionnaires-ce7e5fd9d08af025)
thesis.insider_ownership: The founding Partouche family controls the company through Financière Partouche (~66.8%); board members/directors collectively are reported to hold around 5.75% of shares directly, and Patrick Partouche has been reaffirmed as controlling Financière Partouche as of October 2024. [GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2024/10/11/2962128/0/fr/GROUPE-PARTOUCHE-P%C3%A9rennisation-par-Patrick-Partouche-du-contr%C3%B4le-de-la-Financi%C3%A8re-Partouche-actionnaire-majoritaire-de-Groupe-Partouche.html)
thesis.red_flags: The controlling holding company, Financière Partouche, had been operating under a French court-supervised 'plan de sauvegarde' (safeguard/creditor-protection plan) originally dating to 2014; it was only formally closed in September 2025 after a 2025 refinancing (€80m credit facilities plus €35m Euro PP bond) allowed early repayment of remaining safeguard-plan debt. This reflects a long history of balance-sheet stress at the controlling shareholder level. [Gide law firm](https://www.gide.com/en/news-insights/groupe-partouche-met-en-place-un-refinancement-de-115me-pour-sortir-du-plan-de-sauvegarde/)

thesis.business_description: Belgian regulated real estate company (SIR) that owns and leases industrial, logistics, commercial and office buildings, mainly warehouses and distribution sites, to businesses needing storage, transport and supply-chain space.
thesis.competitive_position: Small-cap Belgian REIT listed on Euronext Brussels since 1998 with a ~€340M portfolio (68% commercial, 22% logistics, 8% office) and 96.5% occupancy as of mid-2025; much smaller in scale than peers such as Warehouses De Pauw (WDP).
thesis.main_shareholders: Stichting Administratiekantoor Valaur (36.4%), Vlim SA (6.14%), ageas SA/NV Asset Management arm (4.42%); top 7 shareholders hold 49.31% ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/WAREHOUSES-ESTATES-BELGIU-6107/company/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Insiders/private companies together hold a majority (~54% per one breakdown, or ~42.6% private companies + 2.3% individual insiders per another) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/be/real-estate/ebr-web/warehouses-estates-belgium-sca-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Edel SE & Co. KGaA is a Hamburg-based independent media company (founded 1986 by Michael Haentjes) operating as a music label and publishing group, also handling artist/label marketing and sales, plus production, logistics and distribution of CDs, DVDs, vinyl records and books through subsidiary optimal media GmbH, which produces approximately 37 million vinyl records annually.
thesis.competitive_position: Edel spans music repertoire from dance/rock/pop to classical and children's catalogues, combining label/publishing activity with physical-media manufacturing scale (vinyl production) as a differentiator versus pure-play digital-only music companies; H1 FY2025/26 turnover grew about 10% to €140.6 million with improved earnings.
thesis.main_shareholders: Michael Haentjes, founder and chairman, holds approximately 64% of the company; Robus Capital Management Limited holds 2.9%; Do Investment AG holds 0.6% ([Yahoo Finance ownership summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/edel-se-co-kgaa-etr-060027412.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder/chairman Michael Haentjes controls approximately 64% of the company, making Edel majority founder-controlled ([Yahoo Finance ownership summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/edel-se-co-kgaa-etr-060027412.html))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Transilvania Investments Alliance S.A. (formerly SIF Transilvania, founded 1996, based in Brașov, Romania) is a closed-ended financial investment company investing in Romanian public and private equity, including venture capital, growth capital and secondary portfolio interests, with a diversified sector focus spanning technology, construction materials, real estate, insurance and financial services.
thesis.competitive_position: As one of Romania's legacy 'SIF' regional investment funds, Transilvania Investments applies fundamental, in-house research-driven analysis across a diversified portfolio (public/private equity, real estate, tourism, financial services); it trades on the Bucharest Stock Exchange Premium category with a 100% free float, meaning no controlling strategic shareholder ([Transilvania Investments corporate site](https://transilvaniainvestments.ro/en/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: SOCEP S.A. (>10% ownership as of a July 2026 disclosure), BT Asset Management SAI (>5% ownership per an August 2020 disclosure) ([Transilvania Investments ownership statements](https://transilvaniainvestments.ro/en/about-us/shareholders/ownership-statements/))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed; as a fully free-floated, no-controlling-shareholder investment company, minority shareholder base is dispersed rather than founder/insider controlled.

thesis.business_description: Maisons du Monde SA is a French home-furnishings retailer that designs, sources and sells furniture, decorative items, lighting and textiles through its network of stores across Europe and an online platform.
thesis.competitive_position: As of 2023 the group operated 349 stores in Europe (212 in France) with over 5,500 employees; roughly 45% of sales were generated abroad and about half of total sales were made online, giving it meaningfully larger scale than most independent home-decor retailers, though it has faced intense pressure from e-commerce competition and weak consumer discretionary spending.
thesis.main_shareholders: Following a 2026 debt-for-equity restructuring, a consortium led by Alteri Investors and Eicos Investment Group converted approximately €210.9 million of bank debt into a 95.2% equity stake, reducing prior shareholders to a combined 4.78% ([InteriorDaily](https://www.interiordaily.com/article/9861140/maisons-du-monde-takeover-leaves-existing-shareholders-with-less-than-5/)). Pre-restructuring, the largest shareholders were Teleios Capital Partners GmbH (28.55%) and MARY Equity Investment SARL/Majorelle Investments (26.49%).
thesis.red_flags: Company underwent a financial restructuring in 2026 in which a lender consortium converted ~€210.9 million of debt into equity, diluting existing shareholders to under 5% of the company — a strong signal of prior balance-sheet distress ([InteriorDaily](https://www.interiordaily.com/article/9861140/maisons-du-monde-takeover-leaves-existing-shareholders-with-less-than-5/)).

thesis.business_description: Murapol S.A. is a Polish residential real estate developer, active since 2001, that develops apartment and commercial projects; through mid-2026 it had completed 104 multi-phase projects totaling over 36,200 units across 21 Polish cities.
thesis.competitive_position: Murapol holds a large, systematically renewed land bank supporting construction of approximately 19,150 further units across 18 Polish cities (as of June 2026), giving it a multi-city development pipeline rather than concentration in a single metro market ([Murapol company profile](https://murapol.pl/en/investor-relations/materials-for-investors/company-profile)).
thesis.main_shareholders: AEREF V PL Investment S.à r.l. (68%, 27,760,000 shares — a fund vehicle linked to Ares Management), Nationale-Nederlanden PTE S.A. (7.25%, 2,960,000 shares), Hampont Sp. z o.o. (5%, 2,040,000 shares — co-controlled by Supervisory Board members Nebil Şenman and Maciej Dyjas) ([Murapol shareholding structure](https://murapol.pl/en/investor-relations/murapol-listed-on-wse/shareholding-structure))
thesis.insider_ownership: Supervisory Board members Nebil Şenman and Maciej Dyjas co-control Hampont Sp. z o.o., which holds 5% of the company; the controlling shareholder AEREF V PL Investment S.à r.l. (68%) is a private equity fund vehicle rather than management/founder ownership ([Murapol shareholding structure](https://murapol.pl/en/investor-relations/murapol-listed-on-wse/shareholding-structure))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: French manufacturer of paper products, stationery and office supplies (Paper and Processing segments), selling under the Exacompta, Clairefontaine, Quo Vadis and Rhodia brands.
thesis.competitive_position: A long-established (founded 1858) family-controlled European stationery/paper group with ~3,362 employees and roughly $887M trailing revenue; sales concentrated in France (51.3%) and Europe (45.1%), reflecting a regional rather than global competitive footprint versus larger diversified paper groups.
thesis.main_shareholders: Établissements Charles Nusse (80.46% of capital as of 31 Dec 2025, >90% of voting rights via French double voting rights), free float ~19.2% including LG Invest (>5%) ([MatrixBCG](https://matrixbcg.com/blogs/owners/exacomptaclairefontaine); [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/de/materials/fra-8kg/exacompta-clairefontaine-shares/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: Nusse family, via Établissements Charles Nusse, controls 80.46% of capital and an estimated >90% of voting rights; board chaired by Jean-Marie Nusse ([MatrixBCG](https://matrixbcg.com/blogs/owners/exacomptaclairefontaine))
thesis.red_flags: Low free float (~19%) and limited institutional presence drive low share liquidity; no governance or litigation red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: French group (Groupe Guillin) that develops, manufactures and markets food packaging (plastic, paper and cardboard trays, bags, containers, cups) and related food-service equipment, founded 1972.
thesis.competitive_position: A leading European food-packaging manufacturer with ~3,094 employees, ~€884.5M revenue (2025), distributing to 70+ countries via a network of specialized subsidiaries; plastic packaging is 93.7% of sales, giving it scale advantages in a fragmented European packaging market.
thesis.main_shareholders: Guillin family holdings (four entities acting in concert) held 65.61% of capital / 78.65% of AGM voting rights as of 27 Feb 2026; other holders include FMR LLC (3.81%), Indépendance AM (3.69%), Amiral Gestion (3.44%) ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/GROUPE-GUILLIN-22752976/company-shareholders/))
thesis.insider_ownership: François Guillin individually ~65.8% (chairman); Sophie Guillin is CEO - founding family retains board and voting control ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/GROUPE-GUILLIN-22752976/company-shareholders/))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Dutch manufacturer of colour concentrates, pigments and additives for coloring plastics, PVC, aluminum profiles, coatings and packaging, headquartered in Apeldoorn with production in the Netherlands, Hungary, US and Indonesia.
thesis.competitive_position: Positions itself as an independent supplier of pigment/additive concentrates with ~430 employees operating through three regional divisions (Europe/Middle East/Africa/India, Americas, Asia); a niche specialty-chemicals player rather than a broad commodity pigments producer, with a strategic focus on recycling/circularity.
thesis.main_shareholders: Holland Pigments BV (51%), Lazard Frères Gestion SAS (6.97%), Peter van Leeuwen (5.06%), Jan de Heer (5%); top 13 shareholders own 89.41% ([Yahoo Finance/MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/HOLLAND-COLOURS-NV-6404/company-shareholders/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders ~10.1%, with private companies (including Holland Pigments BV) holding ~50.5% in aggregate ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/nl/materials/ams-holco/holland-colours-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Wynnstay Properties Plc is a UK property investment and development company (established 1886) that invests in a portfolio of secondary commercial properties — predominantly industrial units and trade counters — across Central and Southern England, targeting medium-to-long-term capital and income growth.
thesis.competitive_position: The portfolio comprises over 93 units across 16 locations let on 86 separate leases; for the six months ended 29 September 2025, rental/property income rose 2.8% to £1.4m, NAV per share rose 2.7% to 1,173p, the interim dividend was raised 5% to 10.5p, and the company reported 99% rent collection with minimal (0.4%) vacancy — indicating a tightly managed, high-occupancy niche portfolio rather than a large diversified REIT ([Wynnstay Properties company profile](https://www.wynnstayproperties.co.uk/about)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Philip Geoffrey Hugh Collins is the largest named shareholder; per TipRanks data, approximately 99.37% of shares are classified as insider-held, with only about 0.63% held by retail/institutional investors, indicating extremely concentrated, closely-held ownership ([TipRanks ownership](https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/gb:wsp/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: Approximately 99.37% of shares are classified as insider-held (led by Philip Geoffrey Hugh Collins), making Wynnstay Properties an effectively closely-held/family-controlled company despite its public listing ([TipRanks ownership](https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/gb:wsp/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: Extremely low free float (institutional ownership reported at approximately 0%) may mean limited trading liquidity for minority shareholders; no litigation or accounting concerns identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Regional bank providing retail and business banking products and services to private individuals and corporate customers in Southern Jutland, Denmark. Offers savings, loans, car financing, pensions, digital services.
thesis.competitive_position: Independent regional bank with local branches in Southern Jutland, emphasizing personalized service and digital complement; niche vs. national competitors.
thesis.main_shareholders: Bernt Ulrich Hermann Jansen (25.1%), Michael Jebsen Fonden (13.4%), free float 61.5%, minor institutional (0.18%).
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources and filings.
thesis.insider_ownership: Chairman Ulrich (Bernt Ulrich Hermann) Jansen, who has chaired the board since 1985, is himself the largest shareholder at approximately 25.1%, consistent with main shareholders on file ([Kreditbanken Ledelse](https://www.kreditbanken.dk/om-banken/ledelse-og-organisation/bankens-ledelse))

thesis.business_description: ProCredit Holding AG, based in Frankfurt, is the parent and strategic management company of the ProCredit group, a network of development-oriented commercial banks serving small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and private clients mainly in South Eastern and Eastern Europe (plus Ecuador).
thesis.competitive_position: ProCredit positions itself as a development-finance-oriented SME banking group with a focus on environmental and social responsibility rather than mass-market retail banking; as of 2025 it reported total assets of €11.6 billion, a loan portfolio of €7.75 billion and deposits of €9.14 billion across its network of banks. [ProCredit Holding](https://www.procredit-holding.com/about-us/)
thesis.main_shareholders: As of year-end 2024, major shareholders include Zeitinger Invest GmbH (~18.3%), KfW/DEG (~13.2%), DOEN Participaties BV (~12.5%), the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (~8.7%) and TIAA-CREF Investment Management (~2.65%); the top four holders together control roughly 53%. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/PROCREDIT-HOLDING-AG-50914884/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Ownership is dominated by development-finance institutions and the founder-linked Zeitinger Invest GmbH (~18.3%) rather than disclosed individual management stakes; specific board/executive insider ownership percentage was not separately found. Not disclosed in public filings reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Finnish beverage manufacturer (founded 1878) producing beer, cider, long drinks, soft drinks, energy drinks and water; the only independent large-scale brewery in Finland, operating via subsidiaries in Estonia (A. Le Coq), Latvia (Cesu Alus), Lithuania (Volfas Engelman), Denmark (Bryggeriet Vestfyen) and Belarus (Lidskoe Pivo).
thesis.competitive_position: Leading independent brewer across the Baltic Sea region with majority-owned national brewery subsidiaries in each market; recently expanded via acquisitions of Valmiermuižas alus (Latvia) and Banjalučka Pivara (Bosnia's largest brewery) in 2025, extending its regional beverage platform beyond the core Baltics.
thesis.main_shareholders: Veritas Group asset management arm (18%), Olvi Foundation (16.2%), Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken AB entities (~7.31% and ~6.61%), Estate of Heikki Hortling (4.86%), Varma Mutual Pension Insurance (4%), ODIN Forvaltning (3.39%); top 25 shareholders hold 82.28%, no single controlling shareholder ([MarketScreener](https://uk.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/OLVI-OYJ-39429102/company-shareholders/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders own approximately 3.97% of the company as a group ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fi/food-beverage-tobacco/hel-olvas/olvi-oyj-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; company retains Belarus operations (Lidskoe Pivo, 96.36% owned), which carries geopolitical/sanctions-related exposure given the region.

thesis.business_description: Bulgarian shipyard (founded 1955, Varna) providing ship repair, maintenance and drydocking services; the largest and best-equipped shipyard in Bulgaria, able to handle vessels up to 90,000 DWT in dock and 150,000 DWT afloat.
thesis.competitive_position: One of the leading ship repair yards in the Black Sea and Eastern Mediterranean region, with over 5,000 vessels serviced since 1955 and international clients from Germany, the Netherlands, Latvia, Portugal and Spain; operates one dry dock, two floating docks and 1,200m of piers.
thesis.main_shareholders: KRZ Invest AD (50%), Pension Insurance Company Saglasie AD (7%), CCB-Sila Pension Fund JSC (7%), general public (~25%) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/bg/transportation/bul-odes/odessos-shiprepair-yard-shares/news/private-companies-who-have-a-significant-stake-must-be-disap-96/amp))
thesis.insider_ownership: Insiders (management/directors) own less than 1% of the company ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/bg/transportation/bul-odes/odessos-shiprepair-yard-shares/news/private-companies-who-have-a-significant-stake-must-be-disap-96/amp))
thesis.red_flags: Market cap declined significantly per Simply Wall St reporting (down ~86m BGN), though no specific governance or litigation issue was identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Bytes Technology Group plc is one of the UK and Ireland's leading providers of software, security, AI, cloud services, and hardware solutions through its subsidiaries Bytes Software Services and Phoenix Software. The company serves over 6,000 customers in public and corporate sectors, focusing on organic growth by expanding relationships with existing clients and acquiring new ones in areas like cybersecurity, hybrid cloud, workspace, and data/AI. It operates a capital-light model with strong ve
thesis.competitive_position: One of the largest IT resellers in UK/Ireland with <4% share of £82bn TAM; competitive moats include deep vendor partnerships (11 Microsoft specializations, AWS MSP), high NPS 79, experienced leadership (20-30+ years), certified expertise, and sticky customer base (97-98% GP from existing customers).
thesis.main_shareholders: Major shareholders not explicitly disclosed in analyzed results presentations or website; institutional ownership prevalent per filings, refer to latest annual report or LSE RNS for details.
thesis.red_flags: No major red flags identified: zero debt, diversified 5,913 customers, no customer/product concentration noted; minor notes include slight eNPS decline to 57 and dependency on Microsoft (but offset by diversification efforts).
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual Insiders hold approximately 0.53% of shares; combined with the Employee Share Scheme (~0.06%), total insider-linked ownership is approximately 0.59% ([Yahoo Finance/Simply Wall St](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/several-insiders-invested-bytes-technology-143601164.html))

thesis.business_description: MEDICLIN Aktiengesellschaft operates a nationwide network of hospitals and clinics across Germany providing acute care and post-acute rehabilitation services, with particular focus on neuroscience, psychosomatics/psychology and orthopaedics, plus nursing care at some sites.
thesis.competitive_position: MediClin is a mid-sized private German hospital operator competing with larger chains (e.g. Asklepios, Helios, Sana) in the acute and rehabilitation hospital segment, differentiated by its focus on neurological and psychosomatic rehabilitation. [MediClin Annual Report 2023](https://www.mediclin.de/fileadmin/02_Dokumente_Share_verzeichnis/01_Klinikuebergreifende_Dokumente/Investor_Relations/Finanzpublikationen/2024_Finanzpublikationen/MEDICLIN_GB_2023e.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Asklepios Kliniken GmbH & Co. KGaA has held a majority stake in MediClin AG since September 2011 and is reported to own approximately 52.73% of the company. [Zahlen und Fakten der MEDICLIN AG](https://www.mediclin.de/investor-relations/zahlen-fakten/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Majority control sits with strategic/corporate shareholder Asklepios (~52.73%) rather than individual management; no separate board/executive personal shareholding was found disclosed. Not disclosed in public filings reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; majority ownership by a competing/related hospital operator (Asklepios) creates a structural related-party dynamic worth monitoring, though no specific dispute was found.

thesis.business_description: AS Silvano Fashion Group is an Estonia-based company (established 1944, Tallinn-headquartered) that designs, manufactures and markets women's lingerie and apparel under brands including Milavitsa, Lauma Lingerie, Alisee, Aveline and Laumelle, selling via wholesale, franchise and retail channels mainly in Russia, Belarus and other CIS/Baltic markets.
thesis.competitive_position: Silvano Fashion Group is a long-established regional lingerie manufacturer/retailer with over 570 stores across 24 countries, built around multiple owned brands and manufacturing in Belarus/the Baltics; its business is concentrated in Russia/CIS/Baltic markets rather than Western Europe. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AS-SILVANO-FASHION-GROUP-6496239/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: No single controlling shareholder; as of March 2026 reported holders above 5% included Baltplast AS (~22.24%), AS SEB Pank Clients (~22.22% nominee holding), Brem Avarii Osaühing (~5.56%), UniCredit Bank Austria AG (~5.49%) and Swedbank AB Clients (~5.35%). Baltplast AS announced plans for a voluntary takeover offer in 2024. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AS-SILVANO-FASHION-GROUP-6496239/news/Baltplast-Plans-Silvano-Fashion-Group-Voluntary-Takeover-Offer-46653386/)
thesis.insider_ownership: No controlling insider/management shareholder was identified; largest disclosed holder Baltplast AS (~22.24%) is a corporate investor, not disclosed as management. Not disclosed in public filings reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: Company's core markets (Russia, Belarus, CIS) carry elevated geopolitical/sanctions risk given the Russia-Ukraine war context; Baltplast AS's 2024 move toward a voluntary takeover offer could also signal a pending ownership-structure change. No governance disputes or accounting issues were identified from sources reviewed. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AS-SILVANO-FASHION-GROUP-6496239/news/Baltplast-Plans-Silvano-Fashion-Group-Voluntary-Takeover-Offer-46653386/)

thesis.business_description: UK-listed (AIM) owner and developer of oil palm plantations in Indonesia (North Sumatra, South Sumatra, Aceh, Bangka-Belitung, East Kalimantan), producing crude palm oil and palm kernels via six palm-oil mills across ~66,100 hectares plus smallholder-managed land.
thesis.competitive_position: A mid-sized sustainable palm oil producer with a Property segment alongside Plantations; holds the London Stock Exchange's Green Economy Mark for sustainability; part-owned by, and closely linked to, major Malaysian palm oil group Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (KLK), its largest shareholder.
thesis.main_shareholders: Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (24%), James Sharp & Co. Asset Management (6.3%), abrdn plc (6.0%); top 4 shareholders hold 51%; institutions hold 58% overall ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/food-beverage-tobacco/aim-mpe/mp-evans-group-shares/news/with-58-ownership-in-mp-evans-group-plc-lonmpe-institutional/amp))
thesis.insider_ownership: Insiders hold approximately UK£25m worth of stock; exact percentage not specified in available sources ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/food-beverage-tobacco/aim-mpe/mp-evans-group-shares/news/with-58-ownership-in-mp-evans-group-plc-lonmpe-institutional/amp))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; palm oil sector carries inherent deforestation/land-use ESG scrutiny industry-wide, though M.P. Evans markets itself as a sustainable producer with LSE Green Economy Mark recognition.

thesis.business_description: Tracsis is a global technology company shaping the future of transport, with a strong foundation in the UK and the US and a growing international footprint. They design and deliver critical systems for rail, road, and local networks, including smart ticketing, personnel planning, intelligent asset monitoring, and operations performance management. The company provides software, hardware, data analytics/GIS, and services for the rail, traffic data, and wider transport industries.
thesis.competitive_position: Leading provider in niche transport technology sectors with expertise commercialized from world-class research, long-term partnerships, global reach with local understanding, and technology-driven innovation creating barriers to entry.
thesis.main_shareholders: Major shareholders not explicitly disclosed on the official website pages reviewed; refer to latest annual report for substantial shareholdings notice.
thesis.red_flags: No major red flags identified from available pages: strong balance sheet with substantial cash reserves, no debt mentioned, no governance issues or single customer dependencies noted.
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 0.06% of shares; ownership is heavily institutional (~91%) ([Yahoo Finance/Simply Wall St](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/4T2.DU/insider-roster/))

thesis.business_description: French distributor of flower and vegetable seeds, young plants, bulbs, and horticultural supplies, headquartered in Colmar; sells to horticulture/gardening professionals, public authorities, and mass-market retail. Net sales split roughly plants/bulbs 61.7%, seeds 35.6%, horticultural supplies 2.7%.
thesis.competitive_position: Described as one of the leading independent European distributors of seeds and young flower/vegetable plants, with a European B2B/B2C footprint concentrated in France (~65% of sales), Germany (~15%), and smaller shares in Italy, Austria and the rest of continental Europe. ([Graines Voltz company profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/epa/GRVO/company/))
thesis.main_shareholders: Albatros, the family holding company of Chairman/CEO Serge Voltz, holds approximately 70% of capital (reduced from ~81.8% via prior share disposals) ([Zonebourse/Boursorama company profile](https://www.zonebourse.com/cours/action/GRAINES-VOLTZ-S-A-5386/societe/)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Effectively the same ~70% figure as main shareholders above - the company is majority-controlled by founder/CEO Serge Voltz through his Albatros holding vehicle, not a separately-disclosed insider bloc.
thesis.red_flags: Minority shareholders publicly disputed governance in 2017 (documented via a dedicated minority-shareholder advocacy blog and a letter to French regulator AMF), alleging the CEO's Albatros holding increased its stake past 75% under an outdated 2009 AMF exemption from mandatory-tender-offer rules, combined with a thin free float, limited transparency, and a persistently low market valuation - concerns framed at the time as a risk of a low-priced forced buyout of minority holders. This is dated (2017) context, not a confirmed current dispute, but relevant given the stock's persistently low valuation relative to revenue. ([2017 minority shareholder letter to the AMF](https://minoritairesgrainesvoltz.wordpress.com/2017/03/15/lettre-envoyee-a-lamf-le-15-mars-2017/))

thesis.business_description: German manufacturer (founded 1748, headquartered in Mettlach) of premium ceramic products across two segments: Bathroom and Wellness (sanitary ware, bathroom furniture, whirlpools) and Tableware (dinnerware, crystal, cutlery).
thesis.competitive_position: A leading international premium ceramics group with ~6,907 employees and record 2024 revenue of €1.421bn, boosted by the February 2024 acquisition of Ideal Standard Group, which significantly expanded its bathroom/sanitary scale in Europe.
