thesis.main_shareholders: Ordinary (voting) shares - 14,044,800 shares, unlisted - are held entirely by the founding Boch/von Boch-Galhau family (~140 family members); listed non-voting preference shares are held by institutional and retail investors including Aktia Varainhoito Oy and Magallanes Value Investors SA SGIIC ([Villeroy & Boch IR](https://www.villeroyboch-group.com/de/investor-relations/die-aktie/vorzugsaktie.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Founding family (Boch/von Boch-Galhau, ~140 members) holds 100% of voting ordinary shares, giving them full control despite the company being publicly traded via non-voting preference shares ([Villeroy & Boch IR](https://www.villeroyboch-group.com/de/investor-relations/die-aktie/vorzugsaktie.html))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; note the dual-class structure means listed (preference) shareholders have no voting rights, all control resting with the unlisted family-held ordinary shares.

thesis.business_description: Absolent Air Care Group AB is a Swedish manufacturer of industrial process-air filtration technology, operating through Industrial (filtration units for aerospace, automotive, defense, pharmaceutical, chemical, electronics, woodworking and food-processing customers) and Commercial Kitchen (ventilation hoods, filtration and fire-suppression systems) segments, with production facilities in Sweden, the UK, Canada and the Netherlands.
thesis.competitive_position: Absolent has its own operations in 14 countries across Europe, North America and Asia, with solutions distributed in around 50 countries via local companies and distributors; Q2 2026 net sales were SEK 329.0 million (up from SEK 314.4 million in Q2 2025), with growth driven by the Industrial segment while Commercial Kitchen faced continued market challenges ([Absolent investor relations](https://www.absolentgroup.com/en/investors/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Mexab Industri AB (55.6%, largest shareholder — linked to Mexab Holding AB and the Melker Schörling investment circle led by Mikael Ekdahl); private companies collectively hold about 55.5% of the company ([SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/capital-goods/sto-abso/absolent-air-care-group-shares/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 13.5% of the company; board/management-linked insiders hold a meaningful minority stake alongside controlling shareholder Mexab Industri AB (part of the Melker Schörling ownership group) ([SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/capital-goods/sto-abso/absolent-air-care-group-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed; note the Commercial Kitchen segment has faced continued market challenges per recent quarterly results.

thesis.business_description: Operates and manages the Port of Thessaloniki, Greece's second-largest port, including a container terminal, conventional cargo, passenger terminal, and intermodal/dry-port services via subsidiary ThPA Sofia.
thesis.competitive_position: One of the main ports in the Eastern Mediterranean and Greece's first transit port for conventional cargo; privatized in 2018 to a private consortium which now operates it under a long-term concession, giving it a regional logistics gateway role complementing (not directly competing with) Piraeus.
thesis.main_shareholders: South Europe Gateway Thessaloniki Ltd / SEGT, controlled by Belterra Investments Ltd (67%), Hellenic Republic Asset Development Fund / HRADF (7.27%), free float (~25.73%) ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/THESSALONIKI-PORT-AUTHORI-6258964/company/))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; company is a former state monopoly now under private concession, with the Greek state retaining a residual 7.27% stake via HRADF.

thesis.business_description: Topps Tiles plc is a UK specialist tile retailer (founded 1963, headquartered in Enderby, Leicestershire) selling wall and floor tiles plus related fitting products (adhesives, trims, grouts, waterproofing) to homeowners, tradespeople and small contractors, operating multiple retail/distribution brands including Topps Tiles, Pro Tiler Tools, CTD, Parkside, Fired Earth and Tile Warehouse.
thesis.competitive_position: Topps Tiles operates a multi-brand retail and distribution strategy covering both DIY consumers and trade professionals, employing about 1,850 people as of April 2026; this multi-fascia approach differentiates it from single-brand tile retailers, though it competes against large home-improvement chains and independent tile merchants.
thesis.main_shareholders: MS Galleon AG (30%, largest shareholder), with the second and third largest shareholders holding approximately 15% and 11% respectively; institutions hold 57.2% overall, private companies 30.3% ([Fintel / SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/retail/lse-tpt/topps-tiles-shares/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 11.6% of the company, representing roughly £9.9 million of the ~£86 million market value ([SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/retail/lse-tpt/topps-tiles-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Finnish bank-independent asset management group (Titanium Oyj, IPO 2017, listed on First North Growth Market Finland) providing discretionary asset management, mutual funds (including real estate funds), investment/wealth management and insurance intermediation to private, corporate and institutional clients.
thesis.competitive_position: A founder-led, bank-independent wealth manager in Finland; niche scale (~$76.4M market cap, ~$22.8M trailing revenue) versus large Nordic bank-owned asset managers, differentiated by its independent ownership structure.
thesis.main_shareholders: Tommi Santanen (13.3%), LKL Holding Oy (10.1%), Petri Kärkkäinen (10%), Henri Prittinen (9.36%), Mikko Leppänen (6.55%), Jorma Jussi Takanen (4.21%), Markus Oksa (4.21%) ([Titanium Oyj Largest Shareholders](https://www.titanium.fi/en/investors/shares-and-shareholders/largest-shareholders/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders (founding partners) hold approximately 49.7% of shares as a group, giving them effective control; institutions are largely absent from the share registry ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fi/diversified-financials/hel-titan/titanium-oyj-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Creightons Plc is a UK-based developer, manufacturer and marketer of toiletries, skincare, hair care and fragrance products (own brands including Feather and Down, Balance Active, The Curl Company, Emma Hardie and T-Zone), also operating private-label and contract-manufacturing businesses for high-street retailers and third-party brand owners, listed on AIM.
thesis.competitive_position: Creightons operates across three business streams (own-branded, private label, contract manufacturing), giving it revenue diversification versus pure own-brand cosmetics companies; its private-label and contract-manufacturing work for supermarket/high-street chains provides scale-driven, forecast-based volume alongside its own cruelty-free/vegan-friendly brand portfolio ([Creightons investor relations](https://creightonsplc.com/investors/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Schroders PLC has increased its stake to 11.03% of voting rights; approximately 27.8% of issued share capital is not in public hands (concentrated/insider-linked holdings), with the remainder held by public shareholders ([Investing.com / Creightons significant shareholders](https://creightonsplc.com/investors/significant-shareholders/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Approximately 27.8% of issued share capital is classified as not in public hands; specific named insider/director holdings were not itemized in sources reviewed ([Creightons significant shareholders](https://creightonsplc.com/investors/significant-shareholders/))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Polish developer of enterprise software (ERP and SFA systems) for businesses, offering three ERP product lines (Softlab, Macrologic, Wapro) plus mobile sales-force automation, data integration (Connector) and factoring (Faktor) tools; part of the international Asseco Group.
thesis.competitive_position: ERP accounts for over 97% of revenue; backlog at HY2026 of PLN 425.9M covers 89% of 2025 sales, indicating strong revenue visibility; benefits from being part of Asseco Group, a major European proprietary-software group operating in 50+ countries, giving distribution and scale advantages versus standalone Polish ERP vendors.
thesis.main_shareholders: Asseco Poland S.A. (via Asseco Enterprise Solutions, ~46-46.47%), Allianz Polska OFE (13.53%), Generali Polska OFE (10.06%), treasury shares (~1.79%) ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ASSECO-BUSINESS-SOLUTIONS-6500800/company-shareholders/))
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Wojciech Barczentewicz directly holds ~1.5% of shares; company otherwise majority-controlled by parent Asseco Poland rather than individual insiders ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/software/wse-abs/asseco-business-solutions-shares/news/what-kind-of-shareholders-hold-the-majority-in-asseco-busine/amp))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; majority control by parent Asseco Poland creates related-party/minority-shareholder dynamics typical of controlled subsidiaries.

thesis.business_description: Belgian construction company (founded 1920, headquartered in Liège) building and renovating residential and non-residential buildings, including public/private buildings, commercial spaces, and providing joinery, HVAC, insulation and metalwork services on a project-contract basis.
thesis.competitive_position: A family-controlled regional Belgian general contractor (~350 employees, ~$281M trailing revenue) operating primarily in the Liège/Wallonia construction market; project-based revenue model typical of mid-sized construction firms rather than a national-scale player.
thesis.main_shareholders: Moury Finance SA (50%), Gilles-Olivier Moury (11%, also Senior Key Executive), Lazard Frères Gestion SAS (3.0%) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/be/capital-goods/ebr-mour/moury-construct-shares/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider and affiliated ownership (Moury family via Moury Finance SA and Gilles-Olivier Moury) totals approximately 60.57% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/be/capital-goods/ebr-mour/moury-construct-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Groupe CRIT is a French services group operating in three core areas: temporary staffing/HR services (one of France's top five temporary employment providers), airport ground assistance, and engineering & maintenance services.
thesis.competitive_position: Groupe CRIT is a leading player in French temporary staffing, ranked among the top five providers in France, with operations extended into Italy, Spain/Portugal, the UK, Switzerland, the USA and Africa. It expanded scale via a 2025/2026 tender offer for Openjobmetis (Euronext Milan), reaching about 98.9% of the Italian staffing firm's capital, strengthening its position in European temp staffing ([Zonebourse](https://www.zonebourse.com/cours/action/GROUPE-CRIT-5152/societe/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Nathalie Jaoui (54.2%), Yvonne Guedj (17%), Karine Guedj (13.8%), Fanny Guedj (11.6%), Eximia SAS (8.52%) - figures as reported likely include overlapping/indirect family holding stakes ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fr/commercial-services/epa-cen/groupe-crit-shares/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders (Guedj/Jaoui families) hold about 82.5% of shares in aggregate ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fr/commercial-services/epa-cen/groupe-crit-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; company is tightly family-controlled (Guedj/Jaoui families), which limits free float and minority influence but was not flagged as a governance issue in available sources.

thesis.business_description: PWO AG (Progress-Werk Oberkirch) is a German developer and manufacturer of metal components and lightweight subsystems for the automotive/mobility industry, headquartered in Oberkirch, Baden-Württemberg, producing electric-motor housings, EV drive components, airbag/seat/steering safety components, and structural body/chassis parts, with production in Germany, Czechia, Canada, Mexico, Serbia and China.
thesis.competitive_position: PWO specializes in high-volume, tailor-made lightweight metal-forming solutions (often several million units per series) for mobility OEMs, giving it deep tooling/process expertise versus generalist metal fabricators, though profitability has been described as inconsistent relative to order volume ([Dismissed & Asset-Backed analysis](https://dismissedandassetbacked.substack.com/p/pwo-pwo-plenty-of-orders-not-enough)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Consult Invest Beteiligungsberatungs GmbH (47%, largest shareholder/private company), Sparkasse Offenburg/Ortenau Asset Management (8.6%), Dimensional Fund Advisors LP (0.9%) ([PWO shareholder structure](https://www.pwo-group.com/en/press-and-investors/pwo-share/shareholder-structure.php))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual investors hold approximately 44% of the company in aggregate, alongside the 47% held by private-company holder Consult Invest Beteiligungsberatungs GmbH; together the top 2 shareholder categories control more than half the company ([Yahoo Finance ownership summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/while-individual-investors-own-44-081035837.html))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed; note commentary from independent analysis questioning earnings consistency relative to order backlog ("Plenty of Orders, Not Enough Earnings").

name: Compañía Española de Viviendas en Alquiler S.A.

thesis.business_description: Spanish real estate company (founded 1968, headquartered in Barcelona) that designs, develops, manages and leases residential and non-residential properties, with a strategic focus on officially protected/affordable rental housing (over 2,000 protected rental homes promoted) alongside commercial, office and industrial space.
thesis.competitive_position: A specialized Spanish rental-housing REIT-like operator with three segments (Property for Rent; Real Estate Projects and Promotions; Financial Investments/Corporate Operations); ~74 employees and ~$50.4M trailing revenue, positioning it as a niche social/affordable-housing focused landlord rather than a diversified commercial REIT.
thesis.main_shareholders: Santander Asset Management SA SGIIC (24.2%), Eulalia Vaqué Boix (18.2%), Empar Vaqué Boix (16.9%); top 10 shareholders own 92.71% ([MarketsMojo/MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/COMPA-A-ESPA-OLA-DE-VIVIE-58002375/company/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 61.4% of the company in aggregate, including significant family holdings (Vaqué Boix family members) ([MarketsMojo](https://www.marketsmojo.com/stocks-analysis/financial-shareholding/compania-espanola-de-viviendas-en-alquiler-sa-cevasa-1120754-71))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: UK specialist equipment hire company (founded 1857, headquartered in Wednesbury) renting pumping equipment and climate-control products - air conditioning, chillers, heating/boilers, dehumidifiers and ventilation units - through Hire & Sales operations in the UK, Europe and the Middle East plus a UK installation business.
thesis.competitive_position: The UK's largest specialist hire company in its category, operating 30 UK depots with 300+ staff; most revenue derives from the Hire & Sales UK segment, giving it national scale versus smaller regional equipment-hire competitors.
thesis.main_shareholders: EOI Sykes Sarl, the Doherty family's holding vehicle, controls 86.90% of issued ordinary shares (family gained control approximately 25 years ago) ([company shareholder disclosures](https://www.andrews-sykes.com/investor-information/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Doherty family holds approximately 86.90% via EOI Sykes Sarl, an extremely high concentration leaving a very small free float ([company shareholder disclosures](https://www.andrews-sykes.com/investor-information/))
thesis.red_flags: Very low free float (~13%) due to 86.90% family ownership, which limits liquidity and outside shareholder influence; no other governance issues identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: UK infection-control and hygiene products company (headquartered in Snailwell, Cambridgeshire) that designs, manufactures and sells chlorine-dioxide-based disinfection products for high-level medical device decontamination and hospital environmental surface disinfection under the Tristel and Crystel brands.
thesis.competitive_position: A specialist AIM-listed medical device decontamination company (~189 employees) with a differentiated chlorine dioxide chemistry platform used across airway management, cardiology, ENT, ophthalmology, endoscopy and other hospital applications; delivered double-digit revenue growth and strong profit growth in FY2025 (year ended 30 June 2025).
thesis.main_shareholders: Liontrust Asset Management PLC (9.9%), Rathbones Investment Management Limited (8.4%), Raymond James Wealth Management Limited (7.7%); institutions hold ~88% of shares overall ([Yahoo Finance/Simply Wall St](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/88-ownership-shares-tristel-plc-070857111.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Insiders hold under 1% of shares ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/de/healthcare/fra-r1v/tristel-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: 3U Holding AG is a German holding company that owns and develops businesses across three segments: Information and Telecommunications Technology (ITC — voice/data services, data centers, managed services, fibre-optic installation), Renewable Energies (wind and solar power generation/project development), and Sanitary/Heating/Air-Conditioning technology (HVAC products sold via online stores to wholesalers, tradespeople and DIYers).
thesis.competitive_position: 3U operates as a diversified holding of niche, smaller businesses across telecom, renewable energy and HVAC distribution rather than a single-market leader, giving it varied revenue streams (recurring services, product sales, and energy output) but limited scale in any one segment relative to focused competitors.
thesis.main_shareholders: Michael Schmidt (25%, largest shareholder), Jürgen Beck-Bazlen (~3.9%, also a Supervisory Board member) ([Yahoo Finance ownership summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/3u-holding-ags-etr-uuu-134138196.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 35% of the company, with individual investors overall holding about 57%; the top 14 shareholders collectively control less than half the company, indicating a fairly dispersed ownership base beyond the largest holder ([Yahoo Finance ownership summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/3u-holding-ags-etr-uuu-134138196.html))
thesis.red_flags: News coverage in early 2026 flagged anticipated 'structural changes' (Strukturveränderungen) at 3U Holding, which may be worth monitoring though no specific details were found in sources reviewed ([finanznachrichten.de](https://www.finanznachrichten.de/nachrichten-2025-02/64504493-3u-holding-ag-aktie-strukturveraenderungen-absehbar-542.htm)).

thesis.business_description: German (Maintal-headquartered) international market leader in engineered and standardized connecting technology - clamps, connectors and fluid systems (hose clamps, pipe couplings, plastic connectors) - for vehicles, ships, aircraft, buildings and industrial applications, listed on the SDAX.
thesis.competitive_position: Global market leader in its niche connecting-technology segment with 125+ years of history and ~6,000 employees across EMEA, Americas and Asia-Pacific regions; ~$1.1bn trailing revenue, 100% free float since 2013 with a broadly diversified, largely institutional shareholder base.
thesis.main_shareholders: Teleios Capital Partners LLC (21%), Financière de l'Echiquier (15%), Amundi Asset Management SAS (~7.6%); ~94% of shares held by institutional investors, ~6% by private shareholders ([NORMA Group IR](https://www.normagroup.com/global/en/investor-relations/share/shareholder-structure); [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/65-ownership-shares-norma-group-045918993.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Management ownership is minimal at approximately 0.04% as of June 30, 2024 ([NORMA Group semi-annual report](https://reports.normagroup.com/semi-annual-report/2024/en/introduction/the-norma-group-on-the-capital-market/broadly-diversified-shareholder-structure/))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; fully institutionally owned free float with minimal management ownership.

thesis.business_description: UK structural steelwork company designing, fabricating and erecting steel frames and heavy steel components for buildings and infrastructure (offices, warehouses, bridges, stadiums, transport facilities), organized into Core Construction Operations and Modular Solutions segments including a Commercial & Industrial division.
thesis.competitive_position: The UK's largest structural steelwork specialist by turnover, holding an approximately 25% UK market share with 130,000 tons/year UK capacity plus 20,000 tons in the EU; record order book of over £480M and expanding into the high-growth Indian market via the JSW Severfield Structures (JSSL) joint venture.
thesis.main_shareholders: J O Hambro Capital Management (11.3%), M&G Investment Management (9.53%), Unicorn Asset Management (6.61%), Chelverton Asset Management (6.31%), Aberforth Partners LLP (6%); top 25 shareholders own 83.25% ([Yahoo Finance/company disclosures](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/severfield-plc-lon-sfr-major-131417971.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Insiders hold approximately 1.63% of shares; institutional ownership dominates at ~94.56% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/capital-goods/lse-sfr/severfield-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: SW Umwelttechnik Stoiser & Wolschner AG is an Austrian family business (founded 1910, headquartered in Klagenfurt) that develops and manufactures precast concrete components for infrastructure, water protection and environmental engineering, with operations in Austria, Hungary and Romania.
thesis.competitive_position: With about 400 employees across three Central European countries, SW Umwelttechnik is a regionally-focused, longstanding precast-concrete specialist rather than a pan-European scale player; it has been listed on the Vienna Stock Exchange since 1997.
thesis.main_shareholders: Wolschner Privatstiftung (private foundation) holds more than 40% of share capital; other major (>5%) holders include VBG Verwaltungs- und Beteiligungs GmbH (a wholly owned subsidiary of BKS Bank AG), Dr. Bernd Wolschner (personal), Dipl.-Ing. Klaus Einfalt (personal) and Dr. Stephan Dörler (direct and indirect) ([finanzen.net Aktionärsstruktur](https://www.finanzen.net/unternehmensprofil/sw_umwelttechnik_stoiserwolschner))
thesis.insider_ownership: The Wolschner family controls the company via the Wolschner Privatstiftung foundation (>40%) plus Dr. Bernd Wolschner's personal direct holding ([finanzen.net Aktionärsstruktur](https://www.finanzen.net/unternehmensprofil/sw_umwelttechnik_stoiserwolschner))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Danish tobacco manufacturer (headquartered in Søborg) producing handmade and machine-rolled cigars and traditional pipe tobacco, with global handmade cigar brands (Macanudo, CAO, Alec Bradley) plus, in the US, Cohiba, Punch, Partagas and La Gloria Cubana, and pipe/smoking tobacco brands (Captain Black, Erinmore, Mac Baren).
thesis.competitive_position: World leader in traditional pipe tobacco and a leading position in handmade cigars in the US; H1 2026 net sales stable at DKK 4.2bn with handmade cigars growing 6% organically offsetting a 4% decline in machine-rolled cigars/smoking tobacco; pursuing 'Focus2030' strategy including expansion into nicotine pouches.
thesis.main_shareholders: Skandinavisk Holding A/S / Skandinavisk Holding II A/S is the majority/controlling shareholder (historically 51%, with Swedish Match Cigars Holding AB holding 49% of the pre-IPO entity; combined Skandinavisk Holding stake reported around 65% of listed STG post-2016 IPO); Skandinavisk Holding is itself owned by the Augustinus Foundation and Det Obelske Familiefond (Danish foundations) ([company press release](https://www.st-group.com/press-media/news-stories/press-releases/skandinavisk-holding-will-through-scandinavian-tobacco-group-form-the-world-s-second-largest-cigar-company/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Insiders hold a minimal direct stake (~0.41%); control rests with majority shareholder Skandinavisk Holding rather than individual officers/directors ([Nasdaq/TipRanks ownership data](https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/sndvf/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; tobacco industry carries inherent regulatory/litigation risk industry-wide (excise taxes, marketing restrictions), though no company-specific issue was identified.

thesis.business_description: Hungarian consumer finance and real estate group (founded 1998 as Duna House, renamed DH Group in December 2025) operating in Hungary, Italy, Poland and Spain, offering mortgages, personal/business loans and insurance (Credipass brand) alongside real estate brokerage, appraisal, energy certification and property management services.
thesis.competitive_position: A leading Central European consumer finance and real estate brokerage platform with ~€125M annual revenue, intermediating over €3.4bn in loan volume and ~14,000 transactions annually through a ~5,000-person network; pursuing a 5-year strategy targeting tripled EBITDA by 2029 via M&A and organic growth, aspiring to become the European leader in its combined niche.
thesis.main_shareholders: CEO Gay Dymschiz is the largest shareholder (~39%), with a second major shareholder also holding ~39% and a third at ~8.3% (specific names of the second/third largest shareholders not confirmed in available sources); individual insiders hold ~78% in aggregate ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/hu/real-estate-management-and-development/buse-dunahouse/duna-house-holding-nyrt-shares/news/duna-house-holding-nyrts-busedunahouse-most-bullish-insider))
thesis.insider_ownership: Founders/insiders hold approximately 78% of the company collectively, with CEO Gay Dymschiz alone holding ~39% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/hu/real-estate-management-and-development/buse-dunahouse/duna-house-holding-nyrt-shares/news/duna-house-holding-nyrts-busedunahouse-most-bullish-insider))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; recent rebrand from Duna House to DH Group (Dec 2025) reflects expanding multi-country strategy, which carries integration/execution risk typical of an M&A-driven growth plan.

thesis.business_description: Ailleron S.A. is a Poland-based (Kraków) technology company providing software for the financial sector (Fintech segment — digital/mobile banking, LiveBank remote advisory platform, leasing front office) and Enterprise Services (telecom systems maintenance, outsourced programming for US/Western European clients), alongside a Hoteltech segment.
thesis.competitive_position: Ailleron serves major international banks including Citibank, ING, Santander, BNP Paribas, Crédit Agricole and Standard Chartered, with nearly 80% of revenue from foreign markets and over 1,500 specialists across Europe and America, positioning it as a scaled B2B fintech software vendor rather than a consumer-facing brand ([ad-hoc-news coverage](https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/ueberblick/ailleron-s-a-stock-exploring-the-fintech-provider-s-business-model-and/69035240)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Wrinzky Fundacja Rodzinna w Organizacji (22.6%), IIF Sp. z o.o. (20.8%), Franklin Resources, Inc. (7.32%), Grzegorz Młynarczyk (5.67%) ([Ailleron shareholder structure](https://ailleron.com/investors/shareholder-structure/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 7.12% directly per ownership-type breakdown, though founder/insider-linked entities (Wrinzky Fundacja Rodzinna, a family foundation, at 22.6%) hold a larger effective stake ([SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/software/wse-all/ailleron-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Lithuanian paper and wood-processing group (Grigeo Group AB) manufacturing hygiene paper (toilet paper, napkins, paper towels), packaging paper from recycled waste paper for corrugated cardboard, corrugated cardboard boxes, and wood hardboard products, via subsidiaries including AB Grigeo Klaipėda, UAB Grigeo Hygiene and UAB Grigeo Paper Packaging.
thesis.competitive_position: The largest manufacturer of sanitary-household (hygiene) paper in the Baltic countries and one of the largest paper/wood-industry groups in the region; 2024 turnover of €213M with €34.8M EBITDA; undertaking a >€106M investment (including a €55.2M SEB Bank loan) to double tissue-paper production capacity.
thesis.main_shareholders: Ginvildos investicija UAB (47.66%), itself 67% owned by Gintautas Pangonis; ~4,843 total shareholders as of 31 Dec 2024 ([Grigeo IR/Pestel-analysis](https://www.grigeo.com/en/for-investors/securities-and-main-shareholders))
thesis.insider_ownership: Gintautas Pangonis controls an effective ~31.9% economic stake through his 67% ownership of Ginvildos investicija UAB (which holds 47.66% of Grigeo directly), making him the controlling individual shareholder ([Grigeo IR](https://www.grigeo.com/en/for-investors/securities-and-main-shareholders))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; one-share-one-vote structure with no special controlling rights noted in company disclosures.

thesis.business_description: Invalda INVL is a leading Baltic asset-management and private-equity group based in Vilnius, Lithuania, managing alternative funds across private equity, forestry/agricultural land, renewable energy, real estate and private debt, plus pension-fund management in Latvia and family-office services.
thesis.competitive_position: Invalda INVL positions itself as the leading Baltic asset manager with a 30+ year track record and over €2 billion in cumulative acquisitions, sales and capital-raising transactions; it targets mid-market private-equity deals (EUR10-40m) in engineering, business services, food processing and renewable energy across the Baltics ([Invalda INVL IR](https://www.invaldainvl.com/en/investor-relations/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Lucrum Investicija UAB (25.8%), LJB Investments UAB (25.1%), Irena Miseikiene (24.7%), Alvydas Banys (7.38%), Indrė Mišeikytė (1.92%) - top 5 shareholders hold 84.89% under a shareholders' agreement on long-term management policy ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/INVALDA-INVL-AB-44154819/company/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders control about 34% of shares directly, with insider-linked private companies holding a further ~50.9% ([Simply Wall St ownership data](https://simplywall.st/stocks/lt/diversified-financials/nsel-ivl1l/invalda-invl-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: Highly concentrated, closely-held ownership (top 5 holders control ~85% under a formal shareholders' agreement) means minority shareholders have limited influence over governance and strategy. No other red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Synergie SE is a European leader in human resources management, providing comprehensive services including temporary staffing, recruitment, training, consulting, and outplacement. Operating in 17 countries with 800 agencies and over 5,700 permanent staff managing more than 57,000 temporary workers. Achieved record revenue of €3.185 billion in 2024, with 60% from international operations.
thesis.competitive_position: Reference European player in HR (#5 in Europe), outperforms markets (e.g., France +2.2% vs -6.3% sector). Leader in diversity (FT, Capital mag). Diversified multi-sector/multi-client (53% SMEs), strong international presence, strategic acquisitions enhancing position (e.g., Australia #1).
thesis.main_shareholders: HB Collector (controlled by founder family Henri Barande): 69.16% capital, 83.92% voting rights. Amiral Gestion: 5.62%. Treasury shares: 6.18%.
thesis.red_flags: Declining profitability (net profit -15.7% to €63M in 2024 due to market slowdown, inflation). Challenges in Germany/Switzerland (negative EBITDA). No major debts, lawsuits, or losses; strong cash position mitigates risks.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder-family shareholder Henri Barande (via HB Collector) holds approximately 70% of shares, consistent with main shareholders on file ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fr/commercial-services/epa-sdg/synergie-shares/news/synergie-se-epasdg-insiders-who-hold-70-of-the-firm-would-be))

thesis.business_description: Lucisano Media Group S.p.A. is an Italian entertainment holding company (founded 1958, headquartered in Rome) engaged in film production (via Italian International Film Srl), film distribution/rights licensing, and cinema management (via Stella Film, operating multiplexes in Rome, Brindisi, Zumpano, Marcianise, Benevento, Napoli and Afragola), with a catalog of over 600 titles.
thesis.competitive_position: Lucisano controls all film production and cinema-management activities of the Lucisano family group, giving it a vertically integrated position spanning production, distribution and exhibition in the Italian market, though it remains a small-cap company relative to major international studios.
thesis.main_shareholders: Keimos Società a Responsabilità Limitata (68.1%, 10,119,912 shares — the Lucisano family holding company), Fulvio Lucisano (11.8%, 1,755,586 shares), Alevi Srl (5.77%, 856,966 shares), Federica Lucisano (1.84%), Paola Lucisano (0.68%) ([SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/it/media/bit-lmg/lucisano-media-group-shares/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: Family-controlled at roughly 82%+ combined between Keimos (68.1%) and direct Lucisano family holdings (Fulvio, Federica, Paola Lucisano) ([SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/it/media/bit-lmg/lucisano-media-group-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Hvidbjerg Bank A/S is a small regional Danish bank, founded in 1912 and headquartered in Thyholm/Hvidbjerg, offering retail and corporate banking (accounts, loans, mortgages, pensions, insurance, digital banking) to customers in central and western Jutland (Thyholm, Struer, Viborg, Holstebro).
thesis.competitive_position: Hvidbjerg Bank is a very small local savings-bank-style lender competing against larger Danish regional and national banks in West Jutland; its competitive position rests on local relationships rather than scale. [stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/cph/HVID/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Sparekassen Thy holds 20.00% of shares, AP Pension holds 5.75% (following a March 2026 acquisition), and Chris Kjeld Kristensen holds approximately 6.5%. [GlobeNewswire storaktionærmeddelelse](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/03/05/3250293/0/da/Storaktion%C3%A6rmeddelelse.html)
thesis.insider_ownership: Company insiders are reported to collectively hold about 21.0% of shares, with individual insiders (as distinct from institutional holders like Sparekassen Thy) at roughly 1.24% per one aggregator breakdown. [Macroaxis](https://www.macroaxis.com/ownership/HVID.CO/Hvidbjerg-Bank)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Fast Ejendom Danmark A/S is a Danish real estate investment company that owns, rents out and manages commercial and residential properties (offices, storage/production facilities, shops, apartments and mixed-use buildings) mainly in Copenhagen, Aarhus and the Triangle Region, targeting cities with over 30,000 inhabitants.
thesis.competitive_position: Fast Ejendom Danmark is a small-cap Danish property investor focused on secondary Danish cities, differentiating itself from larger listed Nordic REITs through a more regional, diversified commercial/residential portfolio. [stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/cph/FED/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: AP Pension Livsforsikringsaktieselskab holds approximately 25.7% of shares, Investeringsselskabet Artha Optimum A/S holds approximately 7.78%, and the company itself holds about 2.66% in treasury shares. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FAST-EJENDOM-DANMARK-A-S-35055777/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: No specific board/management insider ownership percentage (separate from institutional holder Artha Optimum) was found in public sources reviewed; CEO is Torben Holger Schultz and Chairman is Niels Henrik Roth. Not disclosed in public filings reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Speedy Hire plc is a UK-based equipment-rental company that hires out tools, plant, lifting gear, power equipment and specialist site equipment to construction, infrastructure, utility and industrial customers, alongside related services such as equipment management, testing, training and delivery.
thesis.competitive_position: Speedy Hire operates from over 200 fixed sites across the UK and Ireland and reported FY2026 revenue of £416.1 million; it recently secured a commercial agreement with ProService expected to add £50-55 million in revenue, positioning it as one of the larger national tool-hire operators, competing with larger international players such as Ashtead/Sunbelt Rentals ([Speedy Hire](https://www.speedyhire.com/investors/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Schroder Investment Management (13%), abrdn plc (8.0%), Aberforth Partners LLP (7.3%), Fidelity International, Jupiter Fund Management ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/capital-goods/bats-chixe-sdyl/speedy-hire-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; company is heavily institutionally owned (~87%) with no controlling shareholder or family stake.

thesis.business_description: Swedish IT consultancy providing digital transformation, system development, cloud infrastructure (Modern Work M365, Dynamics 365), cybersecurity, automation and SaaS solutions (including an AML system, CM1) to public and private sector clients, headquartered in Stockholm.
thesis.competitive_position: A mid-sized (~485 employee, ~$101M revenue) Swedish IT/management consulting firm focused on long-term client relationships including multi-year outsourcing; FY EBITDA margin declined to 11.4% from 13.6%, suggesting some margin pressure versus prior year.
thesis.main_shareholders: AB Traction (22%), Anders Eriksson (19.6%), Stig Martin (8.05%), Swedbank Robur Fonder AB (5%); top 15 shareholders own 64.68% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/software/sto-sof-b/softronic-shares/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 30.1% of the company as a group ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/software/sto-sof-b/softronic-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: FY EBITDA and EBITDA margin declined year-over-year (104.4 Mkr vs 114.6 Mkr; 11.4% vs 13.6% margin); no governance or litigation issues identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Monnari Trade S.A. designs, outsources production of, markets and sells women's clothing and accessories (skirts, dresses, coats, bags, jewelry) under the MONNARI brand targeted at women aged roughly 30-50, through its own store network and online in Poland and internationally.
thesis.competitive_position: Monnari is a mid-sized Polish women's fashion retailer competing against larger domestic chains (e.g. LPP, CCC) and international fast-fashion players; it also holds notable non-core real estate/financial assets alongside its retail operations, a feature value investors have flagged. [Bebop Value / Hidden Zlotys analysis](https://hiddenzlotys.substack.com/p/monnari-trade-sa-a-retailer-with)
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder and CEO Mirosław Misztal holds approximately 39.46% of shares (40.14% of votes) as of March 2026; Monnari Trade S.A. itself holds about 15.62% in treasury shares, and Fair sp. z o.o. holds approximately 8.29%. thesis.competitive_position: Inpro is one of the largest developers in the Tri-City region, having completed over 50 projects and delivered more than 4,000 residential units; its group includes prefabrication, property-rental and construction-finishing subsidiaries, giving it more vertical integration than pure-play developers ([Inpro corporate site](https://www.inpro.com.pl)).

thesis.competitive_position: Leader in niche markets like poultry hatcheries, pipe extrusion, and food handling automation; strong innovation (e.g., SmartVac, PVC-O pipes); global presence in 105 countries; stable revenue ~€270-280M; peers include Kendrion, Aalberts, TKH; 'buy & build' strategy with recent Eqraft JV.

thesis.business_description: Flügger group A/S is a Danish manufacturer of building paints, wood stains, fillers and wallpaper, sold under brands including Flügger, DAY-system, Fiona and PP Mester Maling, with factories in Denmark, Sweden, China and Poland and its own Flügger Decor retail chain across Scandinavia, Eastern Europe and China.
thesis.competitive_position: Flügger combines in-house manufacturing with a proprietary retail chain (Flügger Decor), giving it more vertical integration than pure wholesale paint makers, competing in the Nordic/Eastern European decorative-paints market ([Flügger IR](https://www.flugger.com/en/investor_eng/share-capital-and-ownership/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: M+ II A/S (851,487 B-shares, controlled by Bettina Antitsch Mortensen), Ulf and Sune Schnack, father and son (1,346,456 shares combined) ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FLUGGER-GROUP-A-S-1412902/company/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Founding Schnack family and related holding company M+ II A/S control a substantial share block and, via A-shares (10 votes each vs. 1 vote for listed B-shares), a majority of voting rights ([Flügger IR](https://www.flugger.com/en/investor_eng/share-capital-and-ownership/))
thesis.red_flags: Dual-class share structure (A-shares carry 10x the votes of the listed B-shares) concentrates control with the founding Schnack family, limiting minority shareholders' influence despite only B-shares being publicly traded. No other red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Samse SA is a French distributor of building materials and DIY products, founded in 1920 in Grenoble, selling cement, insulation, roofing, timber, tools and related equipment to professional builders/tradespeople and private customers via a network of branches and, under the 'L'Entrepôt du Bricolage' brand, DIY retail stores.
thesis.competitive_position: Samse operates a network of about 430 sales points across 68 French departments with over 7,300 employees (2024); building-materials trading represents 80.6% of revenue and DIY retail (37 stores) 19.4%, making it a significant regional player in French construction-materials distribution, listed on the CAC Small index ([Zonebourse](https://www.zonebourse.com/cours/action/SAMSE-35053955/societe-actionnaires/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Dumont Investissement, the holding grouping historical leaders and employees of the Samse group, holds more than 77.3% of capital and 81.28% of voting rights ([Zonebourse](https://www.zonebourse.com/cours/action/SAMSE-35053955/societe-actionnaires/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Founding families and employees, via Dumont Investissement, control over 77.3% of capital and 81.28% of voting rights ([Zonebourse](https://www.zonebourse.com/cours/action/SAMSE-35053955/societe-actionnaires/))
thesis.red_flags: Very high insider ownership concentration (~77-81% via the Dumont Investissement employee/family holding vehicle) leaves a small free float and limited minority-shareholder influence. No other red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: TOYA S.A. is a Polish producer and distributor of hand tools, power tools, professional gastronomy equipment and home-maintenance products, headquartered in Wrocław, sold under brands including YATO, STHOR, VOREL, LUND, FALA and FLO.
thesis.competitive_position: TOYA distributes its products in over 100 countries mainly to wholesalers, distributors and retailers, and emphasizes continuous new-product development (approximately 850 new SKUs introduced annually) as a competitive lever in the fragmented tools-distribution market ([TOYA shareholder structure / IR](https://toya.pl/en/shareholder-structure)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Jan Szmidt (38.2%, 28,284,304 shares), Romuald Szałagan (13%, 9,652,290 shares), Beata Szmidt (4.38%, 3,239,253 shares), Generali Powszechne Towarzystwo Emerytalne S.A. (6.75%) ([TOYA shareholder structure](https://toya.pl/en/shareholder-structure))

thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Spanish designer and manufacturer of large milling machines (gantry, travelling column, bed- and bridge-type) under the Correanayak brand, serving die/mould, aerospace, railway and energy sectors, headquartered in Burgos.
thesis.competitive_position: Export-driven (~90% of production exported to 20+ countries) machine-tool maker with subsidiaries in Germany, China and the US; niche large-format milling specialist rather than a mass-market machine tool producer, with ~$129M trailing revenue.
thesis.main_shareholders: Mepro-Outremer SA (~29%), with Sancor Capital S.L. and Masaveu Finanzas S.L. also holding significant stakes; individual investors hold ~48% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/es/capital-goods/bme-nea/nicolas-correa-shares/news/nicols-correa-sas-bmenea-largest-shareholders-are-individual/amp); [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/NICOL-S-CORREA-S-A-4001440/company-shareholders/))

thesis.business_description: Speedy AD is a Bulgaria-based courier, parcel and logistics company founded in 1998, operating door-to-door courier and transportation services through a network of 84 offices in 55 domestic locations and a fleet of over 500 vehicles, plus international delivery via the DPD/GeoPost network.
thesis.competitive_position: Speedy is the leading domestic courier operator in Bulgaria and, through its former ownership of DPD Romania and its 2021 majority acquisition by GeoPost/DPDgroup, is integrated into one of Europe's largest parcel-delivery networks, giving it international scale advantages versus smaller local couriers ([ti-insight](https://ti-insight.com/geopost-dpdgroup-acquires-the-majority-stake-of-speedy-ad-in-bulgaria/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: GeoPost/DPDgroup (69.81% of share capital, acquired via a 2021 voluntary tender offer) ([ti-insight](https://ti-insight.com/geopost-dpdgroup-acquires-the-majority-stake-of-speedy-ad-in-bulgaria/))
thesis.red_flags: Majority control (69.81%) by a single strategic parent, GeoPost/DPDgroup, means minority shareholders have limited influence and the stock has a small free float. No other red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Genova Property Group AB is a Swedish real estate company (founded 2006, Stockholm-listed since 2020) that owns, manages and develops commercial, residential and public-sector properties (schools, municipal/defense facilities, rental housing, nursing/care homes) concentrated in the Stockholm and Uppsala regions.
thesis.competitive_position: Genova is a mid-sized Swedish property developer/landlord focused regionally on Stockholm/Uppsala with a diversified mix across investment properties, housing and public buildings, differentiating it from pure commercial-only or pure-residential Swedish property peers. thesis.business_description: Solnaberg Property AB is a Swedish real-estate company that owns and manages a single property, Solna Bladet 3, comprising four interconnected office buildings totaling about 31,325 sqm of lettable area in Bergshamra, Solna.
thesis.competitive_position: As a single-asset property vehicle, Solnaberg has no portfolio diversification; its main tenant, If Skadeförsäkring, represents about 80% of rental income, giving high tenant concentration but also stable long-term income and high (98%) occupancy ([Quartr](https://quartr.com/companies/solnaberg-property_16608)).

thesis.red_flags: Single-asset, single-tenant concentration risk: roughly 80% of rental income derives from one tenant (If Skadeförsäkring), creating significant lease-renewal/concentration risk. No other red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.competitive_position: A leading Polish digital media and e-commerce group monetizing audiences through both advertising/subscriptions and transactional commerce (travel bookings being the largest segment); Q1 2026 cash revenue grew 50% year-over-year to PLN 551.5M, indicating strong growth momentum versus single-model media or e-commerce peers.
thesis.main_shareholders: Founders Jacek Świderski (~12.69% capital / ~18.37% votes), Michał Brański (~12.68% / ~18.36%), Krzysztof Sierota (~12.67% / ~18.35%) collectively control over 50% of voting rights via privileged dual-class shares; remainder publicly traded, including holdings by Dimensional Fund Advisors (DFA) index funds ([Wirtualnemedia.pl](https://www.wirtualnemedia.pl/swiderski-branski-i-sierota-przejeli-3-4-mln-uprzywilejowanych-akcji-wirtualnej-polski-maja-56-6-proc-glosow-na-wza,7171819917449345a))

thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; dual-class share structure concentrates voting control with founders despite minority economic stake.

thesis.business_description: Hortico S.A. is a Polish wholesale and retail distributor of professional and hobby gardening products (seeds, seedlings, fertilizers, substrates, plant protection products, tools and nursery supplies), operating since 1991 and selling into Poland, Hungary, Ukraine and Lithuania.
thesis.competitive_position: Hortico serves two distinct customer segments - professional horticultural growers ("profi") and hobby/retail garden centers - as a distributor for major European horticultural manufacturers; it was the first horticultural-industry company listed on Warsaw's NewConnect market, indicating a small-cap, founder-led niche distribution position rather than a dominant manufacturer role.
thesis.main_shareholders: Paweł Kolasa (CEO) ~40.36%, Andrzej Guszał ~18.19%, Robert Bender ~16.39%, Urszula Bender ~0.67% ([StockWatch.pl](https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/hortico,akcjonariat,dane-finansowe.aspx))
thesis.insider_ownership: ~75% combined held by CEO Paweł Kolasa and related founder/director shareholders (Guszał, Bender, Bender) per the shareholder breakdown found
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; very high insider/founder concentration (~75%+) leaves a small free float (~24%) and limited independent minority oversight.

thesis.business_description: Lithuanian clothing retailer (founded 1945, headquartered in Vilnius) operating a network of 166 multi-brand stores (Apranga, Aprangos galerija, City, Mados Linija) and e-commerce across Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia, selling brands including Zara, Mango, Massimo Dutti, Calvin Klein, Tommy Hilfiger and Max Mara.
thesis.competitive_position: The leading clothing retail group in the Baltic states with ~€269.7M revenue (2023) spanning economy, youth, business and luxury segments; benefits from exclusive Baltic distribution rights for major international brands (Zara, Inditex group brands), a scale advantage versus smaller independent Baltic retailers.
thesis.main_shareholders: MG Baltic Group UAB (65.4%, 36.17M shares), UAB Minvista (10.5%, 5.8M shares) - both linked to the MG grupe conglomerate (encompassing MG investment, MV Group, Darnu Group) ([MarketScreener/company shareholder page](https://aprangagroup.lt/en/investors/corporate-governance/shareholders))

thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; note MG Baltic Group's broader business interests (alcohol, real estate) create related-party/conglomerate considerations.

thesis.business_description: Phoenix Mecano AG is a Swiss industrial group headquartered in Stein am Rhein, producing enclosures (aluminum, plastic and glass-fiber-reinforced polyester enclosures, control panels), industrial components, and, via its DewertOkin Technology Group division, electromechanical drive/lifting systems for furniture and medical applications.
thesis.competitive_position: Phoenix Mecano is a global leader in several niches of the enclosures and industrial-components market, operating through three divisions (Enclosure Systems, Industrial Components, DewertOkin Technology Group) with about 7,500 employees and CHF/EUR 757.3 million in 2025 sales ([Phoenix Mecano](https://group.phoenix-mecano.com/en/investor-relations)).
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; detailed shareholder percentage disclosure was not found in available sources for this search.

thesis.competitive_position: Ernst Russ is a mid-sized German shipping and maritime-fund manager with both an owned/operated container-vessel fleet and third-party asset-management business, positioning it as a combined shipowner-and-investment-manager rather than a pure asset-light or pure-play tonnage provider. [Ernst Russ AG company site](https://www.ernst-russ.de/en/share.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Döhle shipping family controls the company: Jochen Thomas Döhle holds approximately 38.47% and Jan Peter Döhle approximately 36.82%, with related entities JaJo Beteiligungsgesellschaft mbH & Co. KG (~9.17%) and MS Cordula Schiffahrtsgesellschaft mbH & Co. KG (~6.45%) also holding stakes. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ERNST-RUSS-AG-24911281/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: The Döhle family (Jochen Thomas Döhle and Jan Peter Döhle) together control over 75% of shares directly, representing very high founder/insider-family concentration. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ERNST-RUSS-AG-24911281/company/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; very high (>75%) combined family insider ownership concentrates control and reduces free float/minority influence.

thesis.business_description: S&U plc is a UK specialist financial-services group founded in Birmingham in 1938, operating in used-car finance (through subsidiary Advantage Finance) and short-term property bridging finance (through Aspen Bridging, launched 2017).
thesis.competitive_position: S&U is one of the UK's longer-established specialist consumer and property lenders, with Advantage Finance recognized as a leading provider of specialist motor finance and Aspen Bridging a smaller but growing property-bridging lender; it has traded on the London Stock Exchange since 1961 ([Bitget](https://www.bitget.com/stock/lse-sus/what-is)).
thesis.main_shareholders: The Coombs family collectively holds approximately 53% of S&U's shares; Chairman and Managing Director Anthony Michael Vincent Coombs personally holds 10.32%; institutional holders include Aberforth Partners and Schroders ([Pestel Analysis](https://pestel-analysis.com/blogs/owners/suplc))
thesis.insider_ownership: The founding Coombs family collectively controls about 53% of shares, with Chairman Anthony Coombs personally holding 10.32% ([Pestel Analysis](https://pestel-analysis.com/blogs/owners/suplc))
thesis.red_flags: As a consumer/motor and property-bridging lender, S&U is exposed to UK consumer credit regulatory risk (e.g., FCA motor-finance commission review) and property-market cyclicality; specific recent controversy was not confirmed in this search, so noted as a sector-level risk rather than a company-specific finding.

thesis.business_description: Firefly AB is a Swedish company (founded 1967, Stockholm) that develops, manufactures and markets fire and dust-explosion protection systems, split between Industrial Applications (process monitoring for woodworking, tissue, food, bioenergy, tobacco and recycling industries) and Infra Systems/Sentio (early fire detection for subway, rail, road and cable tunnels).
thesis.competitive_position: Firefly holds a specialized niche in industrial fire/dust-explosion prevention and tunnel fire-detection systems, serving process industries and transport infrastructure rather than general fire-alarm markets. [firefly.se](https://firefly.se/about-us/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Erik Mitteregger is the largest shareholder with approximately 38.32%, followed by Magnus Wahlquist (~7.5%) and Birgitta Svensson (~5.5%); individuals hold about 56.4% of shares in total. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FIREFLY-AB-39431054/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Largest shareholder Erik Mitteregger (~38.32%) is understood to be an active investor/board-linked holder rather than an operating executive; specific separate management-team ownership percentage was not found. Not disclosed in public filings reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Prim, S.A. is a Spain-based (Móstoles) hospital-supplies and orthopedics group founded in 1870, providing implantable orthopedic products, silicone foot products, abduction splints, mastectomy lingerie, prosthetic components, articulated electric beds and geriatric-care accessories, plus physiotherapy and rehabilitation products through its Grupo Prim subsidiaries (including Enraf Nonius Ibérica).
thesis.competitive_position: Prim is a long-established Spanish hospital-supplies and orthopedics group with a national network of orthopedic stores and a diversified product portfolio spanning orthopedics, hospital supplies, physiotherapy and rehabilitation, plus a real-estate subsidiary (Inmobiliaria Catharsis) ([Prim](https://www.prim.es/en/divisions/orthopaedics/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: José Ignacio Comenge Sánchez-Real (22.5%), a founding-family shareholder syndicate holding 18.56% collectively (3,162,648 shares), Fidelity (9.99%), María Elena García Becerril (7.21%), Masaveu Finanzas (5.81%) ([Forbes España](https://forbes.es/economia/743422/el-sindicato-de-accionistas-de-prim-se-amplia-con-13-miembros-y-el-1856-del-capital/))
thesis.insider_ownership: The Comenge/Prim founding-family shareholder syndicate holds 18.56% of capital collectively, with the largest individual family shareholder (José Ignacio Comenge Sánchez-Real) holding 22.5% ([Forbes España](https://forbes.es/economia/743422/el-sindicato-de-accionistas-de-prim-se-amplia-con-13-miembros-y-el-1856-del-capital/))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search.

thesis.business_description: Immobilière Dassault SA is a Paris-based French real estate company (SIIC/REIT status) that acquires, develops and manages premium office, retail and residential properties concentrated in prime Paris locations; its portfolio at end-2025 comprised 15 assets totaling 42,288 sqm valued at about EUR990.4 million.
thesis.competitive_position: Immobilière Dassault is a small, tightly-held Paris prime-office/residential REIT, part of the Dassault family's industrial group; Q1 2026 rental income grew 17.4% to EUR9.3m, and the family holding company (GIMD) recently acquired Peugeot Invest's 19.81% stake, consolidating control near 80% ([L'Essentiel de l'Éco / Le Monde du Droit](https://www.lemondedudroit.fr/deals/104236-august-debouzy-conseille-le-groupe-industriel-marcel-dassault-dans-le-cadre-de-lacquisition-dune-participation-dans-immobiliere-dassault-aupres-de-peugeot-invest.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Groupe Industriel Marcel Dassault (GIMD), the Dassault family holding company, holds approximately 80% of capital following its 2025 acquisition of Peugeot Invest Assets' 19.81% stake (GIMD held 55.3% as of October 2025 prior to the deal) ([Le Monde du Droit](https://www.lemondedudroit.fr/deals/104236-august-debouzy-conseille-le-groupe-industriel-marcel-dassault-dans-le-cadre-de-lacquisition-dune-participation-dans-immobiliere-dassault-aupres-de-peugeot-invest.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: The Dassault family, via GIMD, controls approximately 80% of the company following its 2025 purchase of Peugeot Invest's stake ([Le Monde du Droit](https://www.lemondedudroit.fr/deals/104236-august-debouzy-conseille-le-groupe-industriel-marcel-dassault-dans-le-cadre-de-lacquisition-dune-participation-dans-immobiliere-dassault-aupres-de-peugeot-invest.html))
thesis.red_flags: Very high family/insider ownership concentration (~80% via GIMD) leaves a very small free float and limited minority-shareholder influence and stock liquidity. No other red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Südwestdeutsche Salzwerke AG (SWS), based in Heilbronn, Germany, is one of Europe's leading salt producers, operating rock-salt and brine-salt mines in Heilbronn and Berchtesgaden and processing facilities in Bad Friedrichshall and Bad Reichenhall, serving industrial, winter-service and household customers.
thesis.competitive_position: SWS operates a Salt segment (production, marketing and trade of salt products) and a Disposal segment (recycling/disposal of waste from salt production); the group generated sales of roughly €343 million in 2025 with 1,151 employees, positioning it as one of the leading European salt producers, though it remains majority publicly (state/municipally) owned rather than market-driven ([Salzwerke.de](https://www.salzwerke.de/de/investor-relations/aktie/kursentwicklung-aktionaersstruktur.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: City of Heilbronn (49.0%), State of Baden-Württemberg (49.0%), as of December 2025 ([Südwestdeutsche Salzwerke IR](https://www.salzwerke.de/de/investor-relations/aktie/kursentwicklung-aktionaersstruktur.html))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; company is majority controlled by German public-sector shareholders (City of Heilbronn and State of Baden-Württemberg), which limits free float and minority-shareholder influence.

thesis.business_description: FW Thorpe plc, headquartered in Redditch, UK, designs, manufactures and supplies professional lighting systems for interior and exterior applications through operating subsidiaries including Thorlux Lighting, Philip Payne, TRT Lighting, Zemper Group and Lightronics, serving markets across the UK, Europe, Australasia and the US.
thesis.competitive_position: FW Thorpe is an established UK lighting-technology group with international subsidiaries (Thorlux Lighting GmbH, Thorlux Australasia, Thorlux Lighting LLC) that focuses on lowest total cost of ownership for clients; H1 FY2026 (to December 2025) revenue was £81.7m (down 2.4% y/y) with operating profit steady at £11.6m ([Quartr](https://quartr.com/companies/fw-thorpe-plc_16275)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Andrew Thorpe (22.2%), Ian Thorpe (21.5%), James Thorpe (1.86%) - founding Thorpe family members; individual insiders collectively own about 50.4% of the company ([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/50-ownership-fw-thorpe-plc-130217994.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders, led by the founding Thorpe family (Andrew Thorpe 22.2%, Ian Thorpe 21.5%, James Thorpe 1.86%), collectively hold about 50.4% of the company ([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/50-ownership-fw-thorpe-plc-130217994.html))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; high family/insider ownership (~50%) supports long-term alignment but also limits free float relative to fully diversified ownership structures.

name: Budapesti Ingatlan Hasznosítási és Fejlesztési Nyrt.
gmSourceUrl: [Budapest Stock Exchange BIF 2024 Annual Report](https://www.bse.hu/newkibdata/129248560/BIF%20Annual%20Report%202024%20%E2%80%93%20Annual%20Financial%20Reports%202024.pdf), [BIF official website](https://www.bif.hu)

thesis.business_description: Budapesti Ingatlan Hasznosítási és Fejlesztési Nyrt. (BIF) is a Hungarian real estate investment company (founded 1994, Budapest-based) that owns, manages and develops property — office buildings, parking garages, construction lots, residential properties and a hotel — across an 18-property Budapest portfolio, and has been a Regulated Real Estate Investment Company (SZIT/REIT) since 31 December 2018.
thesis.competitive_position: BIF earns income from renting office, retail and other commercial space, and selectively improving or selling assets; FY revenue reached Ft18.5 billion (up 38% y/y) with net income of Ft10.8 billion, 12.1% return on equity and 60.9% net margins, reflecting a profitable, concentrated Budapest-focused portfolio rather than a geographically diversified REIT.
thesis.main_shareholders: PIÓ 21 Kft (80.6%, 213,253,886 shares — the controlling private-company shareholder), Takarékbank Zrt. Asset Management (10.9%, 28,702,440 shares) ([SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/hu/real-estate-management-and-development/buse-bif/budapesti-ingatlan-hasznositasi-es-fejlesztesi-nyrt-shares/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 6.09% of the company directly; the dominant controlling entity is private company PIÓ 21 Kft at 80.6% ([SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/hu/real-estate-management-and-development/buse-bif/budapesti-ingatlan-hasznositasi-es-fejlesztesi-nyrt-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: French designer and manufacturer (founded 1986, headquartered in Toulouse) of high-value electronic onboard systems for vehicles, including diagnostic equipment, telematics, instrument panels, tachographs and vehicle communication interfaces, organized into Automotive and Telecom divisions.
thesis.competitive_position: A family-owned, mid-sized ('intermediate-sized') independent industrial group and pioneer of electronic vehicle diagnostics and multiplexed vehicle architecture; mobility products (on-board electronics for road/rail transport, freight, agriculture and construction machinery) account for 74.8% of sales, serving OEMs across automotive, rail, aeronautics, telecom and energy sectors.
thesis.main_shareholders: LP2C (reference shareholder/lead holding company of the founding families), Flottant, Gestineg H, Sidmia International, SGPFEC; the Pech and Calmels founding families collectively remain majority shareholders ([Zonebourse/Tradingsat](https://www.tradingsat.com/actia-group-FR0000076655/actionnariat.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Pech and Calmels founding families hold majority control and occupy Chairmanship and General Management positions ([ACTIA history](https://www.actia.com/en/history-and-values/))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

name: Rawlplug S.A.
gmSourceUrl: [Rawlplug S.A. Management Board Report on operations for FY 2023](https://company.rawlplug.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/RSA_Management-Board-Report-on-operations-for-FY-2023-1.pdf)

thesis.business_description: Rawlplug S.A. (formerly Koelner SA) is a Polish manufacturer and distributor of construction fixings, fasteners and tools (wall plugs, anchors, screws, adhesives, sealants) under the Rawlplug, Koelner and Modeco Expert brands, with production in Poland, Vietnam and Thailand and distribution in over 20 countries.
thesis.competitive_position: Rawlplug is an internationally active Polish fixings/fasteners manufacturer with multi-country production and a 20+ country distribution network, positioning it as a scaled regional player in construction fixing systems versus larger global fastener groups. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/RWL.WA/profile/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Amicus Poloniae Sp. z o.o. (a Koelner-family holding vehicle) holds approximately 56.19% of shares; CEO Radosław Koelner personally holds approximately 10.27%; other holders include PKO BP Bankowy PTE (~9.45%) and Nationale-Nederlanden PTE (~9.15%). [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/RAWLPLUG-S-A-6497624/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founding Koelner family controls the company through Amicus Poloniae (~56.19%) plus CEO Radosław Koelner's personal stake (~10.27%), together over 66% — very high founder/insider control; Radosław Koelner has served as President of the Management Board since 1999. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/insider/RADOSLAW-KOELNER-A0DOKF/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Romanian real estate company (formerly Arta Culinară SA, renamed Sifi Cluj Retail SA in 2014) that owns and leases commercial real estate in Cluj-Napoca, including showrooms, restaurants, event halls and fitness spaces.
thesis.competitive_position: A small-cap Romanian commercial real estate lessor; recently divested a substantial part of its portfolio (sold ~9,900 sqm of property for €11.6M, roughly half its portfolio, and separately agreed to sell its remaining properties for €24.3M), indicating a company in the process of winding down or significantly restructuring its real estate holdings.
thesis.main_shareholders: SIF Imobiliare PLC (Cyprus-registered) holds 96.3-96.4% of shares; SIF Imobiliare is itself controlled by Lion Capital (formerly SIF Banat-Crișana) ([Economedia.ro](https://economedia.ro/sifi-cluj-retail-companie-controlata-indirect-de-lion-capital-fosta-sif-banat-crisana-a-vandut-imobile-de-9-900-mp-pentru-116-mil-euro-aproape-jumatate-din-portofoliu.html); [ZF.ro](https://www.zf.ro/zf-24/sifi-cluj-retail-bucuresti-societate-controlata-sif-imobiliare-22293323))
thesis.red_flags: Company has been selling off large portions of its real estate portfolio (nearly half in one 2026 transaction, ~€11.6M; and further sale agreed for remaining properties at €24.3M), suggesting a wind-down or major strategic shift investors should note; extremely concentrated ownership (~96% by parent SIF Imobiliare) leaves minimal free float.

thesis.business_description: Danish regional bank (founded 1907, headquartered in Nakskov) providing general banking products - deposits, savings, loans, housing/car finance, leasing, pensions, insurance, investments and payment solutions - to private individuals and SMEs on the Danish islands of Lolland and Falster and in South Zealand.
thesis.competitive_position: A small regional Danish savings bank, ranked 34th-largest bank in Denmark with ~0.06% national market share (2024); ~142 employees and ~$45.3M trailing revenue, serving a local/regional niche rather than competing nationally.
thesis.main_shareholders: Sparekassen Sjælland-Fyn A/S (24.9%, 269,285 shares), AHJ A/S (10.1%, 109,200 shares); top 12 shareholders own 35.62%, with the remainder held by the general public (~64.4%) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/dk/banks/cph-lolb/lollands-bank-shares/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold a small stake, approximately 0.305% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/dk/banks/cph-lolb/lollands-bank-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Voxel S.A. is a Polish operator of a network of diagnostic-imaging centers (MRI, CT, teleradiology and nuclear medicine) based in Kraków, and through subsidiary Alteris also provides IT systems and equipment for hospitals and diagnostic centers.
thesis.competitive_position: Voxel operates one of the larger private diagnostic-imaging networks in Poland, having merged with subsidiaries Pro-Scan and Supramed Konin to consolidate its market position; its healthcare-IT arm (Alteris) diversifies revenue beyond pure imaging services ([Voxel.pl](https://voxel.pl/grupa-voxel/diagnostyka-obrazowa/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Major shareholders together hold 6,153,521 shares (58.58% of share capital) and 9,153,621 votes (67.77% of voting rights); specific individual/entity names were not confirmed in available sources ([BiznesRadar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/akcjonariat/VOXEL))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search.

thesis.business_description: Kambi Group plc is a leading B2B provider of sportsbook technology and services, offering a comprehensive platform including odds compiling, risk management, front-end interfaces, AI-driven trading, esports data, and turnkey solutions to licensed B2C gaming operators in over 60 jurisdictions. The company powers premium sports betting experiences for 50+ partners across six continents, with products like Turnkey Sportsbook, Odds Feed+, Shape Games front-end, Abios esports, and Tzeract AI trading.
thesis.competitive_position: World's leading B2B sportsbook provider with market-leading technology, proven track record powering 50+ major operators, competitive advantages in AI-driven trading, modular products (Turnkey, Odds Feed+, esports, front-end), scalability, regulatory expertise across 60+ jurisdictions, and strong partner retention/expansion.
thesis.main_shareholders: Major shareholders represented in Nomination Committee: Veralda Investment Ltd (Anders Ström linked, holds 6M+ shares), Second Swedish National Pension Fund, Kristian Nylén (750k shares), Jofam AB; significant insider ownership by board and executives.
thesis.red_flags: Dependency on regulated markets with risks from regulatory/tax changes (e.g., deposit limits in Netherlands, Colombia VAT), transition fees ending (e.g., Penn), partner churn/migration, foreign exchange volatility, contingent consideration from acquisitions (€25M+ potential); low explicit debt but c
thesis.insider_ownership: Co-founder and Chairman Anders Ström (via Veralda Investment Ltd) holds approximately 21.9%; co-founder/former CEO Kristian Nylén holds approximately 2.7%, combined founders ~24.6% ([Kambi Press Release](https://www.kambi.com/press_release/kambi-group-plc-ceo-kristian-nylen-reduces-shareholding-by-6/))

name: Caisse régionale de Crédit Agricole Mutuel d'Ille-et-Vilaine Société coopérative

thesis.business_description: French regional cooperative bank (Caisse Régionale de Crédit Agricole Mutuel d'Ille-et-Vilaine), a subsidiary of Crédit Agricole S.A. founded in 1900, offering retail banking, savings, insurance, mortgages and business financing across ~122 active branches in Ille-et-Vilaine, France.
thesis.competitive_position: One of Crédit Agricole's network of regional mutual banks; FY2024 revenue of €264.6m (+3.3%) and net income of €64.4m (+6.2%); as a mutual/cooperative bank it is not run to maximize returns to listed security (CCI) holders in the way a standalone bank would be, and its CCI certificates are non-voting.
thesis.main_shareholders: Ownership/voting control rests with the mutual local Caisses Locales (member-owners) per the Crédit Agricole regional-bank cooperative structure; the traded security (Certificats Coopératifs d'Investissement, CCI) carries no voting rights, and detailed CCI free-float holder names were not found in available sources ([Yahoo Finance/Bloomberg company profile](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/CIV.PA/profile/))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; structural note - as a mutual/cooperative bank, CCI holders (public investors) have no voting rights, which is an inherent governance characteristic rather than a disclosed red flag.

thesis.business_description: Telekom Slovenije, d.d. is Slovenia's incumbent telecommunications operator (headquartered in Ljubljana), providing fixed and mobile communications (under the Mobitel and SiOL brands), system integration, cloud computing, digital content and multimedia services to households and businesses, with operations extending into Kosovo, North Macedonia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Montenegro and Gibraltar.
thesis.competitive_position: As Slovenia's largest telecom operator, Telekom Slovenije benefits from an incumbent's scale in fixed and mobile connectivity; recent results showed sales revenue up 4% y/y to €366.9 million, EBITDA up 7% to €134.3 million (36.6% margin), and net profit up 6% to €31.5 million, reflecting steady recurring-revenue performance ([Telekom Slovenije business report](https://seonet.ljse.si/file.aspx?AttachmentID=56277)).
thesis.main_shareholders: The Republic of Slovenia is the controlling shareholder, holding 62.54% directly, plus a further 5.59% via Kapitalska družba (KAD) and 4.25% via Slovenia Sovereign Holding (SDH) — together approximately 72.38% state ownership; domestic investors overall hold 93.5% of the company ([MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/TELEKOM-SLOVENIJE-D-D-186258874/company-shareholders/))
thesis.red_flags: The company faced a legal claim from a market operator/competitor in Slovenia per 2026 news coverage ([ad-hoc-news](https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/ueberblick/telekom-slovenije-d-d-stock-sitks0000008-telecom-operator-faces-legal/69294072)), and the Slovenian government has explored selling down its majority stake, which could affect the ownership/control structure going forward ([Developing Telecoms](https://developingtelecoms.com/telecom-business/operator-news/12704-slovenia-exploring-sale-of-telekom-slovenije-stake.html)). As a majority state-owned enterprise, governance and strategic decisions may also be subject to political influence.

thesis.business_description: German provider (headquartered in Kölleda, Thuringia) of communication, information and security systems for the transport sector, spanning train radio/communication systems, visual and acoustic passenger information systems, and security/video management for train stations and public transport infrastructure.
thesis.competitive_position: A niche German supplier of railway telematics and passenger-information/security systems (~452 employees, ~$185M trailing revenue), targeting rail operators, public transport authorities and infrastructure operators rather than competing as a broad-based electronics conglomerate.
thesis.main_shareholders: Specific major shareholders and percentages were not confirmed in available sources; consult company disclosures for current ownership detail.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Italian engineering and digital services company (founded 1964, headquartered in Gallarate) operating four business units: Technical Authoring and Publishing (technical documentation for aeronautical, automotive and railway industries), Creative (integrated media solutions), Engineering (aeronautical/medical systems design) and Consulting, including Integrated Logistic Support (ILS) services.
