thesis.competitive_position: A specialized Italian technical-documentation and engineering services provider (~€52.32M revenue in 2024, up 8.53%) serving aerospace, automotive and railway OEMs; niche B2B services player rather than a broad-based IT consultancy.
thesis.main_shareholders: G&D S.R.L. is the controlling/majority shareholder; Sofia Holding reduced its stake to below 5% as of 2025 ([Reuters/TradingView](https://in.tradingview.com/news/reuters.com%2C2025%3Anewsml_FWN3TZ264%3A0-technical-publications-service-shareholders-sofia-holding-cuts-stake-under-5))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: EXEL Industries is a France-based, family-controlled industrial group making agricultural and industrial spraying equipment, sugar beet harvesters, and garden & leisure equipment, headquartered in Epernay.
thesis.competitive_position: EXEL is a global leader in spraying technology for agriculture and industry, with a diversified multi-brand portfolio (crop protection, specialty harvesting, leisure/watering equipment) built through decades of family-led organic growth and acquisitions; its scale and niche technical focus give it a defensible position versus larger, more generalist agricultural-equipment makers.
thesis.main_shareholders: EXEL SAS (holding company owned exclusively by the Ballu family, chaired by Patrick Ballu) ~84% ([Substack - family-controlled analysis](https://dismissedandassetbacked.substack.com/p/exel-industries-exe-a-family-controlled))
thesis.insider_ownership: ~84% held by the Ballu family through EXEL SAS, the controlling holding company since the company's founding in 1952
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; very high family/insider concentration (~84%) limits free float and means minority shareholders have little influence over governance decisions.

thesis.business_description: Grand Harbour Marina p.l.c. acquires, develops, operates and manages marinas for yachts and superyachts, owning and operating the Grand Harbour Marina in Birgu, Malta, and holding a 45% interest in IC Cesme Marina in Türkiye (the remaining 55% held by Turkish group Ibrahim Cecen Investment Holding AS).
thesis.competitive_position: Grand Harbour Marina serves as a Mediterranean hub for nautical events (including the Rolex Middle Sea Race) and offers berthing, provisioning, concierge and refit/maintenance services; it is operated and managed in association with Camper & Nicholsons Marinas Limited (CNML), part of the global Camper & Nicholsons marina network, which lends brand/operating expertise ([CN Marinas company structure](https://en.cnmarinas.com/grand-harbour-marina/company-structure/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Camper & Nicholsons Marina Investments Limited (CNMI) holds 79.2% of issued share capital ([MarketScreener / CN Marinas company structure](https://en.cnmarinas.com/grand-harbour-marina/company-structure/))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Medistim ASA is a Norwegian medical device company developing, manufacturing and distributing intraoperative ultrasound imaging and Transit Time Flow Measurement (TTFM) systems used by surgeons for real-time quality control during cardiac, vascular and transplant surgery.
thesis.competitive_position: Medistim holds a specialized global niche in intraoperative quality-control verification for cardiac/vascular surgery via its flagship MiraQ and VeriQ C systems, with subsidiaries in the US, Japan and other regions; the company's technical focus on TTFM/ultrasound quality verification differentiates it from broader surgical imaging players.
thesis.main_shareholders: Øyvin Anders Brøymer (~12.27%), Aeternum Management AS (~5.97%), Follum Invest AS (~5.29%) ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/MEDISTIM-ASA-1413200/company/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Not separately disclosed as an aggregate officer/director figure in sources found; largest individual shareholder (Brøymer) holds ~12.27%. The 20 largest shareholders together own 74.8% of the ~1,061 registered shareholders as of 31 Dec 2024.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; company reported strong Q3 2025 growth (sales +25.7%, EBIT +27.1%) with no disclosed governance or accounting concerns.

thesis.business_description: Bulgarian industrial repair enterprise (founded 1974, headquartered in Kozloduy) specializing in maintenance, repair and modernization of equipment for the Kozloduy Nuclear Power Plant, as well as turbine, electrical and auxiliary equipment repair, transformer diagnostics and custom equipment manufacturing for thermal power plants and other industrial facilities.
thesis.competitive_position: Bulgaria's dominant nuclear/power-plant maintenance contractor, with repair work at Kozloduy NPP (the country's only nuclear plant) generating ~85% of revenue; 2023 net profit more than doubled to BGN 36.1M on revenue up 32% to BGN 86.6M, reflecting high customer concentration but strong recent growth.
thesis.main_shareholders: Bultrade Corporation EOOD (55.2%), Pension Insurance Company Toplina AD (9.65%), Pensionno Osiguritelno Druzhestvo Budeshte AD (8.62%), JSIC OZK-Insurance AD (8.51%), Pension Insurance Company Saglasie AD (3.85%); top 5 shareholders own 85.83% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/bg/commercial-services/bul-atom/atomenergoremont-ad-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: High customer concentration - approximately 85% of revenue from a single customer (Kozloduy NPP); no governance or litigation issues identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: GrønlandsBANKEN A/S, founded in 1967 and headquartered in Nuuk, is the principal retail and commercial bank in Greenland, providing housing/mortgage loans, personal and vehicle loans, savings, insurance, investment services and business banking/advisory services to private customers, businesses and public institutions across Greenland.
thesis.competitive_position: GrønlandsBANKEN holds a dominant position as effectively the leading bank serving the small, geographically isolated Greenlandic market, with deep local relationships (business consulting for fishing, tourism, construction and other Greenland-specific sectors) that would be difficult for outside banks to replicate ([GrønlandsBANKEN](https://www.banken.gl/da/om-os/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: More than 2,500 shareholders, predominantly local Greenlandic customers, individuals and companies with a connection to Greenland; no single controlling shareholder was identified in this search ([GrønlandsBANKEN](https://www.banken.gl/da/om-os/aktionaer-i-groenlandsbanken/))
thesis.red_flags: Concentration risk from operating almost entirely within a single small, remote economy (Greenland) heavily tied to fishing and public-sector activity. No governance red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Bulgarian diversified holding company (Doverie United Holding AD, successor to the Doverie United Bulgarian Privatization Fund established 1996) that acquires, manages and sells shares/interests in ~50 companies across six industrial sectors (medical equipment, construction materials, textiles, services, trade) in 15 Bulgarian and European cities.
thesis.competitive_position: One of the largest diversified holding companies in Bulgaria by portfolio breadth; ranked third among 'Capital' magazine's most promising Bulgarian Stock Exchange investments for 2026, though as a holding company its performance is a composite of its diverse underlying operating businesses rather than a single competitive position.
thesis.main_shareholders: Sopharma AD (22.7%, 4,858,067 shares - main shareholder since 2007-2008), Telecomplect AD (8.94%), Kaliman-RT AD (8.34%) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/bg/diversified-financials/bul-duh/doverie-united-holding-ad-shares/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold a minimal stake, approximately 0.141% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/bg/diversified-financials/bul-duh/doverie-united-holding-ad-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; as a diversified holding company, risk is a composite of its ~50 portfolio companies across multiple sectors.

thesis.business_description: International Personal Finance plc is a Leeds, UK-headquartered international consumer credit group providing home credit, digital installment loans, credit cards and mobile wallet products across Europe and Mexico under brands including Provident, Creditea and Credit24.
thesis.competitive_position: IPF operates across three divisions (European home credit, Mexico home credit, IPF Digital) with about 5,842 employees, giving it geographic diversification versus single-market consumer lenders; it competes with other specialist non-bank consumer lenders in emerging European and Mexican markets ([Quartr](https://quartr.com/companies/international-personal-finance-plc_19691)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Schroder Investment Management (12.8%), Aberforth Partners LLP (12.4%), J O Hambro Capital Management (6.59%); institutions hold 73% overall, general public about 19% ([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/73-ownership-shares-international-personal-070619349.html))
thesis.red_flags: As a home-credit/consumer lender operating in emerging markets (including historically Poland, and currently Mexico and other European markets), IPF is exposed to consumer-credit regulatory risk and currency/political risk in its operating countries; no specific recent controversy was confirmed in this search.

thesis.business_description: Moulinvest S.A. (founded 1916) is a French integrated timber-industry group performing wood sawing, drying and planing, manufacturing sawn/planed timber, nailed panels and treated outdoor wood (garden furniture and landscaping products under the DECOVERT brand), and impregnating wood poles for electrification/telecom markets, plus biomass-based heating pellets and cogeneration electricity.
thesis.competitive_position: Through subsidiaries Scierie Moulin, Moulin Bois Energie, France Bois Imprégnés and Scierie de Sainte Agathe, the group generated €100.8 million in sales in FY2022-23, with France representing 80.9% of net sales and smaller shares in Europe (13.4%), Africa (5.2%) and Asia (0.5%); it holds recognized expertise in autoclave wood impregnation, positioning it as a benchmark player for treated wood poles.
thesis.main_shareholders: The Moulin family holds 68.45% of Moulinvest; other shareholders hold 28.47%; treasury shares (autodétention) account for 1.56% ([Yahoo Finance / BFM Bourse ownership](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/type-shareholder-owns-moulinvest-sas-082936735.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Family-controlled at 68.45% via the Moulin family, with CEO Maurice Moulin and other family members in key management positions ([BFM Bourse actionnariat](https://www.tradingsat.com/moulinvest-FR0011033083/actionnariat.html))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Multitude AG (formerly Ferratum, headquartered in Zug, Switzerland) is a European FinTech group providing digital consumer lending (Ferratum), SME lending (CapitalBox) and wholesale/banking-as-a-service banking (Multitude Bank) to customers often overlooked by traditional banks, serving over 400,000 customers across 17 European countries.
thesis.competitive_position: Multitude positions itself as a diversified digital-lending/banking-as-a-service group spanning consumer, SME and wholesale banking units built on an internal BaaS growth platform, differentiating it from single-product consumer-lending peers. [Multitude Annual Report 2024](https://www.multitude.com/~/media/Files/M/Multitude/reports-and-presentations/2024/multitude-group-annual-report-2024-v1.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder Jorma Olavi Jokela is the controlling shareholder with approximately 55.4% of shares; FundSight SA holds approximately 5.2%, and the company itself holds approximately 1.4% in treasury shares. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/MULTITUDE-AG-20568917/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder and controlling shareholder Jorma Olavi Jokela holds approximately 55.4% of the company, representing majority founder/insider control. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/MULTITUDE-AG-20568917/company/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; majority founder control (>55%) limits minority shareholder influence.

thesis.business_description: Atlantic Grupa d.d. is a Zagreb-headquartered multinational FMCG company (founded 1991) producing and distributing nutritional/functional foods (brands Multipower, Cedevita) and health, beauty-care and pharmaceutical products (Dietpharm, vitamins, cosmetics, OTC medicines), and operating a private pharmacy chain in Croatia, with sales across the Balkans, Russia and Western Europe.
thesis.competitive_position: Atlantic Grupa is a leading producer of food and personal-care products and a leading distributor of consumer goods in South-Eastern Europe, with Croatia (~34%), Serbia (~26.4%) and Slovenia (~15.6%) as its largest markets. [EMIS company profile](https://www.emis.com/php/company-profile/HR/Atlantic_Grupa_dd_en_1571318.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: As of December 31, 2023, EMyberg d.o.o. (the holding vehicle linked to founder Emil Tedeschi) held approximately 50.2%, Lada Tedeschi Fiorio approximately 5.8%, and pension funds collectively approximately 35.3%. [Wikipedia/company data aggregation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atlantic_Grupa)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder Emil Tedeschi controls the company through EMyberg d.o.o. (~50.2%), with family member Lada Tedeschi Fiorio holding a further ~5.8%, together representing majority founder-family control (~56%). [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atlantic_Grupa)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Kallebäck Property Invest AB (publ) is a Swedish single-asset real estate company that owns, manages and leases the Kallebäck 17:2 property in Gothenburg, comprising modern office, laboratory and production space, fully leased to Saab AB through December 31, 2031.
thesis.competitive_position: Kallebäck Property Invest is a niche, single-tenant/single-asset property vehicle whose value proposition rests almost entirely on the long-term Saab AB lease rather than diversified real-estate operations. [Company description/prospectus](https://l.cdn.bequoted.com/1/company-description-26821/kallebackpropertyinvest_prospekt_140321.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Saab Pensionsstiftelse (Saab's pension foundation) holds approximately 26.58%, Global Challenges Foundation approximately 11.8%, Östersjöstiftelsen approximately 4.6%, and board members Lennart Richard Låftman (~3.0%) and Lars Johan Thorell (~2.1%, also Board Chairman). [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/KALLEBACK-PROPERTY-INVEST-26785355/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Board Chairman Lars Johan Thorell (since 2013) holds approximately 2.1% and director Lennart Richard Låftman holds approximately 3.0%; combined board insider ownership is modest (roughly 5%). [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/KALLEBACK-PROPERTY-INVEST-26785355/company/)
thesis.red_flags: Single-tenant concentration risk: essentially all rental income depends on one lease to Saab AB running to 2031; this is a structural concentration risk rather than a governance red flag. No governance disputes or accounting issues were identified. [Company description](https://l.cdn.bequoted.com/1/company-description-26821/kallebackpropertyinvest_prospekt_140321.pdf)

thesis.business_description: Socfinasia S.A., incorporated in 1972 and based in Luxembourg, manages a portfolio of roughly 52,700 hectares of tropical oil palm and rubber plantations in Southeast Asia (including Cambodia and Indonesia) as part of the broader Socfin Group.
thesis.competitive_position: Socfinasia is the Southeast Asian plantation arm of the internationally diversified Socfin Group, giving it scale in regional palm oil/rubber production, though the Socfin Group overall has faced sustained reputational pressure over land-rights practices at its plantations. [SOCFIN Group - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SOCFIN_Group)
thesis.main_shareholders: Socfin (Luxembourg) holds approximately 57.79% of Socfinasia; Bolloré Group holds approximately 17.1% directly (total Bolloré participations, direct and indirect, approximately 22.26%). The broader Socfin Group is majority-owned by the Bolloré Group of France and the Hubert Fabri family of Luxembourg. [Socfinasia 2025 Annual Report](https://socfin.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/2025-Socfinasia-Annual-report-1.pdf)
thesis.insider_ownership: The Fabri family (via Socfin, François Fabri and Philippe Fabri serving as Executive Non-Independent Directors) and the Bolloré family/Group together control the large majority of shares, representing very high founder/insider-family concentration. [Socfinasia 2025 Annual Report](https://socfin.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/2025-Socfinasia-Annual-report-1.pdf)
thesis.red_flags: The parent Socfin Group (and by extension its plantation subsidiaries, which Socfinasia's Southeast Asian plantations are part of) has faced extensive, well-documented allegations of land-rights violations, inadequate community consultation and human-rights abuses at plantations in Cambodia, Sierra Leone, Cameroon and Liberia, including a 2023 third-party (Earthworm Foundation) investigation that found issues including gender-based violence and environmental degradation at some sites. [Mongabay](https://news.mongabay.com/2023/06/communities-accuse-socfin-and-earthworm-foundation-of-greenwash-in-west-africa/)

thesis.business_description: AB Rokiškio sūris is a Lithuanian dairy producer manufacturing fermented and semi-hard/hard cheese plus a broad range of milk products (butter, cream, sour cream, yogurt, curds), and is the largest cheese producer in the Baltic states.
thesis.competitive_position: Rokiškio sūris is one of the largest dairy companies in Lithuania and the largest cheese producer in the Baltics, with international backing from New Zealand's Fonterra Co-operative Group, which took a 10% stake in the company. [dairyreporter.com](https://www.dairyreporter.com/Article/2017/11/07/Fonterra-buys-10-share-of-Lithuania-s-Rokiskio-Suris/)
thesis.main_shareholders: As of a 2011 disclosure, Pieno pramonės investicijų valdymas UAB held approximately 38.86% as the largest shareholder; Fonterra Co-operative Group (New Zealand) holds approximately 10%. More recent precise percentages were not found in sources reviewed. [dairyreporter.com](https://www.dairyreporter.com/Article/2017/11/07/Fonterra-buys-10-share-of-Lithuania-s-Rokiskio-Suris/)
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO is Dalius Trumpa; specific personal/management shareholding percentage was not found in public sources reviewed. Not disclosed in public filings reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Renta 4 Banco, S.A. is a Madrid-based Spanish financial institution providing brokerage services (securities trading, funds and pension plans), asset management (collective investment institutions, pension funds, private wealth), and corporate services (custody, corporate advisory, public debt management, issue underwriting) through a nationwide branch network.
thesis.competitive_position: Renta 4 is a well-established independent Spanish investment bank/broker with roughly 608 employees and multiple regulated subsidiaries (Renta 4 Sociedad de Valores, Renta 4 Pensiones); it reported net profit growth of 40.6% to EUR42.6m in 2025, reflecting a niche but profitable position versus much larger universal banks in Spanish wealth/brokerage services ([Quartr](https://quartr.com/companies/renta-4-banco-s-a_16673)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Juan Carlos Ureta Domingo, founder and chairman (44.67%), Mutualidad General de Previsión Social de la Abogacía (6.88%), Indumenta Pueri S.L. (5.23%), María Beatriz López Perea (5.00%), Santiago González Enciso (4.41%) ([Rankia](https://www.rankia.com/foros/bolsa/temas/3812435-quienes-son-accionistas-mayoritarios-empresas-mercado-continuo))
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder and Chairman Juan Carlos Ureta Domingo holds 44.67% of the bank, making it a founder-controlled company ([Rankia](https://www.rankia.com/foros/bolsa/temas/3812435-quienes-son-accionistas-mayoritarios-empresas-mercado-continuo))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; concentrated founder control (44.67%) limits minority-shareholder influence over strategy but was not flagged as a governance controversy.

thesis.business_description: Flekkefjord Sparebank is a Norwegian savings bank offering deposit accounts, personal and business loans, mortgages, insurance and investment services to individuals and businesses in the Rogaland and Agder regions of southern Norway, headquartered in Flekkefjord.
thesis.competitive_position: One of Norway's oldest savings banks (founded 1837, the first savings bank between Stavanger and Kristiansand), it is a small regional player operating through 5 local branch offices; it listed on Euronext Growth Oslo in May 2024, raising NOK 163 million from about 1,300 new shareholders ([Euronext press release](https://www.euronext.com/en/about/media/euronext-press-releases/flekkefjord-sparebank-lists-euronext-growth-oslo)).
thesis.main_shareholders: As a self-owned Norwegian savings bank ('sparebank'), Flekkefjord Sparebank's core capital is technically ownerless; publicly traded equity certificates (egenkapitalbevis) were issued in the 2024 listing, but specific named owners were not found in sources reviewed ([Flekkefjord Sparebank egenkapitalbevis](https://flekkefjordsparebank.no/om-oss/bankens-investorinformasjon/egenkapitalbevis/))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed; note that under Norwegian savings-bank rules any single investor stake above 10% of equity capital requires approval from the Financial Supervisory Authority (Finanstilsynet), reflecting the sector's diffuse-ownership structure rather than a company-specific concern.

thesis.business_description: Belgian shipping group (Antwerp-headquartered, IPO 2003, spun off from CMB NV) that designs, builds, owns and operates specialized vessels and floating infrastructure for transporting and processing liquefied gas (LNG/LPG), organized into Shipping, Infrastructure and Supporting Services segments.
thesis.competitive_position: A specialized niche player in LNG/LPG shipping and floating gas infrastructure (LNG production, storage, regasification units) with ~1,849 employees; most revenue comes from the Shipping segment, competing in a specialized gas-carrier market against larger diversified shipping groups.
thesis.main_shareholders: Saverex NV (controlled ~98.12% by Nicolas Saverys) is the reference shareholder; Saverex and Nicolas Saverys together held 91.10% of voting rights as of 5 May 2025 (54,203,796 shares) ([TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/exmar-nv-transparency-notification-saverex-nv-exceeds-85-shareholding); [Exmar IR](https://exmar.com/en/investors/shareholding/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Saverys family controls approximately 91.10% of voting rights via Saverex NV, an extremely high concentration leaving a very small free float ([Exmar IR](https://exmar.com/en/investors/shareholding/))
thesis.red_flags: Very low free float (under 10%) following the Saverys family's stake increase above 90% in 2025, raising potential minority-shareholder liquidity and squeeze-out/delisting risk; no other governance issues identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: CellaVision AB is a Swedish medical technology company that develops and sells digital solutions for medical microscopy, enabling automated blood cell analysis and morphology diagnosis in hematology, replacing conventional manual microscopy.
thesis.competitive_position: CellaVision is a specialist/pure-play leader in digital hematology microscopy, but is heavily dependent on distribution partner Sysmex, which reportedly sells the large majority of CellaVision's installed base and itself holds a dominant (~80%+) position in the broader hematology instruments market; competitors Beckman Coulter and newer entrant Scopio are pushing into digital morphology, creating some competitive and channel-concentration risk.
thesis.main_shareholders: William Demant Fonden (~19.93%), Grenlunden AB (~10.02%), Christer Fåhraeus (~8.86%) ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/CELLAVISION-AB-6498975/company/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed as a single aggregate figure in sources found; founder-linked holder Christer Fåhraeus individually holds ~8.86%
thesis.red_flags: Heavy reliance on distribution partner Sysmex (reported ~85% of CellaVision unit sales historically routed through Sysmex) creates channel concentration risk; rising competitive pressure from Beckman Coulter/Scopio in digital morphology. ([inPractise](https://inpractise.com/articles/cellavision-sysmex-partnership-dc-1-instrument-and-reagents-potential))

thesis.business_description: Byggma ASA is a Norwegian manufacturer and supplier of building materials for the Nordic market, organized into four business areas: Panels (Huntonit), Beams (Masonite Beams), Windows (Uldal) and Lighting (Aneta Lighting).
thesis.competitive_position: Byggma is a diversified Nordic building-materials group with multiple manufacturing subsidiaries spanning panels, engineered wood beams, windows/doors and lighting, giving it product diversification versus single-category building-material peers ([Byggma](https://www.byggma.com/investor/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: CEO Geir Drangsland and personal associates control approximately 88.70% of shares ([Proff.no shareholder data](https://www.proff.no/aksjon%C3%A6rer/bedrift/byggma-asa/979165285))
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Geir Drangsland and associates hold approximately 88.70% of shares, making Byggma an insider/founder-controlled company with a very small free float ([Proff.no](https://www.proff.no/aksjon%C3%A6rer/bedrift/byggma-asa/979165285))
thesis.red_flags: Very high insider/controlling-shareholder concentration (~88.7% held by CEO and associates) leaves a thin free float and limited minority-shareholder influence and liquidity. No other governance red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Sofia Commerce-Pawn Brokerage AD is a Bulgarian pawnbroking company operating a chain of roughly 160 pawn shops, providing cash loans secured against pledged movable property (jewelry, electronics, appliances, vehicles) and dealing in precious metals, gemstones and related products.
thesis.competitive_position: The company is one of the larger organized pawnbroking chains in Bulgaria by store count (~160 locations), operating in a fragmented, largely informal Bulgarian pawn-lending market. [SeeNews](https://seenews.com/companies/sofia-commerce-pawn-brokerage-ad-5732)
thesis.main_shareholders: Public search results did not reveal a clearly identified controlling shareholder; one minor institutional holding found was SKY Asset Management AD (~0.22%). No link to Eurohold Bulgaria/Starcom Holding was confirmed. Not disclosed/findable in sources reviewed.
thesis.insider_ownership: Board leadership includes CEO Petar Videnov and Chairman Irena Ivanova (since October 2023), and director Vihren Vassilev (since August 2021); specific personal shareholding percentages for these individuals were not found. Not disclosed in public filings reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: IVU Traffic Technologies AG, based in Berlin, develops and markets IT software (the IVU.suite) for public passenger transport, rail and transport logistics, covering planning, scheduling, operations, ticketing, passenger information and quality assurance.
thesis.competitive_position: IVU is a specialist European public-transport software vendor with about 779 employees; H1 2026 EBIT rose to EUR3.3m (from EUR1.0m in H1 2025), reflecting improving profitability in its niche transit-planning software market ([IVU](https://www.ivu.com/investors)).
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; detailed shareholder percentage disclosure was not found in available sources for this search.

thesis.business_description: Passat Société Anonyme is a French company engaged in image-assisted (TV/demonstration) sale of consumer products — household, kitchen, DIY, garden, beauty and leisure/fitness items — headquartered in Fourqueux, France.
thesis.competitive_position: A small-cap direct-response retailer (market cap ~€17.6 million as of April 2025, ~$68.7 million trailing revenue) with no analyst coverage, operating in a niche of demonstration-sales/infomercial-style consumer products rather than traditional retail ([Investing.com company profile](https://www.investing.com/equities/passat-company-profile)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Robin Broszio (24%), Kristin Broszio (22.8%), Kirsten Broszio (20.8%), Borries Broszio (6.19%), Ofi Invest Asset Management (4.91%) ([SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fr/retail/epa-alpas/passat-societe-anonyme-shares/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders (the Broszio family) hold approximately 73.8% of the company in aggregate ([SimplyWall.st ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fr/retail/epa-alpas/passat-societe-anonyme-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed; note the company has no sell-side analyst coverage, consistent with its small size and thin trading liquidity.

thesis.business_description: NRJ Group SA is a leading French private media group operating national and local radio/audio brands (NRJ, Chérie FM, Nostalgie, Rire & Chansons), plus a digital ecosystem of streaming, topical digital radio stations and podcasts, and licensing/partnership operations for the NRJ and Nostalgie brands in 13 other countries.
thesis.competitive_position: NRJ Group describes itself as a leader in the French private radio/audio market with four complementary national brands and the leading internationally licensed radio brand (NRJ); it also holds a notably large net cash position relative to its market capitalization, a point highlighted by equity analysts. [Décision Bourse](https://www.decisionbourse.fr/analyses-valeurs/2026/04/13/nrj-group-une-position-de-cash-exceptionnelle/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder Jean-Paul Baudecroux and his children collectively hold approximately 80.23% of capital (86.74% of voting rights); Jean-Paul Baudecroux personally holds approximately 67.09% of capital, with children Matilda and Paul Baudecroux each crossing 4.80% of capital after an October 2025 donation-transfer. [Zonebourse](https://www.zonebourse.com/cours/action/NRJ-GROUP-4678/societe-actionnaires/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder/Chairman-CEO Jean-Paul Baudecroux and family together hold roughly 80% of the capital and nearly 87% of voting rights, representing very high founder-family control. [Zonebourse](https://www.zonebourse.com/cours/action/NRJ-GROUP-4678/societe-actionnaires/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: PageGroup plc is a UK-headquartered specialist recruitment consultancy operating globally through brands including Michael Page, Page Executive, Page Personnel and Page Outsourcing, across EMEA, Asia Pacific, Americas and UK segments.
thesis.competitive_position: PageGroup is known for organic growth (rather than acquisition-led expansion) and a focus on professional, white-collar recruitment; the Michael Page and Page Executive brand names provide a recognized "trust halo" with corporate clients, but the business is highly cyclical and competes against Hays, SThree, Robert Walters, Adecco and Randstad in a currently weak hiring market.
thesis.main_shareholders: Brandes Investment Partners LP (~5.12%), Liontrust Investment Partners LLP (~4.99%), GLG Partners LP (~4.99%); free float ~94.6%, institutional ownership ~99.27% ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/PAGEGROUP-PLC-9590167/company-shareholders/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Very low; institutional ownership is ~99.27% of shares, implying minimal direct officer/director holdings as a group
thesis.red_flags: Company has issued multiple profit warnings amid a prolonged hiring slowdown: FY2025 operating profit fell from £52.4m to £20.9m (gross profit down 7.6% in constant currency), with France down 17% and Germany down 23% in Q4; shares fell 16.9% on the FY2025 results announcement, and net cash dropped £63.9m to £31.4m. ([Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/company-news/pagegroup-fy-2025-slides-profit-plunges-60-amid-conversion-challenges-93CH-4543101))

thesis.business_description: Eckert & Ziegler SE is a German isotope technology specialist, operating via two segments: Isotope Products (radiation sources, calibration sources, blood irradiators, industrial/medical isotopes) and Medical (contract development/manufacturing of radiopharmaceuticals, including lutetium-177 and gallium-68 based cancer diagnostics and therapeutics). [Company profile](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/EUZ.DE/profile/)
thesis.competitive_position: Eckert & Ziegler is widely described as a niche leader and the main independent CDMO 'pick-and-shovel' supplier to the fast-growing radiopharmaceutical/nuclear medicine industry, supplying isotopes and radiation components used by many pharma partners rather than competing directly in drug development itself. [Niche player in the radioisotope market](https://millet0775.substack.com/p/eckert-and-ziegler-se-niche-player), [The Pick-and-Shovel Supplier of the Radiopharma Boom](https://investresearch.substack.com/p/eckert-and-ziegler-the-pick-and-shovel)
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder Dr. Andreas Eckert holds approximately 31.16% (19,790,040 shares); Norges Bank Investment Management holds about 3.44%; JP Morgan Asset Management holds approximately 3.04%. Ownership breakdown: VC/PE firms ~31.6%, general public ~38.4%, institutions ~27.1%, state/government ~2.9%. [MarketScreener shareholder data](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ECKERT-ZIEGLER-SE-436039/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder and Chairman of the Supervisory Board Dr. Andreas Eckert personally owns roughly 31% of the company, giving him significant influence over governance and strategy. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ECKERT-ZIEGLER-SE-436039/company-shareholders/)
thesis.red_flags: No major accounting scandal, lawsuit, or governance controversy was identified in public sources searched; the company reported being affected by a cyber attack per some coverage, but no financial fraud or dilution issues were found. [Governance report](https://www.ezag.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Erklaerung-zur-Unternehmensfuehrung-und-Corporate-Governance-Bericht_2024_engl.pdf)

thesis.business_description: Rederiaktiebolaget Gotland is a Sweden-based shipping investment company, founded in 1865 and headquartered in Visby, that invests in and operates vessels in the ferry, roll-on/roll-off (RoRo) and product tanker segments.
thesis.competitive_position: A long-established, family-influenced Swedish shipowner operating in niche ferry/RoRo/tanker segments rather than a major global shipping line; its dual-class share structure concentrates voting control. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/REDERIAKTIEBOLAGET-GOTLAN-147914228/company-shareholders/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Svenska Stålbyggen Invest AB holds approximately 23.71%, the Nilsson Jan-Eric family holds approximately 16.03% of capital (but a dominant 78.52% of higher-vote Class A/B shares per one source), and Lars Johan Thorell holds approximately 15.42%. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/REDERIAKTIEBOLAGET-GOTLAN-147914228/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: The Nilsson Jan-Eric family is reported to hold a dominant stake (approx. 16% of total capital and a majority of the higher-voting share class), indicating substantial family/insider control through the dual-class structure. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/REDERIAKTIEBOLAGET-GOTLAN-147914228/company-shareholders/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Production and distribution of technical, medical, and specialty gases (oxygen, nitrogen, argon, CO2, hydrogen, helium, etc.) and related equipment like cutting/welding hardware. Operates in Serbia and regional subsidiaries in Balkans.
thesis.competitive_position: Leading regional player in Balkans industrial/medical gases market, with production sites across Serbia and subsidiaries in neighboring countries. Strong customer base but concentrated (2 clients 27% sales).
thesis.main_shareholders: Messer SE & Co. KGaA (Germany): 81.94% (849,396 shares); Minority shareholders: 18.06%.
thesis.red_flags: Customer concentration risk (2 major clients 27% revenue); high receivables with impairments (RSD 2.5B provisioned); FX exposure to EUR; minor litigation provisions (RSD 98M). Clean audit opinion overall.
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 1.48% of shares; parent company Messer Industrie GmbH holds 85.9%, consistent with main shareholders on file ([Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/rs/materials/belex-tgas/messer-tehnogas-ad-shares/ownership))

thesis.business_description: Close Brothers Group plc is a UK merchant banking group providing specialist lending (commercial, retail and property finance), deposit taking, asset management and securities trading, deliberately avoiding mass-market high-street retail banking in favor of niche, higher-margin SME and specialist lending.
thesis.competitive_position: Close Brothers differentiates from larger UK banks (Barclays, HSBC) by focusing on tailored, specialist lending (asset finance, invoice discounting, property lending) to SMEs that bigger banks often overlook; it has been shrinking its footprint via recent divestitures (Winterflood Securities sold to Marex for £104m in 2025, plus an asset management sale) and workforce cuts (~600 roles, ~20% of headcount) to preserve capital ahead of motor finance redress costs.
thesis.main_shareholders: FIL Limited (~10.02%), abrdn plc (~8.44%), Jupiter Fund Management PLC (~5.59%), Royal London Asset Management (~4.88%), M&G plc (~4.85%); institutional shareholders collectively own ~88% ([MarketScreener](https://uk.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/CLOSE-BROTHERS-GROUP-PLC-9590157/company-shareholders/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed as a separate aggregate figure; ownership is overwhelmingly institutional (~88%), implying low direct officer/director ownership
thesis.red_flags: Known ongoing motor finance commission scandal: the group swung to a full-year loss of £122.4m after booking a £165m redress provision (cumulative provisions around £300-320m), and has been divesting businesses (Winterflood, asset management) and cutting ~600 jobs to shore up capital; a short seller (Viceroy) has separately warned of balance-sheet risk. ([CityAM](https://www.cityam.com/close-brothers-takes-swing-at-fca-after-near-doubling-motor-finance-provisions/), [Hargreaves Lansdown](https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/stock-market-news/company--news/archive/close-brothers-tumbles-as-short-seller-viceroy-warns-of-potential-wipeout))

thesis.business_description: Eleco plc is a UK-based (AIM-listed) international software and services provider for the built environment, offering construction technology (Contech) and property technology (Proptech) software spanning planning, design, BIM, construction, fit-out, facilities management and asset management, under brands Elecosoft, BestOutcome, Vertical Digital and Veeuze.
thesis.competitive_position: Eleco positions itself as a well-established, best-of-breed software provider for the building lifecycle, with centres of excellence across the UK, Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Romania and the USA rather than competing as a single-geography point-solution vendor. [Eleco plc Annual Report 2024](https://eleco.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/5621_Eleco-plc-Annual-Report-2024_Hyperlink.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Herbert Allen is the largest shareholder with approximately 14.12%, followed by Raymond James Wealth Management (~6.06%), Jupiter Asset Management (~5.0%) and Tikvah Management LLC (~4.64%). [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ELECO-PLC-4001902/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Largest shareholder Herbert Allen (~14.12%) is reported as a significant individual investor; no separate board/executive management ownership percentage was found distinct from this holding. Not disclosed in public filings reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Alfa Financial Software Holdings PLC, based in London, provides Alfa Systems, a software platform for asset/equipment and automotive finance companies covering point-of-sale, originations, contract management and remarketing, plus Alfa Digital, an omnichannel digital origination and servicing suite, sold via license, implementation and recurring subscription/cloud fees.
thesis.competitive_position: Alfa is a specialist software vendor focused narrowly on the asset-finance/equipment-leasing software niche, serving customers across the UK, US and Europe; it received a GBP614m take-private buyout offer from EQT, indicating private-equity recognition of its niche market position ([Finance Director Europe](https://www.financedirectoreurope.com/news/uk-based-alfa-financial-software-receives-614m-buyout-offer-eqt/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: CHP Software and Consulting Limited, controlled by Alfa's chairman and founder Andrew Page, holds 161,454,782 shares (54.4%) ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ALFA-FINANCIAL-SOFTWARE-H-35043565/news/Alfa-Financial-majority-owner-CHP-Software-to-sell-GBP25-million-stake-46866665/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder and Chairman Andrew Page controls a majority stake (54.4%) via CHP Software and Consulting Limited ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ALFA-FINANCIAL-SOFTWARE-H-35043565/news/Alfa-Financial-majority-owner-CHP-Software-to-sell-GBP25-million-stake-46866665/))
thesis.red_flags: Majority founder control (54.4% via CHP Software and Consulting) limits minority-shareholder influence; the company is also subject to a take-private buyout approach from EQT (GBP614m), which could remove it from public markets. No other governance red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: MJ Gleeson plc is a UK housebuilder (founded 1903, listed on the London Stock Exchange) comprising Gleeson Homes, which builds low-cost affordable housing in the North of England and Midlands mainly for first-time buyers, and Gleeson Strategic Land, which promotes land through planning and sells it to housebuilders.
thesis.competitive_position: Gleeson positions itself as the leading low-cost, affordable housebuilder in the UK, targeting first-time buyers and key workers in Northern England and the Midlands, a niche distinct from the volume housebuilders' broader price-point focus. [M J Gleeson - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/M_J_Gleeson)
thesis.main_shareholders: Institutions hold roughly 76-77% of shares. Reported major holders include Harwood Capital LLP (~10.4%), Fidelity International (~10%), Schroder Investment Management (~6.46%), Aberforth Partners (~6.26%) and Rathbones Investment Management (~5.72%). [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/mj-gleeson-plc-reports-change-in-major-holdings)
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders are reported to hold approximately 11% of shares in aggregate. [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/consumer-durables/lse-gle/mj-gleeson-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Gabriel Holding A/S, headquartered in Aalborg, Denmark, designs, develops and manufactures upholstery fabrics and textile solutions for the furniture, transport and acoustics industries, operating through Contract (business furniture, transport, theatres, hospitals) and Home (private furniture) segments.
thesis.competitive_position: Gabriel is a niche Danish textile/upholstery manufacturer supplying both contract (institutional/transport) and home furniture markets, with services spanning textile finishing, product development and design consultancy, differentiating it from pure commodity fabric producers ([Gabriel](https://www.gabriel.dk/investor/gabriel-holding-as/)).
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; detailed shareholder percentage disclosure was not found in available sources for this search.

thesis.business_description: BASSAC is a French real estate developer selling new medium-priced homes (condominiums and houses) in large European population centers, operating in France, Germany and Spain under brands including Les Nouveaux Constructeurs, Premier and Concept Bau, plus a small prefabricated-garage manufacturing business (Zapf).
thesis.competitive_position: BASSAC is a mid-sized regional homebuilder (94.4% of sales from residential/commercial real estate development, 5.6% from prefabricated garages) competing against larger listed French homebuilders such as Kaufman & Broad. Its scale is modest relative to national peers, and results are closely tied to French and European new-build housing demand cycles.
thesis.main_shareholders: Moïse Mitterrand (Chairman & CEO, via holding structure including Premier Investissement SAS) ~86.5%, Gay-Lussac Gestion SA (~0.40%), Independance AM SICAV (~0.21%) ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/BASSAC-36551/company/))
thesis.insider_ownership: ~86.5% held by Chairman/CEO Moïse Mitterrand and affiliated holding entities, per MarketScreener shareholder data
thesis.red_flags: Earnings have deteriorated with the French housing downturn: 1H2024 EPS of €0.98 vs €1.81 in 1H2023; very high insider/family concentration (~86.5%) means minimal free float and limited minority-shareholder influence. ([Webull](https://www.webull.com/news/11582801337066496))

thesis.business_description: INDUS Holding AG is a German industrial holding company that acquires and manages small and medium-sized businesses across five segments: Engineering, Automotive Components/Engineering, Metal/Metal Processing, Construction/Infrastructure, and Medical Engineering/Life Science.
thesis.competitive_position: A diversified German SME holding/private-equity-style conglomerate with broadly dispersed shareholding and no dominant shareholder; the top 25 shareholders together control less than half the company, implying meaningful free float. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/institutions-own-34-indus-holding-061640640.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: Versicherungskammer Bayern is the largest shareholder at approximately 13%; other holders include Hans Joachim Selzer (~5.7%), Protector Forsikring (~5.4%), and Wirtgen Invest Holding (~3.7%); INDUS Holding itself holds about 4.1% in treasury via buybacks. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/INDUS-HOLDING-AG-436251/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Retail/individual investors hold roughly 51-58% in aggregate per different estimates, while institutional ownership is about 34%; no single founder-family insider stake was identified as dominant. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/institutions-own-34-indus-holding-061640640.html)
thesis.red_flags: The company has recognized recurring goodwill/asset impairments in multiple years (2018-2023), including EUR 13.8m in 2022 and EUR 19.3m in 2023, partly driven by higher interest rates raising the cost of capital used in impairment testing; however, the company states compliance with all German Corporate Governance Code recommendations as of its December 2024 declaration. [INDUS Corporate Governance Report](https://indus.eu/wp-content/uploads/INDUS_Corp-Gov-Report-and-Declaration-of-Corp.-Gov-2024_s.pdf)

thesis.business_description: Indel B S.p.A., headquartered in Sant'Agata Feltria, Italy, designs, manufactures and sells mobile refrigeration and air-conditioning products, including compressor refrigerators for trucks, buses, ambulances, RVs and marine applications, plus minibars, safes and other hospitality (Horeca) accessories such as LED TVs, hairdryers and wine cellars for hotels and cruise ships.
thesis.competitive_position: Indel B operates through two main business lines, Mobile Refrigeration and Horeca (hospitality) accessories, giving it exposure to both the vehicle/marine refrigeration niche and the hotel-minibar supply market; nine-month 2025 consolidated revenue was about EUR156.8 million, roughly flat year-over-year ([Indel B Group](https://www.indelbgroup.com/en/investor-relations)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Indel B is majority owned by Amp.Fin S.R.L. (a holding company); specific shareholding percentage was not confirmed in available sources ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/INDEL-B-S-P-A-34973381/company/))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search.

thesis.business_description: StealthGas Inc. is a Marshall Islands-domiciled international shipping company that owns and operates a fleet of LPG carriers transporting liquefied petroleum and petrochemical gas products (propane, butane, butadiene, propylene, etc.); as of March 2026 it operated a fleet of 28 LPG carriers with combined capacity of 334,118 cbm.
thesis.competitive_position: StealthGas is described as the world's largest owner of small LPG pressurized carriers in the strategic 3,000-8,000 cbm segment, giving it scale leadership in that specific niche of the LPG shipping market ([StealthGas investor relations](https://www.stealthgas.com/investor-relations-mainmenu-99.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Flawless Management, Inc. (19.11%, controlled by CEO Harry Vafias), Glendon Capital Management L.P. (12.75%), Harry Vafias directly (12.18%) plus additional indirect holdings via Arethusa Properties LTD (586,020 shares) ([Yahoo Finance ownership summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/heres-stealthgas-inc-nasdaq-gass-115509217.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Harry Vafias controls roughly 30%+ of the company when direct holdings plus Flawless Management, Inc. and Arethusa Properties LTD are combined; he has been President/CEO since the company's founding in December 2004 ([Yahoo Finance ownership summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/heres-stealthgas-inc-nasdaq-gass-115509217.html))
thesis.red_flags: Heavy insider/founder control (CEO Vafias and affiliated entities hold a large combined stake) concentrates governance power; no specific litigation or accounting red flags identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: VIB Vermögen AG is a German commercial real estate company that develops, acquires and manages properties focused on logistics, light industrial and office assets, generating income from long-term rental of its own portfolio.
thesis.competitive_position: A mid-sized German logistics/light-industrial real estate specialist; since 2022 it has been majority-controlled by DIC Asset AG / Branicks Group, which raised its stake over time and in 2026 moved to a control and profit-transfer agreement, reducing VIB's independence as a standalone investment case. [Branicks](https://branicks.com/en/dic-asset-ag-has-secured-a-majority-of-the-shares-in-vib-vermoegen-ag/)
thesis.main_shareholders: DIC Real Estate Investments GmbH & Co. KGaA (a subsidiary of Branicks Group AG, formerly DIC Asset AG) holds roughly 69% of voting rights, following a partial takeover offer completed in 2022; remaining ~31% was free float before a 2026 control/profit-transfer agreement and share-swap offer to minority holders. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/VIB-VERMOGEN-AG-66284737/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: No evidence of meaningful founder/management ownership; control rests with corporate parent Branicks Group/DIC Asset rather than insiders or founders. Not disclosed in public filings beyond the controlling corporate shareholder.
thesis.red_flags: A VIB major shareholder requested a special audit regarding a EUR 250 million loan from VIB to its majority shareholder Branicks Group, a related-party transaction; minority shareholders also raised concerns about potential delisting and dividend cuts following DIC Asset's takeover and the 2026 control/profit-transfer agreement. [Spruchverfahren.blogspot.com](https://spruchverfahren.blogspot.com/2024/07/vib-groaktionar-fordert-sonderprufung.html)

thesis.business_description: Greek car rental and leasing company (founded 1966, Crete origin), the official Hertz International franchisee for Greece and 8 other countries (Cyprus, Romania, Bulgaria, Serbia, Montenegro, Ukraine, Croatia and others), also importing/distributing/selling cars; operates Hertz, Thrifty, Dollar and Firefly brands.
thesis.competitive_position: The largest car rental company in Greece and the largest national Hertz franchisee in the world (continuously since 1978), with a fleet of 48,000+ vehicles and 160+ service locations (51 at airports) across 9 countries.
thesis.main_shareholders: Estate of Theodore E. Vassilakis holds 62.7% (29,782,668 shares); historically Theodore Vassilakis (58.16%) and Emmanuella Vassilakis (9.53%) individually per 2012 disclosure ([MarketScreener/company disclosures](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AUTOHELLAS-S-A-6258920/company/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Vassilakis founding family controls approximately 62.7% via the Estate of Theodore E. Vassilakis, maintaining majority control of the listed company since its 1999 Athens Exchange listing ([company financial statements](https://www.autohellas.gr/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/FINANCIAL-STATEMENTS-31-12-2012.pdf))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Bertrandt AG, headquartered in Ehingen, Germany, provides engineering development services to the automotive and aviation industries, organized into Digital Engineering, Electrical Systems/Electronics and Physical Engineering segments, and also serves aerospace, rail, defense, medical-technology and energy sectors.
thesis.competitive_position: Bertrandt is an established European automotive engineering-services provider with roughly 12,100 employees; Porsche AG is its largest shareholder (28.97%), reflecting close ties to the German auto industry - a source of stable client relationships but also a concentration risk given dependence on automotive R&D spending cycles ([Bertrandt IR](https://www.bertrandt.com/en/company/investor-relations/bertrandt-share/shareholder-structure)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Porsche AG (28.97%), Friedrich Boysen Holding GmbH (14.90%), Frank Ferchau (10%), Supervisory/Management Board (4.0%), free float (45.76%), as of December 2024 ([Bertrandt IR](https://www.bertrandt.com/en/company/investor-relations/bertrandt-share/shareholder-structure))
thesis.insider_ownership: Supervisory Board and Management Board together hold about 4.0% of shares ([Bertrandt IR](https://www.bertrandt.com/en/company/investor-relations/bertrandt-share/shareholder-structure))
thesis.red_flags: Notable customer/industry concentration risk given heavy reliance on the automotive sector, including ties to major shareholder Porsche AG, exposing Bertrandt to cyclical downturns in auto R&D spending. No governance red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: UK-based developer and manufacturer (Surgical and Woundcare segments) of tissue-healing technologies including tissue adhesives, sutures, haemostats and internal sealants (INTEGUSEAL, LiquiBand, RESORBA, Seal-G brands) and advanced wound-care dressings (ActivHeal brand), serving the UK, Germany, France, US and international markets.
thesis.competitive_position: Described as a world-leading independent developer/manufacturer of tissue-healing technologies with manufacturing sites across the UK, Germany, France, Netherlands, Thailand, India, Czech Republic and Israel, giving it a broader international manufacturing footprint than many AIM-listed medtech peers.
thesis.main_shareholders: Octopus Investments Limited (13%), Canaccord Genuity Wealth International (6.5%), Charles Stanley & Co. Asset Management (5.2%); top 12 shareholders control 51%, no single majority holder ([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/advanced-medical-solutions-group-plc-050446954.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Insiders hold under 1% in their own names; CEO Andrew Meredith individually holds ~0.8% ([MatrixBCG/Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/advanced-medical-solutions-group-plc-050446954.html))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: FERRO S.A. is a Poland-based manufacturer and distributor of sanitary and heating installation fittings, selling under its own brands FERRO, Metalia, Titania and Weberman, headquartered in Skawina, Poland.
thesis.competitive_position: A mid-sized Central/Eastern European sanitary-fittings producer with international sales into Romania, France, Ukraine, Belarus, Bulgaria and Russia, competing against larger multinational plumbing/sanitary brands primarily on regional distribution reach and private-label/own-brand positioning. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FERRO-S-A-10213595/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Ownership is dominated by Polish pension funds: Nationale-Nederlanden OFE holds approximately 19.72%, Bankowy OFE approximately 18.82%, AVIVA OFE approximately 14.66%, and Aegon OFE approximately 10.29%. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FERRO-S-A-177502294/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Could not verify specific management/board/founder ownership percentages; the company's register shows institutional pension-fund investors as the largest holders rather than disclosed insider stakes. Not disclosed in public filings reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; no specific fraud, litigation or governance controversy surfaced in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Fountaine Pajot SA is a French shipyard and one of the world's pioneering builders of cruising catamarans, sailing catamarans, motor yachts and sailboats, founded in 1976 in Aigrefeuille-d'Aunis.
thesis.competitive_position: A long-established, founder-family-controlled catamaran/motor-yacht builder with global distribution (including an expanding Asia network); H1 FY2025/26 revenue fell to EUR 136.3 million from over EUR 156 million a year earlier and net profit fell from EUR 15.3 million to EUR 5.2 million, reflecting a cyclical slowdown in leisure-marine demand. [Boat Industry](https://www.boatindustry.com/news/52672/fountaine-pajot-asia-an-expanded-network-from-hong-kong-to-thailand)
thesis.main_shareholders: La Compagnie du Catamaran SAS, the investment vehicle of the founding Fountaine family, holds approximately 53.3%; Independance AM holds approximately 5.59%, with smaller stakes held by Kirao SAS, Amplegest SAS and OFI Invest Asset Management. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FOUNTAINE-PAJOT-54449/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder family control is high: La Compagnie du Catamaran (the Fountaine family vehicle) holds roughly 53.3%, and family members are represented on both management and the board; CEO Nicolas Gardies has led since 1997 and is planning a transition to Deputy CEO Mathieu Fountaine (a family member) ahead of 2027 retirement. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FOUNTAINE-PAJOT-54449/company/)
thesis.red_flags: Revenue and net profit declined sharply in H1 FY2025/26 (revenue down ~13%, net profit down ~66%); the company is also undergoing a leadership succession, with deputy CEO Romain Motteau departing after 20+ years and new deputy CEO Steven Guedeu appointed, alongside CEO Nicolas Gardies' planned 2027 retirement, both execution risks to monitor. [Marine Business World](https://www.marinebusinessworld.com/news/297669/Fountaine-Pajot-strengthens-its-governance)

thesis.business_description: Lošinjska Plovidba - Holding d.d. is a Croatian holding company (founded 1958, based in Mali Lošinj) whose subsidiaries provide marine cargo transportation (feeder and tramp shipping, liner service between Mediterranean and Croatian ports), ship repair services, and tourism operations (camping accommodation, food and beverage, marina services).
thesis.competitive_position: The company operates through Tourism and Shipbuilding Repair segments via subsidiaries including Lošinjska plovidba-Brodogradilište, Lošinjska plovidba-Turizam and Morus Alba, giving it a diversified regional shipping/tourism business rooted in a long maritime heritage dating to 1850 on the Adriatic coast; specific market-share data was not found in sources reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed; detailed ownership/shareholder data was not found in the sources searched (Croatian-language company registries would likely have more detail).

thesis.business_description: Mensch und Maschine Software SE (M+M) is a German provider of CAD, CAM, PDM and BIM software solutions, operating across Europe, the Americas and Asia, headquartered in Wessling near Munich.
thesis.competitive_position: A leading European CAD/CAM/BIM software and Autodesk reseller/value-added partner (founded 1984), with EUR 238.6 million in 2025 sales and ~1,200 employees; chose a monistic (one-tier) board structure to suit its owner-managed-yet-public status. [Rhino Insight](https://rhinoinsight.substack.com/p/mensch-und-maschine-software-se-ticker)
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder and Chairman of the Management Board Adi Drotleff holds approximately 47-48% of shares; other management members hold a further ~5.4%; the top 3 shareholders collectively control more than half the company, with institutional ownership around 16%. [Yahoo Finance/Simply Wall St](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/47-ownership-mensch-und-maschine-054517782.html)
thesis.insider_ownership: Very high insider ownership: founder Adi Drotleff alone holds approximately 47-48% as of year-end 2025, with other management holding an additional ~5.4%, giving insiders well over 50% combined control. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/47-ownership-mensch-und-maschine-054517782.html)
thesis.red_flags: No specific governance disputes or auditor concerns were found; dhgp GmbH Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft was elected as auditor for FY2024 in the normal course. Concentrated founder control (top 3 holders >50%) is a structural governance consideration but not a disclosed dispute. None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Sonel S.A. is a Polish manufacturer of electrical test and measuring instruments for the power industry and telecommunications, headquartered in Świdnica, Poland.
thesis.competitive_position: A Polish niche electrical test-equipment manufacturer; specific market-share or competitive-moat data was not found in available sources beyond its domestic manufacturing base. [Sonel company history](https://sonel.pl/en/about/history)
thesis.main_shareholders: Chairman Krzysztof Wieczorkowski holds approximately 22.51%; board member Mirosław Nowakowski holds approximately 7.95%; individual insiders collectively hold approximately 67.1% of the company, with institutional ownership around 17.5% and the general public holding approximately 15.3%. [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/tech/wse-son/sonel-shares/news/who-are-the-major-shareholders-of-sonel-sa-wseson/amp)
thesis.insider_ownership: Very high insider ownership at approximately 67.1% held by individual insiders, led by Chairman Krzysztof Wieczorkowski (~22.51%) and board member Mirosław Nowakowski (~7.95%). [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/tech/wse-son/sonel-shares/news/who-are-the-major-shareholders-of-sonel-sa-wseson/amp)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Interlife General Insurance Company S.A., founded in Thessaloniki, Greece in 1991, is a non-life insurer offering motor, marine/ship, property, group life/health, legal-protection, technical/engineering, liability and transport insurance products, listed on the Athens Stock Exchange main market since 2021.
thesis.competitive_position: Interlife is a mid-sized, founder-led Greek non-life insurer competing against larger domestic players (e.g. Ethniki, Interamerican, European Reliance) in a fragmented Greek P&C insurance market. [Interlife company data](https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/164465-29)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Votsaridis family controls the company: founder Ioannis Votsaridis holds approximately 22.03%, Georgia Votsaridou approximately 14.24%, Konstantinos Votsaridis approximately 13.42%, and Panagiotis Ioannis Votsaridis approximately 5.08%, with Gnomon Consultants SA holding approximately 5.31%. [iggyoninvesting Substack, citing company disclosures](https://iggyoninvesting.substack.com/p/interlife-the-next-davis-double-play)
thesis.insider_ownership: The founding Votsaridis family collectively holds more than 50% of the company (summing disclosed family stakes of ~22.03% + ~14.24% + ~13.42% + ~5.08%), with founder Ioannis Votsaridis serving as President and CEO — very high founder/insider control. [iggyoninvesting Substack](https://iggyoninvesting.substack.com/p/interlife-the-next-davis-double-play)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: edding AG is a German manufacturer of felt-tip pens, marker pens, spray paints and other writing/stationery products, headquartered in Ahrensburg near Hamburg and founded in 1960.
thesis.competitive_position: A well-known German stationery/marker brand (2023 revenue ~EUR 161 million) competing in a market experiencing structural underperformance, especially in its core Germany and Turkey units; the family retains majority voting control through ordinary shares while only non-voting preference shares trade publicly. [Edding IR](https://www.edding.com/en-us/investor-relations/overview/)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Ledermann founding family holds the majority of ordinary (voting) shares; only non-voting preference shares are publicly traded, meaning public shareholders do not have voting control. [Wikipedia/Edding History](https://www.edding.com/en-us/history/)
thesis.insider_ownership: High and controlling: the Ledermann family has held majority ordinary-share ownership since the 1986 IPO (when co-founder Edding exited), with Per Ledermann (2nd generation) and Julia Marie Ledermann (3rd generation, Chairwoman of the Advisory Board) actively involved in governance. [Edding History](https://www.edding.com/en-us/history/)
thesis.red_flags: The company reported its first-ever net loss in the consolidated financial statements for FY2023, driven by a EUR 5.0 million negative deconsolidation effect from the sale of edding Argentina S.A.; guidance was cut multiple times, with FY2026 sales guidance reduced to EUR 139-154 million (from original mid-term planning of EUR 173-188 million) and EBIT guidance cut to EUR 1-4 million (from EUR 8-11 million), reflecting weak performance in Germany and Turkey. [edding IR](https://www.edding.com/en-us/investor-relations/news/article/net-loss-expected-in-edding-ags-individual-financial-statements/)

thesis.business_description: AB Kauno Energija is a Lithuanian utility that produces and distributes heat energy to consumers in Kaunas and Jurbarkas and parts of the surrounding Kaunas districts, and also generates electricity in Kaunas, operating a power plant in Petrašiūnai, district and regional boiler houses, and providing heat/power infrastructure maintenance services.
thesis.competitive_position: Kauno Energija is effectively the monopoly district-heating utility for Kaunas, Lithuania's second-largest city, giving it a stable, regulated regional market position typical of municipal utilities rather than a competitive commercial moat ([GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/05/26/3300751/0/en/Activity-results-of-AB-Kauno-energija-of-the-1-quarter-of-the-year-2026.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Kaunas City Municipality holds 92.8% of votes (39,736,058 ordinary shares) ([GlobeNewswire shareholder meeting resolutions](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/04/29/tmt-newswire/globenewswire/resolutions-of-the-general-meeting-of-shareholders-of-ab-kauno-energija/2331132))
thesis.red_flags: Very high public-sector ownership concentration (92.8% held by Kaunas City Municipality) means the free float and minority-shareholder influence are minimal; as a regulated municipal utility it is also exposed to tariff-setting/regulatory risk. No other red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Odfjell SE is a Norway-based provider of seaborne transportation and storage of chemicals and other specialty bulk liquids, operating through two segments: Chemical Tankers (a fleet of more than 80 ships serving global routes) and Tank Terminals.
thesis.competitive_position: Odfjell is one of the world's leading chemical tanker operators, competing globally in transport of hard-to-handle liquid chemicals for industrial producers and traders; it recently agreed to buy four 40,000 dwt 'super-segregator' newbuilds for USD290 million to modernize and expand its fleet ([Odfjell](https://www.odfjell.com/investors)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Norchem A/S, controlled by founding-family member Laurence Ward Odfjell (42.37% of shares, 42.02% of votes), A/S Rederiet Odfjell (also Odfjell-family controlled), Stolt-Nielsen Norway AS (13.6% of votes), the Steen family (12.2%) ([Pestel Analysis](https://pestel-analysis.com/blogs/owners/odfjell))
thesis.insider_ownership: The founding Odfjell family controls a plurality stake via Norchem A/S and A/S Rederiet Odfjell (combined well over 40% of votes) ([Pestel Analysis](https://pestel-analysis.com/blogs/owners/odfjell))
thesis.red_flags: Dual-class share structure (A- and B-shares, with B-shares carrying no votes) concentrates control with the founding Odfjell family. No other governance red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Addnode Group AB is a Swedish company that acquires, operates and develops knowledge-led software businesses, organized around Design Management (construction, real estate, industrial design IT solutions), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM software), and Process Management (case management, municipal government, e-archive, GIS systems).
thesis.competitive_position: A Swedish serial-acquirer software group ('digitizing society') spanning multiple vertical software niches; specific market-share/moat data was not confirmed from sources reviewed, though its diversified, acquisition-driven model resembles other Nordic industrial/software holding companies. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ADDNODE-GROUP-AB-6491326/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Lannebo Kapitalförvaltning holds approximately 10.77%, Swedbank Robur Fonder approximately 10.29%, Andra AP-fonden approximately 6.57%, Cliens Kapitalförvaltning approximately 6.52%, and Fjärde AP-fonden approximately 5.04%. No connection to Lagercrantz Group was confirmed; shared minor holder ODIN Forvaltning appears in both companies' registers coincidentally. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ADDNODE-GROUP-AB-6491326/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed as a significant founder/management stake in sources reviewed; the shareholder register is dominated by Swedish institutional asset managers and pension funds rather than insiders.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Stabilus SE is a German manufacturer of gas springs, hydraulic dampers and motion-control components for automotive, industrial and medical applications, headquartered in Koblenz.
thesis.competitive_position: Stabilus is the global market leader in automotive gas springs with an estimated market share of over 40%, and world leader in gas springs/hydraulic dampers overall with annual production exceeding 140 million units; it transformed into a broader industrial-automation player via the 2024 Destaco acquisition, expanding into clamping and robotic end-effectors. [Ad-hoc-news.de](https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/ueberblick/stabilus-se-stock-de000stab1l8-is-its-automotive-motion-control-edge/69158070)
thesis.main_shareholders: Following its 2014 IPO, Stabilus is widely held with roughly 89% free float; notable institutional shareholders include Goldman Sachs Advisors BV (~11.02%), Teleios Capital Partners (~9.77%), and Fidelity Management & Research (~9.54%). No single controlling shareholder remains; prior private-equity owners Montagu and Triton Partners have fully exited. [Yahoo Finance/Simply Wall St](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/stabilus-se-etr-stm-largely-073935973.html)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed in public filings as a significant founder/management stake; ownership is dominated by institutional investors rather than insiders following the 2014 IPO and full exit of prior private-equity sponsors.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Kras d.d. is a Croatian confectionery producer (founded 1911, based in Zagreb) making cocoa products, candy, waffles, biscuits and chocolate, sold under the Kraš brand across the Balkans.
thesis.competitive_position: A leading, long-established confectionery brand in Croatia and the wider Balkan region (2025 revenue ~HRK/EUR 194 million, ~1,597 employees); now fully controlled by meat processor Braća Pivac following a takeover. [Just Food](https://www.just-food.com/news/croatia-meat-group-braca-pivac-now-majority-owner-of-confectioner-kras/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Following a 2026 takeover, Pivac Holding and Kappa Star Ltd (owned by Serbian entrepreneur Nebojša Šaranović) jointly control approximately 97.15% of shares (MI Braća Pivac ~49.29%, Kappa Star ~28.01%, cumulatively with prior holdings); a squeeze-out of remaining minority shareholders (~2.85%) at EUR 130/share was initiated after crossing the 95% threshold. [Dealroom](https://dealroom.co/news/156491-pivac-moves-to-squeeze-out-kra-minorities-at-130-a-share/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Ownership is now concentrated with the Pivac family (via MI Braća Pivac) and Kappa Star Ltd as controlling shareholders, rather than company management; original founders are no longer the controlling party. [Dealroom](https://dealroom.co/news/156491-pivac-moves-to-squeeze-out-kra-minorities-at-130-a-share/)
thesis.red_flags: A squeeze-out of minority shareholders was executed at EUR 130/share after Pivac Holding and Kappa Star Ltd crossed the 95% ownership threshold under Croatian takeover law, meaning the stock is being delisted/taken private - a material consideration for any shortlist thesis given the company is being removed from public markets. [Dealroom](https://dealroom.co/news/156491-pivac-moves-to-squeeze-out-kra-minorities-at-130-a-share/)

thesis.business_description: Oponeo.pl S.A. is a Poland-based online retailer of tires and automotive parts, founded in 1999 and headquartered in Bydgoszcz, offering roughly 100 tire brands plus wheel rims and other auto accessories.
thesis.competitive_position: A leading Polish/European online tire retailer with an established e-commerce platform since its 2007 WSE listing, competing in the fragmented online tire-and-parts retail space. [Oponeo company history](https://www.ir.oponeo.pl/en/company-info/history/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Co-founders Dariusz Topolewski (~32.57%) and Ryszard Zawieruszyński (~26.42%) together hold approximately 59% of shares; institutional holders include Allianz Polska TFI (~5.86%), ING TFI (~5.26%) and Norges Bank Investment Management (~5.13%). [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/OPONEO-PL-S-A-6499864/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Very high founder ownership: co-founders Topolewski and Zawieruszyński together control roughly 59% of the company, indicating strong alignment between management/founders and shareholders. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/OPONEO-PL-S-A-6499864/company/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Fleury Michon SA is a French family-owned agri-food company and France's leading producer of cooked meats (charcuterie), ready meals and catering products sold through supermarkets, founded in 1905 in Vendée.
thesis.competitive_position: Market leader in France for cooked/processed meat products and prepared meals, operating 12 production sites (10 in France) and present in eight additional countries; competes against other European packaged-food players on brand strength and French retail distribution. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FLEURY-MICHON-110711919/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Société Holding de Contrôle et de Participations SAS (the founding-family holding vehicle) holds approximately 48.69%; the Gonnord family holds approximately 10.08% and the Magdelenat family approximately 6.14% directly, giving the founding families majority control. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FLEURY-MICHON-110711919/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: High and controlling: the founding Gonnord/Magdelenat families together control roughly two-thirds of the company through the holding company and direct stakes, with Grégoire Gonnord serving as Chairman and multiple family members on the board. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FLEURY-MICHON-110711919/company-shareholders/)
thesis.red_flags: No Fleury Michon-specific food-safety scandal, lawsuit or governance dispute was found in available search results (a separate 2025 listeria case involved an unrelated French cheese company, Chavegrand, not Fleury Michon).

thesis.business_description: Ökoworld AG is a German asset manager specializing in sustainable/ESG investment funds since 1975, also owning an insurance-brokerage business for pension schemes and an asset-advisory service for high-net-worth individuals (via its subsidiary versiko ASS).
thesis.competitive_position: Ökoworld is an asset-light fund distributor generating fee income from its own fund range, positioned as a pioneer in socially responsible investing (SRI); its non-voting preference shares trade on the Scale segment of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange ([Edison Group research](https://www.edisongroup.com/research/profits-and-principles-a-pioneer-in-sri/18413/)).
