[Unquote - FSN Troax exit](https://www.unquote.com/nordics/official-record/63448/fsn-in-sek-347m-troax-exit)
thesis.main_shareholders: Investment AB Latour is the largest and controlling-type shareholder, holding approximately 30.1-30.3% of both capital and votes per current data ([Inderes/Millistream data](https://inderes.dk/en/companies/Troax-Group/ownership); [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/capital-goods/sto-troax/troax-group-shares/ownership)); Thomas Widstrand holds approximately 5.8% ([Inderes](https://inderes.dk/en/companies/Troax-Group/ownership)). Former private-equity owner FSN Capital fully exited by selling its remaining 18.1% stake (3,618,946 shares) to institutional investors ([Unquote](https://www.unquote.com/nordics/official-record/63448/fsn-in-sek-347m-troax-exit)).
thesis.insider_ownership: No founder/management insider stake of significance was identified beyond Thomas Widstrand's ~5.8%; institutions hold roughly 61% in aggregate per Simply Wall St, with Investment AB Latour (classified by some aggregators as a PE/VC-type holder) as the anchor shareholder rather than an operating-management insider.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Alternative Income REIT Plc is a UK real estate investment trust holding freehold and long-leasehold alternative/specialist UK commercial property (automotive, petroleum, education, healthcare, hotels, industrials), aiming to deliver secure, diversified, inflation-linked income; it is externally advised by M7 Real Estate Limited.
thesis.competitive_position: AIRE is a small externally-managed UK REIT (NAV £67.3m / 83.6p per share at 30 June 2025, 20 assets, 17.2-year WAULT) specializing in alternative/specialist property sectors rather than mainstream offices or retail, giving it long lease-length income but limited scale versus larger diversified REITs; it is currently the subject of competing takeover interest. [AIRE company information, Barclays Research Centre](https://research-centre.barclays.co.uk/shares/alternative-income-reit/company-information)
thesis.main_shareholders: Glenstone REIT (formerly Glenstone Property PLC) is the largest shareholder, having built its stake from 14.73% (late 2020, post-tender-offer) to roughly 24.7-27.4% more recently (sources vary by date/measure) ([AJ Bell - Glenstone bid coverage](https://www.ajbell.co.uk/news/articles/update-alternative-income-hits-out-glenstone-bid-aew-uk-circles); [TipRanks voting rights notice](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/alternative-income-reit-plc-announces-change-in-voting-rights)). Other large holders include Hargreaves Lansdown Asset Management (~22.9%) and Aberdeen Group (~12.5%) per aggregator data ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/real-estate/lse-aire/alternative-income-reit-shares/ownership)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed/found; no significant named management or director insider stake was identified in search results. Not disclosed in public filings found.
thesis.red_flags: Active M&A/takeover situation: Glenstone REIT has pursued control of AIRE (criticized by AIRE's board as an attempt to gain control without paying an appropriate premium), while AEW UK REIT separately floated a possible all-share offer (implied value ~77.4p/share) before AIRE ended those talks in favor of a standalone strategy; a further filing (19 August 2026) on Glenstone's acceptance levels suggests the situation remains unresolved. [AJ Bell - Glenstone bid vs AEW UK](https://www.ajbell.co.uk/news/articles/update-alternative-income-hits-out-glenstone-bid-aew-uk-circles) / [Nasdaq - AIRE ends AEW talks](https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/alternative-income-reit-ends-talks-aew-confident-standalone-strategy)

thesis.business_description: Plastiques du Val de Loire (Groupe Plastivaloire) is a France-based manufacturer of complex injection-molded plastic parts for automotive (roughly 80% of revenue), telecommunications, electrical, construction, and gardening sectors, operating more than 30 sites internationally. [Plastivaloire group history](https://groupe-plastivaloire.com/en/history/)
thesis.competitive_position: Plastivaloire is a long-established, family-founded (1963, by Charles Findeling) automotive plastics supplier with international manufacturing scale (30+ sites), though it has faced balance-sheet strain typical of auto-parts suppliers; it recently returned to positive net profit and improved EBITDA margin (~9.0%) with an 8-month increase in order intake. [Half-year results 2025-2026 press release](https://www.actusnews.com/en/groupe-plastivaloire/pr/2026/07/15/half-year-results-for-2025-2026-ebitda-margin-up-to-9_0-per-cent-return-to-a-positive-net-profit-eight-month-order-intake)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Findeling family owns approximately 57% of capital and controls over 72% of voting rights (via double voting rights), as of early 2025; free float is roughly 40%. [Half-year results press release](https://www.actusnews.com/en/groupe-plastivaloire/pr/2026/07/15/half-year-results-for-2025-2026-ebitda-margin-up-to-9_0-per-cent-return-to-a-positive-net-profit-eight-month-order-intake)
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider ownership is very high and founder-family controlled: the Findeling family (Patrick Findeling is Chairman of the Board, with CEO Antoine Doutriaux appointed in 2022) holds roughly 57% of capital / over 72% of votes. [Bloomberg profile: Patrick Findeling](https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/person/1396127)
thesis.red_flags: Plastivaloire has had elevated financial leverage: net debt stood at approximately €163.4 million (including €15.6 million lease liabilities) against shareholders' equity of €179.1 million as of March 31, 2026, and the company recently had to negotiate an agreement with financial partners to extend the maturity profile of its debt (with a modest 25bps rate increase on syndicated/bilateral loans). This reflects real balance-sheet/refinancing risk, though the company frames it as a successful recovery and extension, not a default. [Half-year results and debt agreement press release](https://www.actusnews.com/en/groupe-plastivaloire/pr/2026/07/15/half-year-results-for-2025-2026-ebitda-margin-up-to-9_0-per-cent-return-to-a-positive-net-profit-eight-month-order-intake)

thesis.business_description: Roularta Media Group NV is a Belgian multimedia group publishing magazines and newspapers (including stakes in French titles via its former Roularta-L'Express print partnership) and operating television/digital media, headquartered in Roeselare, Belgium.
thesis.competitive_position: Roularta is a leading Belgian/Flemish print and multimedia publisher, long family-controlled, which has been consolidating its share structure and is now pursuing a full take-private/delisting after 27 years on the Brussels exchange - a sign the controlling family sees more value outside public markets than the market is currently according it. [Belga News Agency - Roularta delisting bid](https://www.belganewsagency.eu/media-group-roularta-to-delist-as-brussels-stock-exchange-struggles-to-attract-new-listings)
thesis.main_shareholders: The De Nolf family controls Roularta via Koinon NV, holding approximately 72.3% of shares at the time of a going-private tender offer (€15.50/share, a ~24.5% premium) ([Belga News Agency](https://www.belganewsagency.eu/media-group-roularta-to-delist-as-brussels-stock-exchange-struggles-to-attract-new-listings)); a May 2025 Belgian FSMA transparency-register overview shows Hendrik (Rik) De Nolf's combined stake (via STAK Cerveteri/Koinon NV plus Roularta's own treasury-share holding) at approximately 86.98% of voting rights ([FSMA transparency register](https://www.fsma.be/sites/default/files/issuers/files/0434278896_nl.pdf)). The Claeys family holds a smaller allied stake via West Investment Holding (~3.75-4.47% depending on source/date) ([FSMA register](https://www.fsma.be/sites/default/files/issuers/files/0434278896_nl.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: The De Nolf family (founders Willy and Marie-Therese De Nolf's descendants, led by Rik/Hendrik De Nolf) is the controlling insider group at ~72-87% depending on measure and date; the allied Claeys family (Leo Claeys, brother-in-law of Rik De Nolf, having sold down his direct stake to De Nolf over time) holds a smaller allied minority stake. [Made-in.be - Leo Claeys share sale](https://www.made-in.be/west-vlaanderen/leo-claeys-verkoopt-aandelen-roularta-aan-rik-de-nolf/)
thesis.red_flags: Active take-private/delisting bid in progress: the controlling De Nolf family (via Koinon NV), backed by the Claeys family's West Investment Holding, has launched a €215m tender offer at €15.50/share to delist Roularta from Euronext Brussels, which minority shareholders may view as advantaging the controlling family at the expense of outside holders; precise float/treasury percentages are inconsistent across sources and should be checked against the live offer document. [Belga News Agency](https://www.belganewsagency.eu/media-group-roularta-to-delist-as-brussels-stock-exchange-struggles-to-attract-new-listings)

thesis.business_description: Chimimport AD is a Bulgarian holding company that acquires, restructures and manages subsidiary shareholdings and provides capital investment/financing to related enterprises, listed on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange-Sofia since 2007 and part of the SOFIX index.
thesis.competitive_position: A legacy privatization-era Bulgarian conglomerate (originally a 1947 state foreign-trade company, privatized via management-employee buyout in 1994) now serving as the listed holding vehicle for interests historically linked to the Varna-based TIM group, spanning banking, insurance, shipping and other sectors; competitive positioning data for the holding itself (as distinct from its operating subsidiaries) is limited in public sources. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chimimport_AD)
thesis.main_shareholders: Chimimport Invest AD holds approximately 72.22% of the company; minority holders include international institutions such as The Bank of New York Mellon, DSK Rodina Pension Funds, Eaton Vance Emerging Markets, NN Funds, UniCredit Bank and Raiffeisen Bank International. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/CHIMIMPORT-AD-9823293/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Control runs through Chimimport Invest AD (~72.22%), historically linked to the Varna-based TIM business group and its founders; specific individual insider percentages beyond the holding-company structure were not found in sources reviewed. Not fully disclosed in sources reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: The company has long-standing public association with the TIM group, a Varna-based business group that has been the subject of organized-crime investigations and media scrutiny in Bulgaria (including an investigative piece on connections to Russian elites); Bulgaria's judiciary/administration is also noted as generally weak for enforcing ownership-dispute redress, a jurisdictional governance risk. No company-specific fraud or litigation finding was confirmed. [iStories investigation](https://istories.media/en/investigations/2020/09/10/russian-elites-connections-to-bulgarias-largest-crime-group/)

thesis.business_description: Campine NV is a Belgian (Beerse-based) metals recycling and specialty chemicals company, primarily recycling lead from scrap (notably used car batteries) into refined lead metal, and also producing antimony and other specialty chemical products; it has recently expanded into French lead-battery recycling.
thesis.competitive_position: Campine is an established European lead-recycling specialist (approx. 60,000 tonnes of refined lead from scrap as of 2022) that has grown via distressed-asset acquisitions, buying French lead battery recycling plants out of the Recylex insolvency in 2022 and completing the purchase of Ecobat's French lead operations in October 2025 (adding ~70,000 tonnes/year of capacity), consolidating its position in European battery recycling. [Ecobat - sale of French lead operations to Campine](https://ecobat.com/2025/10/ecobat-completes-sale-of-french-lead-operations-to-campine/)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Hempel family (Friedrich-Wilhelm Hempel and linked entities, including the F.-W. Hempel Familienstiftung and F.W. Hempel Metallurgical GmbH) controls Campine with approximately 71.86% of voting rights (1,077,900 of 1,500,000 shares) per a Belgian FSMA transparency-register overview dated 16 May 2025, though this rests on an underlying notification from 27 June 2019 and should be verified for currency ([FSMA transparency register](https://www.fsma.be/sites/default/files/issuers/files/0403807337_nl.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling ownership sits with the German Hempel family (via F.W. Hempel Metallurgical GmbH and the family foundation) at ~72%, rather than with operating management; no separate management/board insider stake was identified in search results. [FSMA transparency register](https://www.fsma.be/sites/default/files/issuers/files/0403807337_nl.pdf)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; note the ~72% family-control figure is sourced to a 2019 notification (last update found), so confirm it has not changed via a more recent FSMA filing.

thesis.business_description: AB INVL Baltic Farmland is a Lithuanian real-estate company that owns and manages agricultural (farm)land, holding 100% stakes in roughly 18 subsidiary companies that collectively own about 3,000 hectares of farmland in Lithuania, leased out to Lithuanian farmers and agricultural companies.
thesis.competitive_position: INVL Baltic Farmland is a small, specialized farmland-holding vehicle (market cap ~EUR 20.5m as of September 2024) spun off in 2014 from Baltic asset manager Invalda INVL; its land management is outsourced to INVL Farmland Management under a property administration agreement, making it essentially a passive landlord rather than an active farming operator. [INVL Baltic Farmland Q3 2024 report](https://nasdaqbaltic.com/market/upload/reports/inl/2024_q3_en_eur_00.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Per aggregator data (undated), the largest holders are LJB Investments UAB (~30.3%), Irena Mišeikienė (~28.9%), Lucrum Investicija UAB (~12.9%), Alvydas Banys (~7.8%, also board chairman) and Ilona Šulnienė (~7.4%), with the top 7 shareholders holding ~91.29% of the company ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/lt/real-estate-management-and-development/nsel-inl1l/ab-invl-baltic-farmland-shares/ownership)). This should be cross-checked against the company's own >5% shareholder disclosure as of 30 September 2024 ([INVL Baltic Farmland Q3 2024 report](https://nasdaqbaltic.com/market/upload/reports/inl/2024_q3_en_eur_00.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Board chairman Alvydas Banys holds a direct stake of approximately 7.8% per aggregator data, and is linked to the Invalda INVL group that spun the company off; combined individual-insider ownership is estimated around 48.1% per the same source, indicating a closely-held structure. [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/lt/real-estate-management-and-development/nsel-inl1l/ab-invl-baltic-farmland-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: PJP Makrum S.A. is a Poland-based industrial company headquartered in Bydgoszcz that manufactures industrial equipment and provides industrial construction services, organized into Docking Solutions, Steel Constructions, Industrial Construction, and other segments (including real estate leasing). [EMIS company profile - PJP Makrum](https://www.emis.com/php/company-profile/PL/PJP_Makrum_SA_en_1454806.html)
thesis.competitive_position: PJP Makrum is a long-established Polish industrial manufacturer (public since 1998) operating in niche segments like loading-dock solutions and steel construction, now controlled by diversified investment group Grupa Kapitałowa IMMOBILE S.A., which has used PJP Makrum as a platform alongside subsidiaries like Promstahl. [Grupa Kapitałowa Immobile - PJP Makrum business areas](https://immobile.com.pl/en/obszary-dzialalnosci/pjp-makrum)
thesis.main_shareholders: Grupa Kapitałowa IMMOBILE S.A. is the controlling shareholder, having built its stake to roughly 70.6%+ of PJP Makrum (with further tender offers, e.g., an offer for an additional 34.27% of shares at PLN 15.70/share, aiming toward 100% ownership). [Stockwatch.pl: GK Immobile tender offer for PJP Makrum](https://www.stockwatch.pl/wiadomosci/gk-immobile-ma-zamiar-oglosic-wezwanie-na-3427-proc-akcji-pjp-makrum-po-1570-zl-za-sztuke,akcje,350910)
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling insider ownership runs through Grupa Kapitałowa IMMOBILE S.A., which has progressively increased its stake toward full ownership via tender offers; no separate individual management/founder stake distinct from Immobile was identified in the sources searched. Could not verify further.
thesis.red_flags: Grupa Kapitałowa IMMOBILE's progressive tender offers aiming at 100% ownership of PJP Makrum signal a likely eventual minority squeeze-out / reduced free float, which prospective minority investors should factor in; no lawsuit or fraud allegation was identified. [Stockwatch.pl tender offer report](https://www.stockwatch.pl/wiadomosci/gk-immobile-ma-zamiar-oglosic-wezwanie-na-3427-proc-akcji-pjp-makrum-po-1570-zl-za-sztuke,akcje,350910)

thesis.business_description: Lime Technologies AB is a Swedish company that develops and sells SaaS-based CRM (customer relationship management) software for the Nordic and broader European market, founded in 1990.
thesis.competitive_position: Lime is a leading Nordic CRM software vendor with over 450 employees and offices across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Finland, the Netherlands and Poland, listed on Nasdaq Stockholm Mid Cap; its ownership is broadly institutional with no single controlling shareholder. [MFN - Syringa Capital Lime Technologies statement](https://mfn.se/nir/a/lime-technologies/syringa-capital-sells-holding-in-lime-technologies-still-committed-and-large-owner-c4066c4a)
thesis.main_shareholders: Largest holders per recent aggregator data include Grenspecialisten AB (~10.2%), SEB Investment Management AB (~9.25%), Cliens Kapitalförvaltning AB (~9.13%), ODIN Forvaltning AS (~8.03%) and co-founder Erik Syrén (~8.83%) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/software/sto-lime/lime-technologies-shares/ownership)); Syringa Capital AB (chaired by Erik Syrén) sold part of its stake in 2024 but stated it remains one of the largest shareholders ([MFN/Inderes - Syringa Capital statement](https://inderes.se/releases/syringa-capital-sells-holding-in-lime-technologies-still-committed-and-large-owner)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Co-founder and chairman-linked holder Erik Syrén holds approximately 8.83% directly, with additional exposure via Syringa Capital AB (which he chairs); aggregate individual-insider ownership is estimated around 10.5% per Simply Wall St, and recent insider transactions (Lars Stugemo, Emil Hjalmarsson, Anders Hofvander) have skewed toward net buying. [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/software/sto-lime/lime-technologies-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Agram banka d.d. is a Zagreb-based Croatian commercial bank (formerly Kreditna banka Zagreb, renamed Agram banka in January 2019), providing retail and corporate banking services and closely affiliated with the Agram Group of insurance and leasing companies.
thesis.competitive_position: Agram banka is a small Croatian bank tightly integrated into the Agram Group ecosystem (insurance, leasing, automotive), acquired from the Agrokor Group in 2005; its competitive position rests on serving the group's affiliated businesses and customers rather than broad independent market scale. [SeeNews - Agram banka dividend coverage](https://www.seenews.com/news/croatias-agram-banka-proposes-2-euroshare-dividend-857092)
thesis.main_shareholders: Ownership is concentrated among Agram Group-affiliated entities: per 2025 aggregator data, Adriatic osiguranje's asset-management arm holds ~20%, Euroherc osiguranje ~18.8%, and Agram Life osiguranje's asset-management arm ~18.6%, with further Agram-affiliated holders including Agram leasing (~8.86%), Agram TIS (~7.67%) and Intermod (~7.61%); the top 10 shareholders hold ~89.74% of the company ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/hr/banks/zgse-kbz/agram-banka-dd-shares/ownership)). A separate Croatian database (Fininfo) gives different percentages for some of the same entities, so figures should be cross-checked against the Zagreb Stock Exchange register.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed/found as distinct from the Agram Group corporate holding structure; no individual founder/management stake was identified separately from the group's affiliated-company shareholdings. Not disclosed in public filings found.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; the concentrated ownership by multiple related Agram Group entities (insurance, leasing, trading companies) is a related-party structure worth noting, though no specific governance controversy was found.

thesis.business_description: Leifheit Aktiengesellschaft is a German household products manufacturer, producing cleaning and home-organization products (Leifheit brand), wellbeing/personal-scale products (Soehnle brand) and private-label goods (Birambeau, Herby brands), sold across Germany, Central/Eastern Europe and internationally.
thesis.competitive_position: Leifheit is an established mid-cap German household-goods brand (listed on the Frankfurt Prime Standard since 1984) competing against larger players like Freudenberg's Vileda brand in mechanical cleaning products; it has historically been majority-controlled by a founding-family holding structure. [Börsen-Zeitung interview with Leifheit CEO](https://www.boersen-zeitung.de/unternehmen-branchen/wir-besitzen-eine-hohe-resilienz-gegen-externe-schocks)
thesis.main_shareholders: Historically (2010-2011 GSC Research analyst notes) the controlling holder was HOME Beteiligungen GmbH at approximately 47.3%, followed by MKV Verwaltungs GmbH (~10.0%) and Joachim Loh personally (~6.6%), with treasury shares (~5%) and free float (~31%) making up the rest ([GSC Research, 2010-2011](https://gsc-research.de/media/2010-11-15_LEIFHEIT.pdf)); these figures are over a decade old and a current breakdown was not found in this search - only 61.73% of share capital was represented at the 2024 AGM, which is consistent with a continued large anchor shareholder but should be verified via Leifheit's current voting-rights notifications.
thesis.insider_ownership: Joachim Loh (associated with the Loh/HOME Beteiligungen holding structure) was reported as a direct holder of ~6.6% in 2010-2011 filings, alongside the larger HOME Beteiligungen GmbH stake (~47%); current individual insider holdings were not confirmed in this search and should be checked against recent Bundesanzeiger/EQS voting-rights notices. Not independently confirmed for the present day.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

name: Fabryka Farb i Lakierów Sniezka SA

thesis.business_description: Fabryka Farb i Lakierów Śnieżka SA is a Polish paint and coatings manufacturer, producing decorative and industrial paints/varnishes and operating a multi-brand group across Poland and Central/Eastern Europe (including Hungarian subsidiary Poli-Farbe and Radomska Fabryka Farb i Lakierów/Rafil), listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 2003.
thesis.competitive_position: Śnieżka describes itself as the only paint manufacturer listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange and the only one controlled by Polish capital, and has grown via regional acquisitions (Rafil, Hungary's Poli-Farbe at an 80% stake); it has paid dividends every year since its 2003 listing, reflecting a strong regional market position and cash generation. [European Coatings - Śnieżka powder coatings divestment](https://european-coatings.com/?p=25743)
thesis.main_shareholders: Per a December 2025 brokerage report (BDM), major shareholders are Stanisław Cymbor (~20.1%), Jerzy Pater (~20.1%), OFE Allianz (~14.4%), Rafał Mikrut (~10.1%), Piotr Mikrut (~10.1%, also CEO) and OFE Nationale-Nederlanden (~9.4%), with others holding the remaining ~15.8% ([BDM brokerage report via Strefa Inwestorów](https://strefainwestorow.pl/sites/default/files/attachments/53074429_13672243_53074429_20251203_BDM_SKA_PL_RA.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: The Mikrut family (brothers Piotr Mikrut, CEO, and Rafał Mikrut) together hold approximately 20.2% (10.1% each); founders/long-term holders Stanisław Cymbor and Jerzy Pater each separately hold ~20.1% and both sit on the supervisory board (Cymbor as chairman, Pater as vice-chairman as of the 2026 AGM) ([BDM brokerage report](https://strefainwestorow.pl/sites/default/files/attachments/53074429_13672243_53074429_20251203_BDM_SKA_PL_RA.pdf); [Parkiet - supervisory board nominations](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art44428891-fabryka-farb-i-lakierow-sniezka-sa-powolanie-czlonkow-rady-nadzorczej-i-komitetu-audytu)).
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Victrex plc is a UK-based manufacturer of high-performance polymers, primarily PEEK (polyetheretherketone) and related PAEK-based materials, serving aerospace, automotive, energy, electronics and healthcare (via its Invibio medical subsidiary) end markets.
thesis.competitive_position: Victrex owns a substantial share of global PEEK manufacturing capacity, making it a global leader in this high-performance polymer niche; it originated from a 1995 management buyout of ICI's PEEK business and listed on the London Stock Exchange, and remains widely held with a free float of roughly 99% and no controlling shareholder. [Interactive Investor - Victrex analysis](https://ii.co.uk/analysis-commentary/victrex-why-uk-star-stock-worth-owning-ii510162)
thesis.main_shareholders: No controlling shareholder; largest institutional holders per aggregator data (undated) are Threadneedle Asset Management (~11.67%), FIL Investment Advisors/Fidelity (~9.76%) and Norges Bank Investment Management (~9.18%), with further holdings above 3% from Jupiter, Schroder, Brown Capital, M&G, Janus Henderson, Royal London and Vanguard ([MarketScreener shareholder table](https://in.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/VICTREX-PLC-9590145/company-shareholders/)).
thesis.insider_ownership: No significant named founder/management insider stake was identified; ownership is essentially fully institutional/public float (~99.14% free float per MarketScreener data), consistent with its origin as a management buyout that subsequently listed and diluted founding management's stake over three decades. [MarketScreener](https://in.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/VICTREX-PLC-9590145/company-shareholders/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Toyota Caetano Portugal, S.A. is Toyota's import and distribution operation for Portugal, also manufacturing/assembling light commercial vehicles (notably the Toyota Dyna/Caetano Bus operations historically) and operating dealership/retail automotive activities, controlled jointly by the Salvador Caetano family group and Toyota.
thesis.competitive_position: Toyota Caetano is the exclusive Toyota (and historically Lexus) importer/distributor for Portugal, giving it a durable franchise-based moat tied directly to its contractual relationship with Toyota Motor Europe; this relationship is itself the source of a formal shareholder agreement constraining the company's ownership structure. [Grupo Salvador Caetano corporate governance report](https://toyotacaetano.pt/wp-content/uploads/sites/24/2018/08/Governance_Report-30042015.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Grupo Salvador Caetano, SGPS, S.A. (the family holding company) holds approximately 69.8% per recent aggregator data ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pt/automobiles/eli-sct/toyota-caetano-portugal-shares/ownership)), versus about 60.8% in a 2015 governance report; Toyota Motor Europe NV/SA (listed by some sources as Toyota Motor Corporation) holds approximately 27% ([2015 Governance Report](https://toyotacaetano.pt/wp-content/uploads/sites/24/2018/08/Governance_Report-30042015.pdf); [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pt/automobiles/eli-sct/toyota-caetano-portugal-shares/ownership)). A shareholder agreement tied to the Toyota dealer contract commits the family holding to retain roughly 60% of share capital while that contract remains in force (described as a pledge of honour with no penalty clause) ([2015 Governance Report](https://toyotacaetano.pt/wp-content/uploads/sites/24/2018/08/Governance_Report-30042015.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: The Salvador Caetano family controls the company via Grupo Salvador Caetano SGPS; heirs of founder Salvador Fernandes Caetano separately held about 4% directly as of the 2015 report ([2015 Governance Report](https://toyotacaetano.pt/wp-content/uploads/sites/24/2018/08/Governance_Report-30042015.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: A 2019 shareholder-approved attempt to delist the company (with Salvador Caetano Auto committing to buy out minority shareholders) was abandoned in 2020 because the company judged the offer price unconvincing; minority shareholders should be aware a future delisting attempt is plausible given this history. [ECO - Salvador Caetano abandons delisting plan](https://eco.sapo.pt/2020/04/22/salvador-caetano-desiste-de-retirar-toyota-caetano-da-bolsa-preco-nao-convence/)

thesis.business_description: Guillemot Corporation S.A. is a French company designing and distributing computer hardware and gaming peripherals/accessories, including brands such as Thrustmaster and Hercules. [Guillemot Corporation - Encyclopedia.com](https://www.encyclopedia.com/books/politics-and-business-magazines/guillemot-corporation)
thesis.competitive_position: Guillemot is a long-established, founder-family-run gaming hardware/peripherals maker; the Guillemot brothers also co-founded Ubisoft, giving the family deep roots in the video-game industry, though Guillemot Corporation itself is a smaller niche peripherals player relative to larger consumer electronics competitors. [Yves Guillemot - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yves_Guillemot)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Guillemot family collectively controls a large majority of the company; individual family members' reported stakes include Michel Guillemot (~9.28%), the broader Guillemot Family entity (~8.34%), Gérard Guillemot (~7.46%), Yves Guillemot (~6.71%), the Estate of Claude Guillemot (~5.30%), Valentin Guillemot (~2.58%) and Christian Guillemot (~2.24%); more recent disclosures describe the family controlling around 72% of capital and 83% of voting rights. [MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/GUILLEMOT-CORPORATION-5164/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider ownership is very high and concentrated in the founding Guillemot family (five brothers: Claude, Michel, Gérard, Christian, Yves), who together control roughly 72% of capital / 83% of votes per recent disclosures. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/GUILLEMOT-CORPORATION-5164/company-shareholders/)
thesis.red_flags: No specific lawsuit or related-party-transaction controversy was identified in the sources searched; the company's heavy insider/family control (extending to Ubisoft overlap given the Guillemot brothers' dual roles) is worth monitoring for related-party dynamics but no documented dispute was found. [Guillemot Corporation half-year report 2022](https://www.guillemot.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/2022-HALF-YEAR-REPORT-30-06-2022-FINAL-1.pdf)

thesis.business_description: Kopparbergs Bryggeri AB is a Swedish brewery, best known for Kopparberg-brand fruit ciders, also producing beer and other beverages, headquartered at the historic Kopparberg brewery site (established 1882) in Sweden.
thesis.competitive_position: Kopparberg is a well-known international cider brand (particularly strong in the UK on-trade/off-trade cider market) built up from a derelict brewery site acquired and revived by the founding brothers in 1994; it remains tightly founder-family controlled with a dual-class share structure concentrating voting power. [Drams Scotland - visit to Kopparberg brewery](https://dramscotland.co.uk/2014/03/25/a-trip-to-the-home-of-kopparberg)
thesis.main_shareholders: P & D Bronsman AB, the family holding vehicle of founders Peter and Dan-Anders Bronsman, holds approximately 22.8% of capital but 65.3% of votes (reflecting a dual-class share structure), per aggregator data ([Inderes/Millistream data](https://www.inderes.se/en/companies/Kopparbergs-Bryggeri/ownership)); other large holders include 7 H Förvaltnings AB (~14.6% capital / 6.6% votes) and SEB Life International Assurance Ltd (~12.1% capital / 5.5% votes) ([Inderes](https://www.inderes.se/en/companies/Kopparbergs-Bryggeri/ownership)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Founders Peter Bronsman and his brother Dan-Anders Bronsman control the company through P & D Bronsman AB, giving them majority voting control (~65.3% of votes) despite a minority economic stake (~22.8% of capital) - a classic founder dual-class control structure. [Inderes ownership data](https://www.inderes.se/en/companies/Kopparbergs-Bryggeri/ownership); [The Grocer - Bronsman background](https://www.thegrocer.co.uk/people-news/md-davin-nugent-leaves-kopparberg-cider/373755.article)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: INGRA d.d. is a Croatian construction and civil-engineering group, originally founded in 1955 as an export association for Yugoslav industrial manufacturers, that builds civil infrastructure and buildings including hydroelectric/thermoelectric plants, electricity distribution networks, factories, highways, bridges, tunnels, residential buildings, stadiums and hospitals; it has also begun developing hydrogen/renewable-energy projects with the University of Zagreb.
thesis.competitive_position: INGRA is a long-established Croatian infrastructure and civil-engineering contractor with a legacy international project portfolio from the former Yugoslavia; it is now fully privatized with a majority of small shareholders and is diversifying into renewable/hydrogen energy projects ([Ingra](https://ingra.hr/en/about-us/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: President of the Management Board Danko Deban (6.9%), Management Board member Dinko Pejković (6.7%), former Supervisory Board member Franjo Herceg (4.9%) ([Bloomberg Adria](https://hr.bloombergadria.com/trzista/burze/109268/ingra-kupila-cak-26-posto-vlastitih-dionica/news))
thesis.insider_ownership: Management insiders Danko Deban (6.9%) and Dinko Pejković (6.7%) together hold roughly 13.6% of shares, alongside former board member Franjo Herceg (4.9%); the remainder is broadly held by small shareholders ([Bloomberg Adria](https://hr.bloombergadria.com/trzista/burze/109268/ingra-kupila-cak-26-posto-vlastitih-dionica/news))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; ownership is fragmented among small shareholders with no single controlling block, which can also mean limited strategic oversight.

thesis.business_description: Spire Healthcare Group plc operates a network of private hospitals and clinics across the UK, providing treatments spanning cancer care, orthopaedics, cardiac, kidney, eye, cosmetic surgery, dental and ENT procedures.
thesis.competitive_position: Spire is one of the UK's largest private hospital groups, historically majority-linked to South African hospital group Mediclinic; it was deemed attractive enough to draw a recommended take-private bid in 2026 at a 66.2% premium, indicating the market had undervalued its private-healthcare real estate and earnings relative to a private-equity buyer's view. [ProActive Investors - Spire takeover agreement](https://www.proactiveinvestors.com/companies/news/1098152/spire-healthcare-agrees-1-03-billion-takeover-as-management-reshuffles-1098152.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: Mediclinic Group Limited was historically the largest shareholder at approximately 29.8% (though this figure traces to an older 2015 notification and should be verified) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/healthcare/lse-spi/spire-healthcare-group-shares/ownership)); Toscafund Asset Management holds approximately 18.1% and is also part of the consortium (alongside Three Hills and Ares Management) bidding to take Spire private via Tulip UK Bidco Limited at 250p/share (~£1.03bn total) ([ProActive Investors](https://www.proactiveinvestors.com/companies/news/1098152/spire-healthcare-agrees-1-03-billion-takeover-as-management-reshuffles-1098152.html)); Fidelity International holds approximately 10% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/healthcare/lse-spi/spire-healthcare-group-shares/ownership)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider/management ownership is small, estimated at roughly 0.34% per TipRanks aggregator data; the company is institutionally rather than insider-controlled. [TipRanks ownership data](https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/gb:spi/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: Active take-private transaction: Spire's board has recommended a cash takeover by Tulip UK Bidco Limited (backed by Toscafund, Three Hills and Ares Management) at 250p/share, with CEO Justin Ash stepping down and shareholders representing 53.4% of stock already committed to support the deal as of the most recent reporting found; this is a live, material corporate event for current/prospective shareholders to track. [ProActive Investors - Spire takeover agreement](https://www.proactiveinvestors.com/companies/news/1098152/spire-healthcare-agrees-1-03-billion-takeover-as-management-reshuffles-1098152.html)

thesis.business_description: IDI (IDI S.C.A.) is a Paris-based private equity investment company making leveraged buyout (LBO) and growth-capital investments in small and mid-cap companies, primarily in France and Europe, investing both on its own balance sheet and for third parties.
thesis.competitive_position: IDI is a listed French private-equity holding vehicle with a multi-decade LBO/growth-capital track record; its structure as a société en commandite par actions (partnership limited by shares) gives its managing general partner, Ancelle & Associés, entrenched control regardless of the free float's wishes - an important governance feature for outside investors to understand. [AlphaValue - IDI company analysis](https://corporate.alphavalue.com/Secure/Handlers/LatestHandler/74b308ae-041d-ec11-8593-00155d3d3b01/IDI_24092021.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Ancelle & Associés is the controlling managing general partner (gérant-commandité); an older capital-increase report showed Ancelle/Financière Neuilly Madrid's stake moving from 78.1% to 62.2% of capital (publication context suggests ~2008) ([TradingSat](https://www.tradingsat.com/idi-FR0000051393/actualites/idi-leve-578-millions-d-euros-par-augmentation-de-capital-387876.html)); a more recent indicative breakdown (as of 1 June 2026, approximate/not fully reconciled with threshold-crossing filings) shows insiders/related entities at roughly 70.2% and institutional investors at roughly 5.6% ([aggregator data cited via rendementbourse.com](https://rendementbourse.com/idip-idi/assemblee-generale)). FFP (the Peugeot family's holding company) was reported as the second-largest shareholder at 10.1% of capital as of January 2010 ([AMF filing, Jan 2010](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/CNS/2010/01/FCCNS024782_20100119.pdf)), and Allianz SE has also been named as a minority shareholder in an undated directory source - this should be verified against current AMF filings.
thesis.insider_ownership: IDI's management describes the company as controlled and majority-owned by its own teams via Ancelle & Associés; combined insider/related-party ownership is estimated around 70% per the most recent (approximate) breakdown found, making this an insider/management-controlled investment vehicle rather than a widely-held one. Figures should be cross-checked against IDI's annual report and AMF franchissements de seuils filings for precision.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; note the partnership (SCA) legal structure entrenches the managing general partner's control irrespective of free-float shareholder votes, which is a structural governance consideration (not a scandal) for minority investors.

thesis.business_description: Netcall plc is a UK software company providing cloud-based customer engagement and process automation software, principally its Liberty platform (omnichannel contact centre, workforce optimisation) and MATS low-code application platform, sold to healthcare (including NHS trusts), telecoms, financial services and local government customers.
thesis.competitive_position: Netcall is a mid-sized, profitable AIM-listed software vendor with deep penetration into the UK public sector and NHS (serving roughly two-thirds of NHS Acute Health Trusts) and blue-chip accounts such as BT, Lloyds Banking Group, ITV and Nationwide, giving it a defensible niche in regulated/public-sector contact-centre and low-code workflow software rather than scale versus global CCaaS players. [Netcall company profile / investegate](https://investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/netcall--net/director-pdmr-shareholding/1910727)
thesis.main_shareholders: Institutional/VC holders dominate the register: Gresham House Asset Management (WS Gresham House UK Micro Cap Fund) around 24%, Rathbones/Investec Wealth & Investment collectively near the 10% notifiable threshold, Octopus Investments around 7-14% (sources vary by date), Liontrust around 6%, and Business Growth Fund (BGF) around 4-6%; Artemis Investment Management notified at 3.27%. Figures come from different dated snapshots and should be checked against the latest RNS holdings notices. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/software/aim-net/netcall-shares/ownership), [Investegate holdings RNS](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/netcall--net/holding-s-in-company/1609392)
thesis.insider_ownership: Henrik Bang, long-serving CEO (joined 2004) and now Non-Executive Chairman (since Jan 2024), holds roughly 2.6% (~4.46m shares), though he sold ~1.7m shares in January 2025. Chairman predecessor Michael Jackson held about 0.84% (1.2m shares) as of a December 2018 disclosure. No named founder's stake was identified (company incorporated 1984 as Ackrill Carr plc). Aggregate individual-insider ownership is estimated at roughly 5% of the register by Simply Wall St. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/software/aim-net/netcall-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. Recent RNS disclosures describe routine board succession (new CFO and NED appointed, 2023) and standard governance-strengthening statements; no litigation, dilution, or auditor concerns surfaced in search. [LSE RNS - Result of AGM](https://www.lse.co.uk/rns/result-of-agm-d8u3bkb15kb7845.html)

thesis.business_description: Alumil Rom Industry S.A. is a Bucharest-based manufacturer of aluminium architectural/construction profile systems and related hardware (window and door locks, hinges, handles, glass and surface treatments), founded in 1988 and listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange since 2007.
thesis.competitive_position: The company is positioned as a leading player in the Romanian architectural aluminium systems market, operating as the local manufacturing/distribution arm of Greece's Alumil group, giving it access to group-wide product R&D and brand while serving the domestic construction and renovation market. [ZF.ro](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/bursa-alumil-rom-industry-lider-pe-piata-sistemelor-arhitecturale-de-23163153)
thesis.main_shareholders: Alumil S.A. (Alumil Aluminium Industry S.A., the Greek parent headquartered in Kilkis, Greece) holds approximately 55.9%; businessman Michail Sotiriou holds approximately 24%; the remainder (~20%) is free float dating to the 2007 IPO. [ZF.ro / BVB data](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/bursa-alumil-rom-industry-lider-pe-piata-sistemelor-arhitecturale-de-23163153), [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/ro/materials/bvb-alu/alumil-rom-industry-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Michail Sotiriou's ~24% personal stake (separate from the Alumil corporate parent's 55.9%) is the main individually-held/insider-type position identified; General Manager is Marius Ionita, but no separate management shareholding was disclosed in the sources found. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/ro/materials/bvb-alu/alumil-rom-industry-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; the company is majority-controlled by its Greek parent (standard related-party/control structure for a controlled subsidiary, but no specific dispute or dilution event was found). Recent (2026) interim results showed improving profit and declining debt. [Bursa.ro](https://www.bursa.ro/cel-mai-bun-plasament-in-perioada-30-august-6-septembrie-avans-de-5-11-procente-pentru-alumil-rom-industry-65582538)

thesis.business_description: SinterCast AB is a Swedish technology company that supplies process control systems (the System 4000) for the high-volume, reliable production of Compacted Graphite Iron (CGI), a stronger/lighter metal used by engine and component makers; founded in 1983, headquartered in Katrineholm.
thesis.competitive_position: SinterCast describes itself as the world's leading supplier of CGI process control technology, with an installed base of around 58 licensed installations across 13 countries as of its latest disclosures - a narrow, technology-licensing niche business with high switching costs for customers once installed, though volumes are tied to cyclical heavy-engine/automotive demand. [SinterCast investor release](https://storage.mfn.se/5c6a0152-b6b4-4129-80b9-067af7296541/press-release-pdf-english-version.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Inderes (Millistream data): Ulf Stenbeck ~9.3%, Avanza Pension ~8.1%, Torbjörn Gustafsson ~4.6%, Nordnet Pension ~4.5%, Canaccord Genuity Wealth Management ~3.7%, Lazard Frères Gestion ~3.3%, Jan Olof Brandels ~3.2%, Måns Flodberg ~2.6%. The four Nomination Committee members (Stenbeck, Gustafsson, Canaccord's David Walton, and Einar Ahlström) together represent 24% of shares as of 31 Aug 2025. [Inderes ownership](https://www.inderes.se/en/companies/SinterCast/ownership), [Nomination committee release](https://storage.mfn.se/396016b4-7463-45d2-ac39-a7d7345e065d/nomination-committee-en.pdf)
thesis.insider_ownership: No named company founder/executive holds a large disclosed stake distinct from the above investor-shareholders; incoming Managing Director Dr. Vitor Anjos made a small insider purchase of 400 shares in September 2025, and outgoing CEO Dr. Steve Dawson remains on the board. Simply Wall St's aggregate category split (dated, unverified against Inderes) put 'individual insiders' at roughly 29%, which likely includes Stenbeck and other large individual holders rather than pure management. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stock/om/sint)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. The company has never paid dividends, which is a disclosed policy choice rather than a governance red flag. Leadership transition (CEO handover from Dawson to Anjos) completed at the May 2026 AGM appears orderly. [SinterCast AGM release](https://www.sintercast.com/media/2589/sintercast-annual-general-meeting-2025.pdf)

thesis.business_description: We.Connect SA is a French distributor that designs, manufactures and distributes computer, peripheral and electronic equipment to professional customers, including computers, monitors, multimedia products, storage products and accessories; formed in 2015 from the merger of Techniline and Groupe Unika.
thesis.competitive_position: A French B2B IT hardware distributor with approximately EUR 265 million in revenue and approximately EUR 12 million EBITDA (2023), operating in the low-margin, competitive IT distribution sector. [Alluvial Capital](https://alluvialcapital.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/ACM-We.Connect-Deck.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Gorsd brothers together hold over 80% of the company: Moshey Gorsd (CEO) holds approximately 53.2% and Yossef Gorsd (board member) holds approximately 23.6%. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/WE-CONNECT-162442/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Very high founder/insider ownership: CEO Moshey Gorsd and board member Yossef Gorsd together control over 80% of the company, making it effectively a founder-controlled business despite its public listing. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/WE-CONNECT-162442/company/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Jersey Electricity plc is the vertically integrated monopoly electricity utility for the island of Jersey, importing, generating, transmitting and distributing power (around 95% imported via three undersea cables from low-carbon French sources), alongside smaller businesses in building services, retail (Powerhouse), property and utility software/consultancy.
thesis.competitive_position: As the sole licensed electricity supplier to Jersey, JEL holds a regulated natural monopoly in its core market, generating over 80% of group revenue and operating profit from electricity; its diversified smaller units (retail, property, building services) provide modest additional earnings but the investment case is dominated by the regulated utility's stable cash flows. [Edison Investment Research](https://www.edisongroup.com/research/strong-cash-generation/)
thesis.main_shareholders: The States of Jersey (the island's government) is the controlling shareholder, holding approximately 62% of ordinary share capital and a disproportionately larger ~82-86% of voting rights (sources vary by year: 86.4% per a 2019 Edison note, 82% per a 2016 note). The remaining ~38% of shares trades on the London Stock Exchange among roughly 300 shareholders; institutional investor Utilico Ltd previously held just over 20% of ordinary share capital (per a 2008-dated States of Jersey proposition). [Edison Investment Research](https://www.edisongroup.com/research/jersey-electricity/15875/), [States Assembly proposition P.41/2009](https://statesassembly.je/publications/propositions/2009/p-41-2009)
thesis.insider_ownership: No specific director/management shareholding percentages were found in this search; given the dominant States of Jersey stake and dual-class voting structure, free-float insider ownership is likely small, but this could not be independently confirmed.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. The dual-class structure (62% of capital commanding 82-86% of votes) concentrates control with the States of Jersey, which is disclosed and long-standing rather than a new governance concern.

thesis.business_description: Criteo S.A. is a France-founded (recently converting its domicile to Luxembourg) commerce media and advertising technology company whose platform turns shopper/ecommerce data signals into personalized advertising, historically centered on dynamic product retargeting and now spanning demand-side, supply-side and retail-media monetization tools for retailers, brands and publishers.
thesis.competitive_position: Criteo built its original scale on ad retargeting powered by AI trained on roughly $1 trillion in annual ecommerce sales data, and has been diversifying into commerce/retail media as retargeting has declined in relative importance amid privacy changes (e.g., reduced reliance on third-party cookies) and competition from Google's search/display ecosystem; the company is currently the subject of a take-private approach, reflecting perceived undervaluation relative to private-market interest.
thesis.main_shareholders: Neuberger Berman Investment Advisers LLC (~15.82%), Morgan Stanley (~9.77%), DNB Asset Management AS (~9.22%), Senvest Management, LLC (~9.15%); institutional ownership overall ~83.95% ([TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/markets/stocks/crto/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: ~12.61% held by insiders in aggregate, per ownership-structure data; largest individual insider holder is Till Hufnagel at ~3.74%
thesis.red_flags: Known recent corporate action: Criteo is subject to a take-private approach from Vista Equity Partners and Quinti Capital at a reported 50%+ premium (implying ~$3.7bn equity value, >$50/share), submitted around the time of Criteo's shareholder-approved redomiciliation from France to Luxembourg (completed vote Feb 2026); the board has not yet decided how to respond, creating deal-completion and valuation uncertainty for the thesis. ([ppc.land](https://ppc.land/vista-equity-and-quinti-capital-offer-50-premium-for-criteo-sources-say/))

thesis.business_description: FRoSTA Aktiengesellschaft is a Bremerhaven-based German frozen food producer, developing, manufacturing and marketing frozen fish, vegetables, fruits, herbs and ready meals sold under the FRoSTA brand, private label, and foodservice channels across Germany, Poland, Austria, Italy and Eastern Europe.
thesis.competitive_position: FRoSTA is a well-established branded player in the German frozen-food category, known for its 'clean label' (additive-free) positioning that it pioneered roughly two decades ago, supplying both its own brand and private-label product to major retailers such as Aldi, Lidl and Norma - a differentiated niche versus lower-cost private-label-only competitors. [Emerald Insight case study](https://emerald.com/insight/content/doi/10.1108/978-1-80455-840-920231005)
thesis.main_shareholders: Controlled by the founding Ahlers family across three generations; sources disagree on exact current split - the company's own investor page cites Felix Ahlers 25.8% and Dirk Ahlers 10.0% (free float 56.3%), while the FAQ page cites Felix Ahlers at 33.7% and Dirk Ahlers at 10%; a 2015 trade report put their combined stake at 52.9%, and an academic case study describes family ownership at 'just under 50%.' The family is reported to hold a majority (over 50%) in at least two sources. [FRoSTA investor relations](https://www.frosta-ag.com/en/investor-relations/facts-and-figures/), [FRoSTA FAQ](https://www.frosta-ag.com/en/service/faq/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Management and control rest with the Ahlers family: Felix Ahlers is Chairman of the Executive Board & CEO, with a disclosed stake of either ~25.8% or ~33.7% depending on source/date; his father Dirk Ahlers (former CEO) holds ~10%; Friederike Ahlers handles public relations for the family. This is a classic founder/family-controlled structure now in its third generation. [FRoSTA investor relations](https://www.frosta-ag.com/en/investor-relations/facts-and-figures/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. The inconsistency in publicly stated family ownership percentages across the company's own IR page, FAQ, and media reports (ranging ~26% to ~53%+) is a data-quality/disclosure-clarity note worth flagging for diligence, though not evidence of wrongdoing.

thesis.business_description: BioPharma Credit PLC is a UK-listed closed-ended investment trust that provides debt financing (loans and royalty-backed credit) secured against cash flows from approved, commercialized life-sciences/pharmaceutical products, aiming to generate income for shareholders.
thesis.competitive_position: BioPharma Credit occupies a specialist niche in pharma royalty/credit lending, externally managed by Pharmakon Advisors LP (led by co-founder Pedro Gonzalez de Cosio), which sources and underwrites a diversified portfolio of approved-product-backed loans designed for cash-flow stability and downside protection versus equity biotech exposure. [BioPharma Credit Investor Update](https://bpcruk.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/BioPharma-Credit-PLC-Investor-Update-December-2023.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: No major shareholder register was found in this search; as a UK investment trust, its shares are widely held by retail and institutional investors via the London Stock Exchange. The shares have traded at a persistent discount to NAV (e.g., -15.42% as of December 2023), prompting buybacks. [BioPharma Credit Investor Update Feb 2024](https://bpcruk.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/BioPharma-Credit-PLC-Investor-Update-February-2024.pdf)
thesis.insider_ownership: Directors include Pedro Gonzalez de Cosio, Martin Friedman and Pablo Legorreta (all affiliated with Pharmakon Advisors, the investment manager) with Harry Hyman as independent Chairman; specific personal shareholding percentages for these directors were not found and, as an externally-managed investment trust, meaningful 'insider' equity ownership in the traditional operating-company sense is not typically disclosed or expected. [BioPharma Credit factsheet](https://bpcruk.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/BioPharma-Credit-PLC-Investor-Update-May-2023.pdf)
thesis.red_flags: Shares have traded at a material discount to NAV (around -15% in late 2023/early 2024), which the company itself noted constrains its ability to make new investments while trading below NAV - a structural/valuation concern rather than a governance one. No litigation, auditor or related-party issues were identified. [BioPharma Credit Investor Update Feb 2024](https://bpcruk.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/BioPharma-Credit-PLC-Investor-Update-February-2024.pdf)

name: Zwack Unicum Likoripari és Kereskedelmi Nyilvánosan Muködo Részvénytársaság

thesis.business_description: Zwack Unicum Nyrt. is a Hungarian producer and distributor of spirits, most notably its namesake Unicum herbal liqueur, with a history dating to the Zwack family's 18th-century recipe and reclaimed post-communist privatization business, listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
thesis.competitive_position: Zwack Unicum holds a dominant, iconic position in the Hungarian bitters/liqueur category with its heritage Unicum brand, strengthened by a strategic partnership with global spirits major Diageo, which gives it international distribution reach alongside its family-controlled domestic leadership. [Budapest Stock Exchange company profile](https://bse.hu/pages/company_profile/$security/ZWACK)
thesis.main_shareholders: Peter Zwack & Consorten AG (the Zwack family holding vehicle, PZAG) controls a majority stake of 50%+1 share; Diageo Netherlands B.V. holds 26% as a strategic investor. The remaining free float is held by other shareholders. [Budapest Stock Exchange](https://bse.hu/pages/company_profile/$security/ZWACK), [mandadb.hu family history](https://en.mandadb.hu/cikk/951263/A_unique_liqueur_and_family_story)
thesis.insider_ownership: Family control is exercised through Peter Zwack & Consorten AG (50%+1); Sándor Zwack (son of the late Péter Zwack, who led the post-1989 reclamation of the business) has chaired the board since his father handed over leadership in 2008, representing the sixth generation of family involvement; CEO is reported as Csaba Belovai in more recent sources. [mandadb.hu](https://en.mandadb.hu/cikk/951263/A_unique_liqueur_and_family_story)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. The company has a long, stable family-control history since 1991 privatization; no disputes, dilution, or auditor issues surfaced in search.

thesis.business_description: Sjóvá-Almennar tryggingar hf. is one of Iceland's leading insurance companies, offering property/casualty, motor, marine and other general insurance products to retail and commercial customers, listed on Nasdaq Iceland.
thesis.competitive_position: Sjóvá is one of a small number of established insurers in Iceland's concentrated domestic insurance market, giving it meaningful domestic market share; specific market-share figures were not found in this search. [Snowball Analytics](https://snowball-analytics.com/public/asset/SJOVA.IC.ISK)
thesis.main_shareholders: Historical ownership: in 2011, the Central Bank of Iceland's asset-management arm ESÍ sold 52.4% of outstanding shares (834,481,001 shares) to SF1 slhf., a limited partnership managed by Stefnir hf., retaining a 20.6% stake itself at the time. This is a 2011 snapshot and current ownership could not be confirmed from available sources. [Central Bank of Iceland](https://cb.is/publications/news/news/2011/07/28/ESÍ-sells-stake-in-Sjóvá-Almennar-tryggingar)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed in sources found; no current management/board shareholding data was located. Could not verify.
thesis.red_flags: Could not verify current state; no specific current governance concerns were found, but the 2011 sale followed Sjóvá's 2009-2010 financial difficulties and government-backed recapitalization during Iceland's post-financial-crisis banking restructuring, a historical event worth noting for context though not a current-state red flag. [Central Bank of Iceland](https://cb.is/publications/news/news/2011/07/28/ESÍ-sells-stake-in-Sjóvá-Almennar-tryggingar)

thesis.business_description: Platzer Fastigheter Holding AB is a Gothenburg-based Swedish commercial real estate company that owns, manages and develops office, retail and other commercial properties primarily in the Gothenburg region; founded in 1969.
thesis.competitive_position: Platzer is a regionally-focused commercial landlord concentrated in the Gothenburg metropolitan area, giving it local market knowledge and relationships versus nationally-diversified Swedish REITs, though this also concentrates its risk to one regional economy. [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/real-estate-management-and-development/sto-plaz-b/platzer-fastigheter-holding-shares/ownership)
thesis.main_shareholders: Ernström & Co AB ~15% (~18m shares); Familjen Hielte/Hobohm (a family holding entity) ~14.5-14.7% (~17.3m shares); Länsförsäkringar Göteborg och Bohuslän ~13.7% (~16.4m shares); Länsförsäkringar Fondförvaltning AB ~7.2%; Lf Skaraborg Förvaltning AB ~5.4%. Top 25 shareholders own ~85% of the company. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/real-estate-management-and-development/sto-plaz-b/platzer-fastigheter-holding-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insider ownership is reported as under 1% of the register by Simply Wall St's category breakdown; recent disclosed insider transactions include Karoliina Callavik selling ~171,000 shares (May 2025) and Henrik Schoultz buying 2,500 shares (July 2025). No evidence found linking the 'Platzer' name itself to a controlling family stake distinct from Ernström & Co or Familjen Hielte/Hobohm. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/real-estate-management-and-development/sto-plaz-b/platzer-fastigheter-holding-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Quartix Technologies plc is a UK-based provider of subscription-based vehicle tracking and fleet management systems (GPS telematics hardware and software) for commercial fleets and insurance telematics, founded in 2001.
thesis.competitive_position: Quartix is an established, profitable niche player in the vehicle telematics/fleet tracking market with a long operating history (founded 2001) and a subscription-revenue model; it has experienced recent management turbulence (CEO departure, founder's return as chairman) that could affect strategic continuity. [AJ Bell news](https://streaming1.www.ajbell.co.uk/articles/latestnews/266309/quartix-non-executive-chair-resigns-board-replaced-founder)
thesis.main_shareholders: Not fully disclosed in sources found with specific percentages for most holders; founder Andy Walters is described as having a 'significant shareholding' that the board cited as a reason to add an additional independent director, but his exact percentage was not found. For current detail, Quartix's RNS holdings notices would need to be checked directly.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder Andy Walters returned to the board as Non-Executive Chairman in September 2023 and then became Executive Chairman after CEO Richard Lilwall's departure, reflecting strong founder influence over governance; his personal shareholding percentage is not disclosed in the sources found but was explicitly cited by the company as 'significant.' Separately, director Glen Middleton and his wife Georgina Middleton held a combined 52,294 ordinary shares as of a December 2025 PDMR filing (a minor holding, not a major stake). [AJ Bell - founder replaces chair](https://streaming1.www.ajbell.co.uk/articles/latestnews/266309/quartix-non-executive-chair-resigns-board-replaced-founder), [Stockopedia PDMR filing](https://www-proxy.stockopedia.com/share-prices/quartix-technologies-LON:QTX/news/reg-quartix-technologies-director-pdmr-shareholding-urn:newsml:reuters.com:20251215:nRSO6535La)
thesis.red_flags: Notable management turbulence in 2023: the Non-Executive Chairman resigned and was replaced by founder Andy Walters, who shortly after also saw the CEO (Richard Lilwall) step down and leave the company, with Walters becoming Executive Chairman. This sequence of leadership changes, partly attributed by outside commentary to founder dissatisfaction with prior management, is worth noting as a governance watch-item, though not necessarily a red flag in the fraud/litigation sense. [AJ Bell - CEO steps down](https://streaming1.www.ajbell.co.uk/articles/latestnews/267015/brief-quartix-technologies-chief-executive-steps-down)

thesis.business_description: Micro Systemation AB (MSAB) is a Swedish software company providing digital forensics and mobile device data-extraction technology (e.g., XRY) used by law enforcement, government and corporate investigators worldwide.
thesis.competitive_position: MSAB is a recognized specialist/niche leader in mobile forensics software for law enforcement and intelligence customers globally, a position built over many years, though it faces competition from other digital-forensics vendors (e.g., Cellebrite) and sources did not quantify relative market share. [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/software/sto-msab-b/micro-systemation-shares/ownership)
thesis.main_shareholders: Ownership is concentrated among a handful of funds/family vehicles following a 2021 share sale: AB Grenspecialisten, Edastra AB/Ltd and Cervantes Capital AB jointly acquired founder Henrik Tjernberg's A-shares in April 2021. Per Inderes (Millistream): Alcur Select ~18.4% of capital/12.5% of votes, Nordnet Pensionsförsäkring ~10.2%/6.9%, AB Grenspecialisten ~9.9% capital/23.5% votes (reflecting A-share voting power), Edastra Ltd ~6.5%/15.5%. [Inderes ownership](https://www.inderes.se/en/companies/Micro-Systemation/ownership), [MSAB press release - 2021 ownership change](https://investors.msab.com/investors/newsroom/press-releases/2021/change-of-ownership-in-micro-systemation-ab/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder Henrik Tjernberg sold his entire A-share (high-vote) stake in April 2021 to AB Grenspecialisten, Edastra and Cervantes Capital, meaning founder ownership has effectively ended; individual-insider ownership in Simply Wall St's category breakdown is roughly 1% of the register, with the register now dominated by funds and family investment vehicles (Grenspecialisten and Edastra hold outsized voting power via A-shares). [MSAB press release](https://investors.msab.com/investors/newsroom/press-releases/2021/change-of-ownership-in-micro-systemation-ab/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. The 2021 sale of the founder's entire voting stake to a small group of holders concentrated A-share voting control (e.g., Grenspecialisten ~23.5% of votes vs ~9.9% of capital) - a dual-class control-concentration structure worth noting for governance diligence, though disclosed and not itself a violation. [MSAB press release](https://investors.msab.com/investors/newsroom/press-releases/2021/change-of-ownership-in-micro-systemation-ab/)

thesis.business_description: SBO AG (formerly Schoeller-Bleckmann Oilfield Equipment AG) is an Austrian manufacturer of high-precision components and equipment for the oil and gas drilling industry (downhole tools, drill collars and related equipment), listed on the Vienna Stock Exchange (ATX).
thesis.competitive_position: SBO is a long-established, specialist manufacturer of precision oilfield drilling equipment, historically regarded as a leading global niche supplier of drill collars and downhole tools to the oilfield services industry; detailed current market-share data was not found in this search. [Boerse-express](https://www.boerse-express.com/boerse/aktie/schoeller-bleckmann-ag+tts-666437/firmenprofil)
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in sources found with specific percentages; the company's 2025 AGM approved a name change to SBO AG and a dividend of EUR 1.75/share, but no major-shareholder breakdown was located. Could not verify current ownership structure from available sources.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed in sources found. Brigitte Ederer was re-elected to the Supervisory Board for a four-year term at the 2025 AGM, but no personal shareholding data was found for board members. [Boerse-express AGM release](https://www.boerse-express.com/news/articles/eqs-news-schoeller-bleckmann-oilfield-equipment-ag-annual-general-meeting-approves-company-name-change-to-sbo-ag-and-a-dividend-payment-of-eur-175-per-share-775118)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. The 2025 AGM discharged both the Executive and Supervisory Boards for fiscal 2024, a routine governance action.

thesis.business_description: SLOMAN NEPTUN Schiffahrts-Aktiengesellschaft is a Bremen-based German shipping company (founded 1873) that owns and operates a fleet of gas tankers, oil/chemical tankers and dry cargo vessels worldwide, and also offers liner and port agency services.
thesis.competitive_position: SLOMAN NEPTUN is a long-established (152-year-old) niche shipowner/operator specializing in gas and chemical/product tankers (capacities up to 35,000 DWT) and a founding member of the UNIGAS Consortium (since 1969) for gas shipping cooperation, giving it an established position in specialized tanker segments rather than bulk/container shipping scale. [SLOMAN NEPTUN - About Us](https://sloman-neptun.com/about-us)
thesis.main_shareholders: The company is a subsidiary of Rob. M. Sloman & Co., per third-party aggregator data; it is a thinly-traded Hamburg-exchange-listed stock (2.00m shares outstanding) and the company's own site states that shareholder information is published only in German, limiting English-language verification of the full register. [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/de/transportation/hmse-nep/sloman-neptun-schiffahrts-aktiengesellschaft-shares/information)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed in sources found in English; given the Rob. M. Sloman & Co. parent/controlling relationship, insider and family (Sloman family legacy name) control appears likely but could not be independently quantified from available English-language sources. Could not verify specific percentages.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources, though the limited English-language disclosure (shareholder information published only in German) and thin free float/trading on the smaller Hamburg exchange reduce transparency for non-German-speaking investors - a diligence consideration rather than a confirmed governance issue.

thesis.business_description: Atlanta Poland S.A. is a Gdańsk-based company that trades, processes and retails nuts and dried fruits for the confectionery and bakery industries, and sells sweets and dried fruit products under its own Bakal and Kujawianka brands; founded in 1990.
thesis.competitive_position: Atlanta Poland is an established, long-running Polish nut/dried-fruit processor and brand owner (Bakal, Kujawianka) serving both B2B (confectionery/bakery) and retail consumer channels, giving it diversified demand but exposure to volatile global soft-commodity (nuts, dried fruit) input costs. [Yahoo Finance company profile](https://au.finance.yahoo.com/quote/ATP.WA/profile?p=ATP.WA)
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder Dariusz Mazur controls the company with a dominant stake, held indirectly through Rockfield Holding AG and Rockfield Jurata Sp. z o.o.: a 2021 disclosure put this combined holding at 3,627,888 shares (59.55% of capital and votes); an August 2026 investor-site snapshot shows Mazur at 59.47%, Dariusz Orłowski at 9.99%, Generali OFE at 7.58%, and Paweł Cichosz at 6.39% (together 83.43%, free float 16.57%). [Parkiet ESPI notice](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art26739911-atlantapl-powolanie-osob-nadzorujacych), [Strefainwestorow.pl shareholder table](https://strefainwestorow.pl/notowania/spolki/PLATLPL00018/akcjonariat)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder Dariusz Mazur is both the controlling shareholder (~59-60%, held via Rockfield entities) and described in company disclosures as the company's founder and indirect main shareholder - a clear founder-controlled structure. [Parkiet ESPI notice](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art26739911-atlantapl-powolanie-osob-nadzorujacych)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources beyond the standard concentration-of-control considerations inherent in a ~60% founder-controlled free float structure; no litigation, dilution or auditor issues were found in this search.

thesis.business_description: Luceco plc is a UK-based manufacturer and distributor of LED lighting products and wiring accessories, operating brands including Luceco (LED lighting), British General (wiring accessories), Masterplug (portable power) and Ross (AV accessories).
thesis.competitive_position: Luceco is a mid-cap UK electrical products manufacturer/distributor with a portfolio of recognized trade brands across lighting, wiring and power accessories, though its 2017-2018 inventory-valuation/accounting restatement episode and 2022 destocking-driven profit warning highlight historical volatility in margins and controls. [Sharecast - accounting error](https://sharecast.com/amp/news/news-and-announcements/luceco-issues-profit-warning-after-accounting-error--3031507.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: CEO Jonathan (John) Hornby holds approximately 16.9-18.9% depending on listing/date; EPIC Investment Partners LLP holds approximately 23.3%; BlackRock, Inc. holds approximately 10.4%; Record Plc ESOP holds approximately 6.71%; Chairman Giles Brand holds approximately 6.21%. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/capital-goods/lse-luce/luceco-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Jonathan Hornby is the largest individual/insider holder at roughly 16.9-18.9%; Chairman Giles Brand holds roughly 6.21%. No source identified Hornby as the company's original founder; a separate founder, John Harding, founded Kingfisher Lighting, a business Luceco acquired in 2017 for £9.75m from Harding and his wife Barbara as retiring founder/major shareholders - a different, acquired entity rather than Luceco itself. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/capital-goods/lse-luce/luceco-shares/ownership), [Legal Futures - Kingfisher Lighting sale](https://www.legalfutures.co.uk/associate-news/aaron-partners-llp-cooper-parry-corporate-finance-advise-sale-kingfisher-lighting-limited-luceco-plc/print/)
thesis.red_flags: Significant historical accounting/control failure: in December 2017 Luceco warned that an incorrectly calculated inventory valuation had masked gross-margin deterioration, its Financial Controller resigned, and a further March 2018 review found errors in historic financial information requiring a restatement; shares fell from 232p to as low as 50p during this period. A separate 2022 profit warning was attributed to customer destocking rather than accounting issues. [CityAM](https://www.cityam.com/?p=2068604), [Shares Magazine](https://sharesmagazine.co.uk/news/shares/is-lighting-provider-luceco-over-its-stock-accounting-calamity), [AJ Bell - 2022 warning](https://streaming1.www.ajbell.co.uk/articles/latestnews/251540/brief-luceco-warns-2022-profit-be-below-estimates-destocking)

name: ECO Animal Health Group plc
gmSourceUrl: [ECO Animal Health Group plc Annual Report 2024](https://ecoanimalhealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/ECO-Animal-Health_Group-plc_Annual_Report_2024_FINAL.pdf)

thesis.business_description: ECO Animal Health Group plc is a UK-based international animal health company that develops, manufactures and markets medicines for livestock and companion animals, with a focus on anti-infectives (e.g., its tylvalosin/Aivlosin product line).
thesis.competitive_position: ECO Animal Health is a specialist, mid-sized player in the global animal-health pharmaceuticals market with an established anti-infective franchise, competing against larger diversified animal-health companies; its recent expansion of product range (2024) suggests ongoing efforts to broaden its niche. [Morningstar UK news](https://morningstar.co.uk/uk/news/AN_1721044186703528500/eco-animal-targets-sustained-growth-with-expanded-product-range.aspx)
thesis.main_shareholders: Schroder Investment Management Limited holds approximately 17.4%; Soros Fund Management LLC holds approximately 11.2%; founder Peter Lawrence holds approximately 9.59%; Fidelity International Ltd holds approximately 6.91%; Killik & Co LLP has been notified as crossing 3.0138% of total voting rights. Figures are from a Simply Wall St (S&P Global-sourced) snapshot that may not reflect the most current register. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/pharmaceuticals-biotech/aim-eah/eco-animal-health-group-shares/ownership), [TipRanks - Killik threshold notice](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/eco-animal-health-group-sees-shift-in-major-shareholdings)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder Peter Anthony Lawrence (director of predecessor ECO Animal Health Ltd. from 1991-2019, and Non-Executive Chairman of the group 2018-2019) holds approximately 9.59% - a meaningful founder stake.
