thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search.

thesis.business_description: FBD Holdings plc is an Irish general insurer, founded in the 1960s by and for farmers, now providing motor, home, farm and business insurance to farmers, businesses and retail customers across Ireland; it is the only major general insurer incorporated and based in Ireland.
thesis.competitive_position: FBD holds a dominant position in the Irish farm insurance niche - commanding over 70% (per a 2024 Cantor Fitzgerald note) to as much as 80% (per older reporting) market share of the farm segment - reflecting deep historical roots and a farmer-ownership heritage that differentiates it from internationally-owned competitors in the broader Irish general insurance market. [Cantor Fitzgerald analyst note](https://cantorfitzgerald.ie/analyst-conviction-list-fbd-insurance), [Farmers Journal](https://www.farmersjournal.ie/dempsey-at-large-the-co-op-share-dilemma-872880)
thesis.main_shareholders: A farmer-owned holding entity retains what has been described as a blocking stake of around 24.6-25% in FBD Holdings, with transfer of these shares tightly restricted similar to a cooperative structure, intended to preserve farmer influence over the insurer; some farmer-shareholders have periodically pushed to sell this stake (estimated proceeds of ~€140m in one account) and distribute proceeds. These figures are from Irish Farmers Journal reporting dated 2014 and later commentary, and may not reflect the current precise percentage. [Farmers Journal - the co-op share dilemma](https://www.farmersjournal.ie/dempsey-at-large-the-co-op-share-dilemma-872880)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed with specific current board/management percentages in sources found beyond the farmer-holding-entity structure described above; could not verify individual director stakes.
thesis.red_flags: Storm Éowyn (January 2025) was described by FBD itself as the largest weather event in the company's history, driving ~9,000 claims and a net cost (after reinsurance) of approximately €30.8m for full-year 2025, contributing to a pretax profit decline to €54.1m (from €77.0m) and a combined ratio rising to 90.8% (from 84.9%); this is a disclosed catastrophe-claims event rather than a governance red flag, but is material to near-term earnings volatility. There is also an ongoing, publicly aired internal debate among farmer-shareholders about whether to sell the ~25% farmer-held blocking stake, a governance/strategic tension worth monitoring. [FBD 2025 Full Year Results Statement](https://www.fbdgroup.com/media/fbdgroup/files/2025_Full_Year_Results_Statement.pdf), [Farmers Journal](https://www.farmersjournal.ie/dempsey-at-large-the-co-op-share-dilemma-872880)

thesis.business_description: Sunex S.A. is a Racibórz, Poland-based manufacturer of renewable-heating equipment, including heat pumps, solar thermal collectors, thermosiphons, storage tanks, pump groups and related mounting systems; founded in 2002.
thesis.competitive_position: Sunex operates in the European heat pump/renewable heating equipment market, which an October 2024 IPOPEMA research note described as facing 'extremely difficult' market conditions, suggesting the company is a smaller regional manufacturer navigating a cyclical downturn in European heat-pump demand rather than holding a clearly dominant competitive position. [IPOPEMA research note](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/49778186/DOC.20241010.49778186.20241010_0811_SNX_EN_RA.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Per an October 2024 IPOPEMA research note: Polska Ekologia Sp. z o.o. holds approximately 43.84%, CEO Romuald Kałyciok holds approximately 24.68% individually, and other holders collectively hold approximately 31.48%. Some aggregators describe Sunex as a subsidiary of Polska Ekologia, though Polska Ekologia's ~44% stake alone is not a formal majority. [IPOPEMA research note](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/49778186/DOC.20241010.49778186.20241010_0811_SNX_EN_RA.pdf)
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO and President of the Management Board Romuald Kałyciok personally holds approximately 24.68% of shares, a substantial founder/management-level stake, in addition to his control influence over Polska Ekologia (the largest corporate shareholder at ~43.84%). [IPOPEMA research note](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/49778186/DOC.20241010.49778186.20241010_0811_SNX_EN_RA.pdf)
thesis.red_flags: The European heat pump market was described as facing 'extremely difficult' conditions as of October 2024, a sector-wide demand headwind rather than a company-specific governance issue; no litigation, dilution or auditor concerns were identified. [IPOPEMA research note](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/49778186/DOC.20241010.49778186.20241010_0811_SNX_EN_RA.pdf)

thesis.business_description: WASGAU Produktions & Handels AG is a German regional supermarket operator running more than 70 super- and discount markets, primarily in Saarland and the Palatinate region of Germany.
thesis.competitive_position: WASGAU is a regional German grocery retailer that has been drawn into the orbit of national players: REWE acquired a 51% stake in its parent holding company Wasgau Food Beteiligungs GmbH in 2013 (from the founding Hornbach family and the Hornbach foundation, which retained 49%), while Edeka Südwest separately holds just under 25% directly in the listed operating company WASGAU AG - giving the company a somewhat unusual dual-major-grocer ownership structure overlaying its regional retail footprint. [Lebensmittelpraxis - Rewe-Wasgau deal](https://lebensmittelpraxis.de/handel-archiv/8514-wasgau-deal-genehmigt.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: Wasgau Food Beteiligungs GmbH (the holding company, 51% REWE / 49% Hornbach Stiftung since the 2013 deal) holds approximately 53.1% of WASGAU AG's listed share capital; Edeka Südwest holds just under 25% directly in the operating company. The German competition authority (Bundeskartellamt) cleared REWE's majority stake in the parent but opened a separate review of the effects of the arrangement at the WASGAU subsidiary given the combined REWE/Edeka interest; the outcome of that review was not found. [Lebensmittelpraxis](https://lebensmittelpraxis.de/handel-archiv/8514-wasgau-deal-genehmigt.html)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founding Hornbach family influence has been reduced since 2013: the Hornbach Stiftung (foundation) retained a 49% stake in the parent holding company (implying an indirect ~26% economic interest in WASGAU AG), and family members Christian and Jan Hornbach were replaced on the supervisory board by REWE-nominated managers (Dr. Martin Küssner and Lionel Souque) in June 2013, with Christian Hornbach taking only a deputy seat. Management has also changed hands: Thomas Bings succeeded Ambroise Forssman-Trevedy as board spokesman on 1 January 2025. [Lebensmittelpraxis](https://lebensmittelpraxis.de/handel-archiv/8717-rewe-entsendet-zwei-neue-aufsichtsratsmitglieder.html)
thesis.red_flags: The 2013 REWE/Edeka combined ownership interest in WASGAU prompted a specific Bundeskartellamt competition review of effects at the subsidiary level (separate from the parent-level clearance); the outcome of this review could not be found in this search, so it should be checked directly if relevant to governance/competition risk. thesis.competitive_position: Pattern has grown through acquisitions (e.g., the 2022 purchase of knitting mill Zanni to expand in luxury knitwear) to build an integrated luxury production hub, targeting €140 million in turnover under its strategic plan through 2028 and expanding into new product categories - positioning it as a consolidator/supplier within the Italian luxury manufacturing supply chain rather than a brand owner itself. [Borsa Italiana price-sensitive notice](https://borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/price-sensitive/download/20164_143071_2024_oneinfo.html)

thesis.business_description: ANY Biztonsági Nyomda Nyrt. (formerly Állami Nyomda Nyrt., 'State Printing House') is a Hungarian security printing company producing banknote-grade secure documents, identity/travel documents, meal vouchers and related security printing products, listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
thesis.competitive_position: ANY holds an entrenched position in Hungarian security/government printing given its state-printing-house legacy, and has diversified into commercial products such as meal vouchers; specific market-share data was not found, but its historical role as the former state printer suggests incumbency advantages in government security-document contracts. [Privatbankar.hu](https://privatbankar.hu/cikkek/kkv/830-millioert-nyomjak-az-etkezesi-utalvanyokat-261607.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: Dr. Ákos Erdős, board chairman, held a combined stake (via EG Capital LLC and Fortunarum Kft.) of approximately 2.3 million shares as of a July 2023 disclosure (up from ~2.2 million shares in a November 2016 disclosure); against a rough market-cap-derived share count estimate (~14 million shares, not independently confirmed), this would imply roughly 16%, but this percentage is an approximation and not a confirmed, sourced figure. Gábor Zsámboki (CEO) held approximately 143,900 shares and György Gyergyák held 200,000 shares per the 2016 disclosure. [Company 2023 disclosure via BET](https://bet.hu/newkibdata/128925477/ANY230718ER01H.pdf), [Company 2016 disclosure via BET](https://bet.hu/newkibdata/122864167/ANY161121ER01H.pdf)

Current, up-to-date percentages could not be confirmed. [BET company disclosures](https://bet.hu/newkibdata/128925477/ANY230718ER01H.pdf)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; however, shareholder data found is dated (2016 and 2023 snapshots) and a current register should be checked directly.

thesis.business_description: Björn Borg AB is a Swedish sports and fashion brand company that owns and licenses the Björn Borg trademark globally for apparel, underwear, footwear, eyewear and accessories, listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2007.
thesis.competitive_position: Björn Borg AB fully owns the Björn Borg trademark (having acquired full rights from the tennis legend and the Dutch licensing entity Fabulous Licensing for 124 million kronor / ~$18 million in the mid-2000s) and operates as a brand management/licensing company in sports fashion, distinct from Björn Borg the person, who reportedly holds no equity stake in the company today. [Kullin.net](https://www.kullin.net/?p=501)
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Inderes (Millistream data): Nordnet Pension ~16.1%, Martin Bjäringer ~9.9%, Mats H Nilsson ~6.5%, Thomas Eklund ~5.6%, Vilhelm Schottenius (with family) ~5.6%, Avanza Pension ~5.3%, Lazard Frères Banque ~5.2%, Fredrik Lövstedt (via company) ~3.6%. Top 25 shareholders control approximately 85.85% of the company per Simply Wall St. [Inderes ownership](https://www.inderes.dk/en/companies/Bjorn-Borg/ownership), [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/consumer-durables/sto-borg/bjorn-borg-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Simply Wall St categorizes 'individual insiders' at approximately 41.9% of the register, which appears to include large individual holders such as Martin Bjäringer (~9.9%), Mats H Nilsson (~6.5%) and Vilhelm Schottenius with family (~5.6%) rather than company founder Björn Borg himself, who is reported (via a secondary/lower-authority source) to hold no equity in the company - his name is used solely under license. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/consumer-durables/sto-borg/bjorn-borg-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Mangata Holding S.A. is a Polish industrial holding company operating in three main segments: automotive-component forgings and machined parts (for automotive, agricultural and hydraulic industries), industrial valves and castings, and fasteners, exporting to roughly 70-75 countries.
thesis.competitive_position: Mangata is a diversified industrial-components manufacturer with automotive/machinery components generating roughly 58% of group revenue per investor commentary, giving it a broad international customer base across multiple end-markets (automotive, agriculture, hydraulics, valves, fasteners) that reduces single-sector dependency, though specific competitive/market-share positioning was not found. [Investor commentary cited in search](https://www.parkiet.com/spolka/Mangata_Holding)
thesis.main_shareholders: Ownership is concentrated but sources disagree on specifics: Bankier's shareholder page reports two large shareholders together hold 70.73% of shares/votes (names not specified in the excerpt found); a separate Simply Wall St article reports Avallon Sp. z o.o. holding 63% with institutions holding 23%; other aggregators describe the parent as 'Capital MBO' (spelled variously as a limited company or limited partnership in different filings). Given these inconsistencies, the exact controlling entity and percentage could not be reliably confirmed in this search and should be checked against Mangata's current WSE filings. [Bankier.pl shareholder page](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/MANGATA/akcjonariat), [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/capital-goods/wse-mgt/mangata-holding-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not clearly disclosed in sources found; the dominant ~63-70% holder is described variously as Avallon Sp. z o.o. or 'Capital MBO' entities (possibly a management-buyout vehicle given the 'MBO' naming), which may imply meaningful management/insider participation, but this could not be confirmed with a specific named individual or percentage.
thesis.red_flags: Source inconsistency itself is worth flagging for diligence: multiple financial data aggregators give materially different ownership structures and parent-entity names for Mangata's controlling shareholder, which should be resolved against the company's own current-report (raport bieżący) disclosures on the Warsaw Stock Exchange before relying on any single figure. No specific litigation, dilution or auditor red flags were identified.

thesis.business_description: AEP Plantations Plc (formerly Anglo-Eastern Plantations Plc, renamed November 2025) is a UK-listed, FTSE 250-constituent plantation company that owns, operates and develops oil palm plantations in Indonesia and Malaysia, also producing rubber slabs and biogas; it recently completed the acquisition of PT AEP Pinago Plantations, adding 14,300 hectares and bringing total planted area to 87,392 hectares.
thesis.competitive_position: AEP is a long-established (founded 1985), sizeable palm-oil plantation operator with a growing planted area (87,392 hectares after its latest acquisition) across Indonesia and Malaysia, generating significant free cash flow that it has returned to shareholders via $25.9m in dividends and buybacks in its latest interim period; it is not a forestry/teak business as sometimes assumed, but a palm oil and rubber producer. [AEP Interim Report 30 June 2026](https://www.directorstalkinterviews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Interim-Report-30-June-2026_Final.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Genton International Limited is described as a significant/parent-level shareholder (per a 2022 chairman's statement and a company profile listing it as parent). Other large institutional holders per a Fidelity factsheet include Value Square NV, Dimensional Fund Advisors LP, and Sorbus Partners LLP (exact percentages and date not confirmed). Total issued ordinary shares stood at 399,762,720 as of a July 2026 buyback notice, including 16,862,208 shares held in treasury. [Fidelity factsheet](https://www.fidelity.co.uk/factsheet-data/factsheet/GB0000365774-aep-plantations-plc/profile), [AEP buyback notice](https://kalkinemedia.com/uk/news/announcements/aep-plantations-executes-buyback-of-56179-shares-at-17584-pence-average-price-on-24-july-2026)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed with specific individual percentages in sources found; Genton International Limited's relationship to company insiders/founders was not clarified in available sources. Could not verify.
thesis.red_flags: At the 2024 AGM, a notable number of shareholders opposed a resolution granting directors the power to allot equity without pre-emption rights; the company subsequently said it would consult shareholders on a case-by-case basis for specific transactions. This is a disclosed governance friction point worth monitoring, though not evidence of actual dilution having occurred. [TipRanks - AEP responds to shareholder concerns](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/aep-responds-to-shareholder-concerns-over-equity-allotment-resolution)

thesis.business_description: Practic S.A. is a Bucharest-based commercial real estate company, one of the largest owners of commercial space in the city (approximately 50,000 square meters, mainly in the Drumul Taberei, Crângași and Militari districts), which it rents and sublets, including to food and non-food stores, bank branches, pharmacies and restaurants; this has been its main activity since 2002.
thesis.competitive_position: Practic is a concentrated, founder/family-controlled Bucharest commercial-property landlord rather than a diversified or publicly liquid real estate company; its shares trade on the Bucharest Stock Exchange's lower-liquidity AeRO market, and the company is reportedly in the process of delisting to become a closed joint-stock company, reducing its relevance as a liquid public equity. [Forbes Romania](https://www.forbes.ro/?p=55383)
thesis.main_shareholders: Businessman Radu Dimofte holds approximately 48.47% directly; Wellkept Group (which Dimofte indirectly controls) holds approximately 12.03%, giving him effective control of roughly 60%; IBTCYRO Holding Ltd of Cyprus previously held approximately 32.15% but transferred this entire stake (190,976 shares, 32.153% of capital) to Wellkept Properties Limited, registered by the central depository on 7 July 2026. Top 3 shareholders together hold approximately 92.66% of the company. [BVB current report - shareholder change](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/PRBU/PRBU_20260708150828_Current-Report-July-08-2026-shareholder-change.pdf), [Targetare.ro company profile](https://targetare.ro/2774512/practic-sa)
thesis.insider_ownership: Radu Dimofte is the controlling individual/insider, holding approximately 48.47% directly plus indirect control of Wellkept Group's ~12.03% stake (and now, following the July 2026 transfer, apparently also effective influence over the former IBTCYRO 32.15% stake via the Wellkept-affiliated acquirer) - representing a dominant founder/owner-operator control structure. [BVB current report](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/PRBU/PRBU_20260708150828_Current-Report-July-08-2026-shareholder-change.pdf)
thesis.red_flags: The company is reportedly in the process of voluntarily delisting from the Bucharest Stock Exchange's AeRO market to become a closed joint-stock company, with an extraordinary general meeting called to vote on withdrawal and a valuation report issued (dated 1 July 2026) for shareholders wishing to exit - a significant corporate action that minority public shareholders should be aware of, as it may force them out of a public market at a company-determined valuation. [Forbes Romania](https://www.forbes.ro/?p=55383), [BVB valuation notice](https://www.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/PRBU/PRBU_20260701100231_Current-report-informs-shareholders.pdf)

thesis.business_description: Talenom Oyj is a Finnish accounting and financial administration services company for small and medium-sized enterprises, founded in 1972 by Paavo and Anneli Tahkola, headquartered in Oulu, and operating in Finland, Sweden, Spain and Italy; it listed on Nasdaq Helsinki in June 2015.
thesis.competitive_position: Talenom is a technology-driven, scaled accounting-services provider for SMEs that has expanded internationally (Sweden, Spain, Italy) beyond its Finnish base, differentiating itself from smaller traditional accounting firms through digital/automated bookkeeping tools; specific market-share data was not found in this search.
thesis.main_shareholders: The founding Tahkola family remains the largest shareholder group: Harri Tahkola holds approximately 17.2% and Markus Tahkola holds approximately 10.6% per Simply Wall St snapshots (dated 2024-2025). Institutional holders include Danske Capital Denmark (~7.56%), Sp-Rahastoyhtiö Oy (~5.22%), with SEB Investment Management and Allianz each in the 3-5% range. Top 25 shareholders control approximately 78.95% of the company. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/commercial-services/bats-chixe-tnomh/talenom-oyj-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder-family members Harri Tahkola (~17.2%) and Markus Tahkola (~10.6%) together hold a substantial combined stake (~27.8%), reflecting continued strong founder-family influence since Paavo and Anneli Tahkola founded the company in 1972; note that different source pages show inconsistent 'individual insiders' aggregate figures (1.46% vs 18.7%), which cannot be reconciled with the named Tahkola stakes and should be treated with caution. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/commercial-services/bats-chixe-tnomh/talenom-oyj-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; note the internal inconsistency across Simply Wall St's own listing pages regarding aggregate insider ownership percentages, a data-quality caveat rather than a company-specific governance issue.

thesis.business_description: Orell Füssli AG is a Zurich-based Swiss company tracing its roots to 1519 as a book printer, today operating primarily in security printing (banknotes, value documents, identity documents, and government identification systems) alongside a Book Retailing segment that is a leading player in the Swiss book retail sector.
thesis.competitive_position: Orell Füssli holds a specialized, long-established position in security printing (banknotes and identity documents) for governments, a high-trust, high-barrier-to-entry niche, though its security printing revenue declined from CHF 87.3m to CHF 73.8m between 2020 and 2021; its shares have traded on the SIX Swiss Exchange since 1897, making it, by its own description, the oldest continuously publicly traded company in Switzerland. [EQS-News - Orell Füssli profitability release](https://eqs-news.com/news/adhoc/orell-fussli-ag-orell-fussli-ag-boosts-profitability-and-increases-dividend/1528895)
thesis.main_shareholders: Shareholder data conflicts sharply across sources/listings: the Swiss SIX-listed (SWX:OFN) Simply Wall St page shows a highly dispersed register with institutions at only ~8.05% and the general public at ~92%, led by J. Safra Sarasin Investmentfonds Ltd at ~4.73%; by contrast, Simply Wall St's London- and Frankfurt-listing pages show the Schweizerische Nationalbank (Swiss National Bank) at 33.3% and an individual, Dieter Meier, at 13.5% - a materially different ownership picture that could not be reconciled in this search and should be verified against Orell Füssli's own SIX-mandated major shareholder disclosures. [Simply Wall St (SWX:OFN) ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/ch/commercial-services/vtx-ofn/orell-fussli-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not reliably determined given the conflicting source data described above; if the Dieter Meier (~13.5%) figure from the London/Frankfurt-listing page is accurate it would represent a significant individual/insider stake, but this could not be cross-verified against the Swiss primary-listing data and should be treated as unconfirmed.
thesis.red_flags: The stark disconnect between shareholder registers reported for different listings of the same company (SWX vs. LSE vs. Frankfurt aggregator pages) is itself a data-reliability flag for due diligence purposes - investors should obtain Orell Füssli's own SIX-filed major-shareholder notifications rather than relying on secondary aggregators. No litigation, dilution or auditor concerns were identified from official sources. AGM shareholder votes (2022, 2023) approving board proposals and dividends were routine, with 75.63% of share capital represented in 2023.

thesis.business_description: Kofola ČeskoSlovensko a.s. is a Czech/Slovak beverage company producing and distributing soft drinks (including its Kofola cola brand), bottled water, and, following an acquisition, beer (it bought the Czech Republic's fifth-largest brewery group), listed on the Prague Stock Exchange.
thesis.competitive_position: Kofola holds a strong, differentiated position in the Czech and Slovak beverage market through its namesake cola brand (a historic local alternative to Coca-Cola/Pepsi dating to the communist era) and has diversified into brewing via acquisition, giving it a broadened beverage portfolio across Central Europe. [Inside.Beer - brewery acquisition](https://www.inside.beer/news/detail/czech-republic-soft-drink-maker-buys-the-countries-fifth-largest-brewery-group)
thesis.main_shareholders: Jannis Samaras, executive Group CEO, controls a majority stake via AETOS together with his family, reported at 67.22% per a December 2019 investor presentation; AETOS became majority owner of the Kofola Group in 2017, acquiring a ~68% stake from the company's then-second-largest shareholder, CED Group (which held 37.3%). A more recent, undated Simply Wall St snapshot lists KSM Investment S.A. as the largest named holder at approximately 75.5% (top 4 holders together ~75.5%); whether KSM Investment is the same vehicle as, or affiliated with, Samaras/AETOS could not be confirmed in this search. [Kofola investor presentation Dec 2019](https://investor.kofola.cz/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/ir-meeting-v-ceske-sporitelne-a-s-12-12-2019-en.pdf), [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/cz/food-beverage-tobacco/sep-kofol/kofola-ceskoslovensko-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Jannis Samaras is also the controlling shareholder, holding approximately 67.22% via AETOS together with his family as of the 2019 disclosure - a strong owner-operator/insider-control structure, though no source in this search explicitly described him as the company's founder. [Kofola investor presentation](https://investor.kofola.cz/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/ir-meeting-v-ceske-sporitelne-a-s-12-12-2019-en.pdf)
thesis.red_flags: A 2022 shareholder restructuring was announced (details not fully retrieved in this search - see ESM Magazine source) and a compulsory buyout of a 0.2% minority stake at 57 PLN/share was reported by a Polish financial outlet, both of which are minority-squeeze-out-type corporate actions worth reviewing directly given the concentrated ~67-75% controlling stake. [ESM Magazine - shareholder restructuring](https://www.esmmagazine.com/a-brands/kofola-ceskoslovensko-shareholders-44422), [Forsal.pl - compulsory buyout](https://forsal.pl/artykuly/906668,kofola-cs-oglosila-przymusowy-wykup-02-proc-akcji-spolki-kofola-po-57-zl-szt.html)

thesis.business_description: Petros Petropoulos AEBE is a Greece-based (Athens) industrial and commercial group, founded in 1922, engaged in the manufacture, modification, marketing, distribution, and support of vehicles, automotive machinery, industrial and agricultural equipment, batteries, and related components, organized into business units including Truck and Bus, Agricultural Equipment, Isuzu, Engines and Boats, Industrial Equipment, Petrogen, PMS, and Shell Lubricants, with subsidiaries in Cyprus and Bulgaria. [Petros Petropoulos company page](https://petropoulos.com/en/company/)
thesis.competitive_position: Petros Petropoulos is a century-old, diversified Greek industrial distribution and equipment group with multiple exclusive brand distributorships (e.g., Isuzu, Shell Lubricants) and regional reach into Cyprus and Bulgaria, giving it diversified revenue streams across automotive, agricultural, and industrial equipment segments. [Petros Petropoulos company overview](https://petropoulos.com/en/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: The largest disclosed shareholder is Ioannis Petropoulos (~30.81%, representing the founding Petropoulos family), followed by Anabak Trading & Investments Ltd. (~25.89%). name: Astarta Holding PLC

thesis.business_description: Astarta Holding PLC is a Cyprus-incorporated, Ukraine-focused diversified agribusiness group founded in March 1993, active in sugar production, crop farming, dairy and other agricultural operations, listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 2006.
thesis.competitive_position: Astarta is one of Ukraine's largest diversified agribusiness groups with a long operating history since 1993 under founder Viktor Ivanchyk, holding institutional backing from Fairfax Financial Holdings-linked entities, which has provided capital support through Ukraine's wartime economic disruption; specific market-share figures were not found. thesis.insider_ownership: Founder and CEO Viktor Ivanchyk has led the company since its 1993 founding and holds a substantial personal stake of approximately 41.9-43.22%, representing strong founder control. Shareholder data is also materially inconsistent across sources (Fairfax-linked stake reported anywhere from ~22% to ~30%, and a separate ~41% holder, Albacon Ventures, whose relationship to known holders is unconfirmed), warranting direct verification before relying on any ownership figure. thesis.business_description: Schwälbchen Molkerei Jakob Berz AG is a German dairy company founded in 1938 and based in Bad Schwalbach, Hesse, producing and selling fresh and long-life milk and dairy products (yoghurt, whipped cream, sour cream, quark) under the SCHWAELBCHEN brand, with production/distribution sites including Mainz, Ilsfeld and Korntal-Münchingen, plus a foodservice subsidiary, SCHWÄLBCHEN Frischdienst GmbH.
thesis.competitive_position: Schwälbchen is a long-standing German regional dairy brand (founded 1938) with a DIN ISO 9001-certified quality system, positioned as a regional brand supplier of fresh dairy products; the company has described itself as financially well-positioned through difficult periods (e.g., the COVID-19 crisis), suggesting a conservatively-run, family-managed niche regional player rather than a national-scale dairy major. [Lebensmittelzeitung](https://www.lebensmittelzeitung.net/industrie/nachrichten/corona-folgen-schwaelbchen-leidet-sehr-161276)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Berz family controls the company, with CEO Dr. Günter Berz-List (a family member, per the company name 'Jakob Berz AG' and management board listing) leading the business; however, no source found in this search gave a specific percentage for the family's or any other shareholder's stake. The company has conducted share buybacks (up to 70,000 shares, ~5% of share capital, held in treasury), which reduces free float but was not attributed to any specific shareholder's benefit. Could not verify specific ownership percentages for the Berz family or other holders.
thesis.insider_ownership: Dr. Günter Berz-List, a member of the founding Berz family, serves on the Management Board (CEO), indicating continued family management involvement, though his or the broader family's specific shareholding percentage was not found and could not be verified in this search.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; note that ownership percentage data for this company could not be found via general web search and would require checking German voting-rights notifications (Stimmrechtsmitteilungen), the Bundesanzeiger/Unternehmensregister, or the company's own annual reports directly - a disclosure-transparency gap worth noting for diligence purposes.

thesis.business_description: Sanok Rubber Company S.A. (formerly Stomil Sanok, renamed November 2015) is a Polish manufacturer of rubber, rubber-to-metal, and multi-material products for automotive (car body sealing systems, anti-vibration parts), construction, agriculture, pharmaceutical and household appliance markets, based in Sanok, Poland, with roots dating to 1932.
thesis.competitive_position: Sanok is an established Central European rubber-products manufacturer with international reach, having acquired full ownership of China's Qingdao Meteor Rubber & Plastics (2016, having previously held a 20% stake) and a majority (54%) stake in Polish façade-systems firm BSP Bracket System, reflecting a strategy of diversifying beyond core automotive rubber parts into adjacent materials and geographies. [European Rubber Journal](https://www.european-rubber-journal.com/2016/08/17/draft-polish-company-takes-qingdao-meteor-rubber-plastics)
thesis.main_shareholders: Ownership is dominated by Polish pension funds alongside a long-standing large individual holder, Marek Łęcki (also Chairman of the Supervisory Board): per Wikipedia, ING OFE ~11.53%, Łęcki ~11.04%, Aviva OFE Aviva BZ WBK ~10.83%, PZU Złota Jesień OFE ~9.30%, Aviva Investors Poland ~6.60%; a separate, differently-dated Simply Wall St snapshot (~January 2021) shows Nationale-Nederlanden OFE ~21.9%, PTE Allianz Polska ~16.6%, Łęcki ~11.9%, and a PZU pension fund ~10.8%. Figures vary by source and date (pension fund mergers/renamings, e.g. ING OFE to Nationale-Nederlanden OFE, account for some discrepancy), and free float is reported around 55% by Bankier.pl. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sanok_Rubber_Company), [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/automobiles/wse-snk/sanok-rubber-company-spolka-akcyjna-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Marek Łęcki, Chairman of the Supervisory Board, has held a consistent, substantial individual stake across multiple years and sources, reported at approximately 11.0-11.9% depending on date - a meaningful long-term insider holding, though he is described as a long-time executive/board figure rather than explicitly as the company's founder (the company's roots trace to 1932 under the Stomil Sanok name). [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sanok_Rubber_Company), [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/automobiles/wse-snk/sanok-rubber-company-spolka-akcyjna-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: ATC CARGO S.A. is a Polish logistics company (founded 2006, headquartered in Gdynia) providing sea, air, and land freight and forwarding services in Poland and internationally.
thesis.competitive_position: A mid-sized Polish freight forwarding and logistics provider; specific market-share or competitive-moat details were not found in sources reviewed beyond its multi-modal (sea/air/land) service offering. [ATC Cargo investor relations](https://atc-cargo.pl/en/dla-inwestora?973e7ac6_page=0)
thesis.main_shareholders: Fundacja Rodzinna Bąk w organizacji holds approximately 18.86% of shares (25.96% of votes); WBW INVEST Ignasiak, Szczegodziński S.K.A. holds approximately 18.85% of shares (25.96% of votes); Marcin Karczewski holds approximately 14.17% combined; investment funds managed by TFI PZU hold approximately 13% of bearer shares; Worldwide Supply Chain Holdings Pte. Ltd. holds approximately 11.76% of bearer shares. Shareholders Wiktor Bąk and Marcin Karczewski are bound by a voting agreement. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ATC-CARGO-S-A-20706043/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder/insider ownership is meaningful and consolidated through family and related-party vehicles: the Bąk family foundation and Marcin Karczewski (bound by a shareholder voting agreement) together with the Ignasiak/Szczegodziński-linked WBW INVEST entity control a substantial combined block, though a precise aggregate percentage attributable strictly to 'insiders' was not confirmed. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ATC-CARGO-S-A-20706043/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Quercus TFI S.A. is a Poland-based investment fund management company, founded in August 2007 by Sebastian Buczek, offering investment fund management, portfolio management, and investment advisory services, historically targeted at high-net-worth investors. [Quercus TFI company page](https://quercustfi.pl/en/strona/quercus-tfi-sa)
thesis.competitive_position: Quercus TFI is described as Poland's first independent mutual-fund company and a cash-rich compounder, with strong historical profitability metrics (reported P/E ~11.8, ROE ~39.8%, five-year revenue CAGR ~23%) and an active share buyback program; in November 2025 it merged with Templeton Asset Management (Poland) TFI, bringing Franklin Templeton in as a strategic shareholder and expanding its scale. [Substack: Quercus TFI - Poland's Cash-Rich Compounder](https://kubangpasucapital.substack.com/p/quercus-tfi-sa-wse-qrs-polands-cash)
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder and CEO Sebastian Buczek (with related parties) holds approximately 18.8% as of April 2026; Jakub Głowacki (with related parties) holds about 16.0%; Franklin Templeton holds roughly 7.1%-7.8% following the November 2025 merger with Templeton Asset Management (Poland) TFI; OFE NN (a Polish pension fund) holds about 7.4%. [MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/QUERCUS-TFI-S-A-11194062/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder/CEO Sebastian Buczek remains the single largest shareholder (~18.8%), alongside co-founder-era investor Jakub Głowacki (~16.0%), together representing roughly 35% of the company held by original insiders. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/QUERCUS-TFI-S-A-11194062/company/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources searched; the 2025 merger with Templeton Asset Management (Poland) TFI was a disclosed, negotiated transaction (including a note that Franklin Templeton would not participate in a potential 2026 share buyback, which could incrementally increase its relative stake) rather than a governance dispute. [Analizy.pl: Quercus TFI merger with Templeton AM Poland](https://www.analizy.pl/puls-rynku/38696/quercus-tfi-laczy-sie-z-templeton-am-poland)

thesis.business_description: B&C Speakers S.p.A. is an Italy-based (Bagno a Ripoli) manufacturer specializing in the design, production, and marketing of professional loudspeaker components (transducers) under the B&C brand, founded in 1945/1946 by Fernando Borrani and Roberto Coppini. [B&C Speakers history](https://www.bcspeakers.com/en/about-bc/history)
thesis.competitive_position: B&C Speakers is described as one of the largest and most prestigious professional loudspeaker transducer manufacturers in the world, with a long operating history (since the 1940s) and sufficient brand strength to pursue trade-dress infringement litigation against competitors (e.g., PRV Audio Group) to defend its product designs. [B&C Speakers v. PRV Audio Group litigation](https://www.courtlistener.com/opinion/10854523/bc-speakers-spa-and-bc-speakers-na-llc-v-prv-audio-group-inc/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Research & Development International S.r.l. is the controlling shareholder, holding approximately 52.73% of B&C Speakers S.p.A. [MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/B-C-SPEAKERS-S-P-A-286463/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling ownership runs through the holding company Research & Development International S.r.l. (~52.73%); current CEO Lorenzo Coppini appears to be linked to co-founder Roberto Coppini's family lineage, suggesting continued founder-family involvement in management, though a distinct personal shareholding percentage for him was not separately confirmed. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/B-C-SPEAKERS-S-P-A-286463/company/)
thesis.red_flags: B&C Speakers has been engaged as plaintiff in trade-dress infringement litigation against PRV Audio Group, Inc. over alleged copying of its speaker basket design; this is offensive litigation to protect its IP rather than a governance red flag against the company itself, but it indicates active legal/IP disputes in its competitive environment. [B&C Speakers v. PRV Audio Group court opinion](https://www.courtlistener.com/opinion/10854523/bc-speakers-spa-and-bc-speakers-na-llc-v-prv-audio-group-inc/)

thesis.business_description: Mühlbauer Holding AG is a German technology company, headquartered in Roding, developing smart card, e-passport/ID document, RFID and solar back-end manufacturing and production equipment, operating through Precision Parts, Production Equipment and Government Solutions segments.
thesis.competitive_position: Mühlbauer holds a specialized global niche in high-security ID document and smart-card production equipment (a technically demanding, relationship-driven government/enterprise market), with strong family-led continuity since 1981; its narrow end-market focus provides differentiation but also concentrates revenue exposure to government ID/passport procurement cycles.
thesis.main_shareholders: Josef Mühlbauer (founder) ~82.5%, GS&P Kapitalanlagegesellschaft SA ~3.43%, MFC Asset Management Public Co., Ltd. ~0.03% ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/MUHLBAUER-HOLDING-AG-436421/company/))
thesis.insider_ownership: ~82.5% held by founder Josef Mühlbauer, with family members (Isabel Mühlbauer, Josef Markus Mühlbauer, Stefan Mühlbauer) holding senior supervisory board and CEO roles
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; extremely high founder/family concentration (~82.5%) means a very small free float and limited minority-shareholder influence over governance.

thesis.business_description: Boreo Oyj is a Finnish serial-acquirer holding company that owns and develops small/medium-sized businesses across three segments — Electronics (components distribution, e.g. Yleiselektroniikka, Noretron), Technical Trade (industrial products/services, e.g. Machinery, Muottikolmio) and Heavy Machines — operating in Finland, Sweden, the Baltics and internationally.
thesis.competitive_position: Boreo operates a buy-and-build model similar to other Nordic serial acquirers, consolidating niche electronics-distribution and technical-trade businesses under owned brands (Yleiselektroniikka, YE International, Noretron Komponentit, Milcon, Delfin Technologies, Machinery, Pronius, and others); its competitive advantage derives from disciplined capital allocation/M&A and decentralized operating units rather than a single product moat. [Acquirers.com - Boreo: a Finnish serial acquirer](https://www.acquirers.com/post/boreo-a-finnish-serial-acquirer); [stockanalysis.com - Boreo company profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/hel/BOREO/company/).
thesis.main_shareholders: Preato Capital AB, controlled by Chairman Simon Hallqvist, is the dominant shareholder with approximately 70-71% of shares (reported variously as 70.02%-70.9% in different filings); AK Capital Oy holds approximately 1.31%. [MarketScreener - Boreo Oyj PDMR transactions, Preato Capital AB](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/BOREO-OYJ-1412572/news/Boreo-Oyj-Plc-Managers-transactions-Preato-Capital-AB-47265568/); [Inderes - Boreo Ownership](https://www.inderes.fi/en/companies/Boreo/ownership).
thesis.insider_ownership: Chairman Simon Hallqvist controls the company via his majority-owned investment vehicle Preato Capital AB (~70% of Boreo), making him the controlling insider; several operating executives and employees (including Ari Wilhelm Sulin ~1.01%, Mikko Petteri Moilanen ~0.95%, Aku Rumpunen ~0.89%) also hold smaller stakes, with over 8% of shares reportedly held by employees via equity issued as acquisition consideration. [Inderes - Boreo Ownership](https://www.inderes.fi/en/companies/Boreo/ownership).
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources regarding litigation or auditor disputes. The company previously had Russian operations that it divested, which is a disclosed geopolitical-exposure item rather than a governance red flag; the very high single-shareholder concentration (~70% via Preato Capital) also means minority shareholders have limited influence over strategy. [Castren & Snellman - Boreo divestment of Russian operations](https://www.castren.fi/cases/boreo-divestment-of-russian-operations/).

thesis.business_description: Eurofins-Cerep SA is a France-based (Poitiers-founded, 1989) contract research company specializing in in vitro drug profiling, pharmacological screening and pre-clinical drug research services for the pharmaceutical industry, now operating as part of Eurofins Pharma Discovery Services.
thesis.competitive_position: A niche pre-clinical CRO (contract research organization) that has been majority- and now near-fully-owned by global testing/laboratory group Eurofins Scientific since 2013, operating as part of Eurofins' broader Pharma Discovery Services division rather than as an independent competitive entity. [Eurofins press release](https://www.eurofins.com/media-centre/press-releases-archive/2012-12-21/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Parent Eurofins Scientific SE holds approximately 95.78% of Eurofins-Cerep SA as of December 31, 2024, following a series of acquisitions beginning in December 2012 (75.13% stake acquired for EUR 18.9 million) and a subsequent tender offer. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/equities/cerep-ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider ownership is effectively the parent company Eurofins Scientific SE (~95.78%); minimal free float remains, meaning minority shareholders have very limited influence and the stock trades with low liquidity typical of a company nearing full absorption by its parent. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/equities/cerep-ownership)
thesis.red_flags: Extremely low free float (~4.2% non-Eurofins-Scientific ownership) presents liquidity and potential future squeeze-out/delisting risk for minority holders, though no specific litigation or fraud was identified in sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: S.C. Ropharma S.A. operates a chain of pharmacies and pharmaceutical wholesale/distribution business in Romania, headquartered in Brașov, with pharmacies across multiple Romanian counties (including Iași, Suceava, Bacău, Sibiu, and Brașov). [Ropharma company profile - EMIS](https://www.emis.com/php/company-profile/RO/Ropharma_SA_en_1482328.html)
thesis.competitive_position: Ropharma is one of Romania's established pharmacy-chain and pharmaceutical distribution operators, founded by entrepreneur Mihai Miron (who previously built and sold Europharm to GlaxoSmithKline); it is a mid-sized regional player expanding into rural pharmacy coverage rather than a dominant national leader. [ZF.ro interview with Mihai Miron](https://www.zf.ro/te-inspira/brasov/brasov-inspira-mihai-gabriel-miron-ropharma-ne-dorim-ne-extindem-22460787)
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder and chairman/CEO Mihai Miron is the controlling shareholder, holding approximately 20.5% directly, with related entities ADD Pharmaceuticals Limited (~17.8%) and Rimia Investments also controlled by Miron; Goa Capital SA holds about 3.91%. Ownership breakdown: private companies ~21.7%, individual insiders ~23.7%, general public ~54.6%. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/ro/consumer-retailing/bvb-rph/sc-ropharma-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder Mihai Miron and entities he controls (ADD Pharmaceuticals Limited, Rimia Investments) together constitute the dominant insider ownership bloc, with Miron personally holding around 20.5% and serving as President/General Director. [BusinessPedia profile of Mihai Miron](https://businesspedia.ro/wiki/mihai-miron-presedintele-consiliului-de-administratie-si-director-general-ropharma-sa/)
thesis.red_flags: Romanian press reported that employees of a Mihai Miron-owned company (in a separate business context, not confirmed to be Ropharma itself) were investigated by prosecutors over alleged money laundering through a monastery's bank account; Miron denied wrongdoing and suggested the investigation followed his public criticism of the Health Minister. This is a reputational matter involving the controlling shareholder that investors should be aware of, though it was not confirmed to directly implicate Ropharma's own operations. [Adevărul investigation report](https://adevarul.ro/stiri-interne/evenimente/angajatii-companiei-miliardarului-mihai-miron-1424819.html)

thesis.business_description: Growens S.p.A. (formerly MailUp S.p.A.) is an Italian holding company operating in cloud marketing technology, historically known for its MailUp email-marketing and mobile-messaging (SMS) platforms; following 2022-2023 divestitures (MailUp sold to TeamSystem for ~€76.7M; Contactlab, Acumbamail and Datatrics also sold), the group is repositioning around its remaining marketing-technology assets and investments.
thesis.competitive_position: Growens' historical core, MailUp, was a mid-sized multichannel email/SMS marketing platform aimed at small-and-medium businesses in Italy, Europe, the Americas and Asia, competing against larger international ESPs; the 2023 sale of MailUp and other units to TeamSystem for €76.7 million marks a strategic retrenchment into a smaller, more focused portfolio, meaning its current competitive scale and moat are considerably reduced versus its former MailUp-era positioning. [Tech.eu - TeamSystem acquires Growens' MailUp](https://tech.eu/2023/02/03/cloud-marketing-outfit-growens-snaps-up-e-mail/); [MarketScreener - MailUp/TeamSystem sale](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/GROWENS-S-P-A-17039534/news/Finalized-sale-of-MailUp-business-unit-from-Growens-to-TeamSystem-44332888/).
thesis.main_shareholders: Per the company's own shareholder disclosure page, the main holders are: Nazzareno Gorni (via Poliedriq S.r.l.) ~11.76%, Matteo Monfredini (via MM S.r.l.) ~11.62%, Matteo Bettoni (via Linea S.r.l.) ~11.04%, Alberto Miscia (via AM0 S.r.l.) ~10.43%, Luca Azzali (via Yugen S.r.l.) ~10.05%, treasury shares ~9.28%, and free float ~35.82%. [Growens - Shareholders (official)](https://www.growens.io/en/shareholders/).
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder-managers hold a majority bloc: CEO Nazzareno Gorni and CFO Matteo Monfredini, together with co-founders Matteo Bettoni, Alberto Miscia and Luca Azzali, collectively control roughly 55% of shares through personal holding vehicles, indicating high founder/management alignment. [Growens - Shareholders (official)](https://www.growens.io/en/shareholders/).
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources regarding litigation, auditor disputes, or related-party transactions. The major divestiture of the MailUp/Contactlab/Acumbamail/Datatrics businesses in 2022-2023 represents a significant strategic discontinuity that materially shrank the group and should be understood as a business-model risk factor, though it was presented as a planned strategic sale rather than a distress event. [Tech.eu - Growens MailUp sale](https://tech.eu/2023/02/03/cloud-marketing-outfit-growens-snaps-up-e-mail/).

thesis.business_description: Helio S.A. is a Polish company, founded in 1992 and based in Zaborów, that produces and markets dried fruits, nuts, candied fruit, cake masses/icings, and microwave popcorn under the HELIO brand, sold to retail chains and wholesalers. [Helio company profile - Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/HEL.WA/profile/)
thesis.competitive_position: Helio is described as a leader in Poland's dried fruits and nuts industry, built as a 100%-Polish-owned family business; it has achieved strong recent earnings growth, though it remains a relatively small-cap niche food producer. [Bridges Magazine: why HELIO is Poland's Dried Fruits & Nuts Industry Leader](https://sms-bridges.com/in-a-nutshell-heres-why-helio-is-polands-dried-fruits-nuts-industry-leader/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Founders Leszek and Justyna Wąsowicz are the controlling shareholders; Leszek Wąsowicz has been reported holding a majority stake historically disclosed at 77.1% of share capital and votes, with company insiders collectively holding roughly 92% of shares per aggregator data. [Helio investor relations - shareholding change notice](https://www.helio.pl/en/investor-relations/public-offering-of-shares/history-of-shares-transactions/change-in-a-shareholders-share-in-the-total-vote-by-the-shareholder-who-held-over-33percent-of-the-total-vote), [Helio company profile - stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/HEL/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider ownership is very high and founder-controlled: Leszek and Justyna Wąsowicz founded, manage, and are the strategic owners of the company, with Leszek individually disclosed as holding around 77.1% of shares/votes at one point and insiders collectively holding roughly 92%. [Helio investor relations](https://www.helio.pl/en/investor-relations/public-offering-of-shares/history-of-shares-transactions/change-in-a-shareholders-share-in-the-total-vote-by-the-shareholder-who-held-over-33percent-of-the-total-vote)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources searched; note the earlier web search mistakenly suggested an 'Agora S.A.' subsidiary relationship, but this could not be corroborated and appears to be an aggregator data error -- Helio is reported elsewhere as a founder/family-controlled independent company.

thesis.business_description: LIMES Schlosskliniken AG is a German holding company (formerly GMF Capital AG) headquartered in Cologne that owns and manages six private clinics across Germany, Switzerland, Italy, and Liechtenstein specializing in psychiatry, psychotherapy, and psychosomatic medicine, with roughly 400 treatment places. [LIMES Schlosskliniken Annual Report 2024](https://www.limes-schlosskliniken.de/app/uploads/2025/05/Annual-Report-2024-LIMES-Schlosskliniken-1.pdf)
thesis.competitive_position: LIMES operates as a consolidator/operator of high-end private psychiatric and psychosomatic clinics ('Deluxe Mental Healthcare'), a specialized niche within German private healthcare; it has continued to expand via acquisitions such as a majority stake in Clinicum Alpinum. [Investec: LIMES Schlosskliniken Group takes over majority shareholding in Clinicum Alpinum](https://www.investec.com/advisory/deals/limes-schlosskliniken-group-takes-over-majority-shareholding-in-private-clinic-clinicum-alpinum/), [Deluxe Mental Healthcare overview](https://hrmt.substack.com/p/limes-schloss-clinics-lik)
thesis.main_shareholders: GMF Capital GmbH is the controlling shareholder, holding approximately 75.6%-76.9% of LIMES Schlosskliniken AG (reported slightly differently across sources/dates); other holders include Chelverton Asset Management Ltd. (~3.14%) and Lupus alpha Asset Management AG (~2.08%). [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/LIMES-SCHLOSSKLINIKEN-AG-56049225/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling insider ownership runs through GMF Capital GmbH (~75-77%); a director's dealing disclosure shows GMF Capital GmbH sold a block of shares worth approximately €4.8 million outside the trading platform, which reduces but does not eliminate its controlling position. [EQS director dealing notice](https://www.eqs-news.com/news/directors-dealings/limes-schlosskliniken-ag-gmf-capital-gmbh-sell/3a08b096-7810-4b44-ab7d-9001292a5d00_en)
thesis.red_flags: A disclosed insider/controlling-shareholder sale by GMF Capital GmbH (~€4.8 million off-market) is worth noting as a reduction in founder/controlling-holder commitment, though it was a disclosed, routine directors'-dealings transaction rather than a scandal. No lawsuit, auditor issue, or delisting was identified. [EQS director dealing notice](https://www.eqs-news.com/news/directors-dealings/limes-schlosskliniken-ag-gmf-capital-gmbh-sell/3a08b096-7810-4b44-ab7d-9001292a5d00_en)

thesis.business_description: Artmarket.com, through its Artprice division, is a France-based global leader in accumulating, managing, and exploiting historical and current art-market price information and data for the art market, founded in 1997 by Thierry Ehrmann. [Artmarket.com / Artprice overview](https://www.actusnews.com/en/amp/artmarket/pr/2026/08/17/the-ehrmann-family-increases-its-equity-stake-in-artprice-by-artmarket-as-part-of-its-ai-first-transformation)
thesis.competitive_position: Artprice positions itself as the world leader in art-market price databases and analytics, now pivoting toward AI-driven tools (branded 'Intuitive Artmarket' and 'Blind Spot') to extend this data leadership; the company is controlled and founder-led by Thierry Ehrmann, who has run it continuously since founding. [Artmarket.com H1 2026 financial report](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/09/29/tmt-newswire/pr-newswire/artmarketcom-h1-2026-financial-report-one-of-a-kind-ai-systems-intuitive-artmarket-and-blind-spot-will-drive-the-next-phase-of-growth-for-ai-first-artprice-in-2026-2030/2434489)
thesis.main_shareholders: Groupe Serveur, the founder's holding vehicle, is the largest shareholder, holding approximately 30.16% of share capital and about 45.78% of voting rights (excluding additional Ehrmann family holdings); the Ehrmann family has recently been increasing its equity stake further as part of a company strategic pivot. [Ehrmann family increases stake in Artmarket.com](https://www.toobit.com/en-US/news/ehrmann-family-increases-stake-in-artmarketcom)
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider ownership is high and founder-controlled: founder/CEO Thierry Ehrmann and his family (via Groupe Serveur, ~30.16% of capital/~45.78% of votes) are the controlling shareholders, and the family had not sold any shares since 2015 (a 10-year holding period) before recently adding to their stake; board member Nadège Ehrmann (family) has also recently acquired additional shares. [Ehrmann family stake increase disclosure](https://www.actusnews.com/en/amp/artmarket/pr/2026/08/17/the-ehrmann-family-increases-its-equity-stake-in-artprice-by-artmarket-as-part-of-its-ai-first-transformation)
thesis.red_flags: Some older commentary has criticized Artprice/Artmarket's use of aggressive or 'decoy website' marketing practices; no lawsuit, auditor dispute, or dilution issue was identified in the sources searched. Separately, founder Thierry Ehrmann is independently known for his controversial art installation 'Abode of Chaos,' which is a personal/reputational matter distinct from the company's financial governance. Could not independently verify further financial-reporting criticism beyond this general commentary.

thesis.business_description: Soditech SA is a France-based (Cannes-la-Bocca) SME specializing in electronic and mechanical engineering, integrating mechanical, thermal, and electronic subsystems for the Space, Research, and Defence sectors, founded in 1990. [Simply Wall St company information](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fr/commercial-services/epa-alsec/soditech-shares/information)
thesis.competitive_position: Soditech is a small, specialized engineering-services provider serving niche high-reliability sectors (space, research, defense), where technical qualification and long-term customer relationships typically create switching-cost barriers; no independent market-share data was found to size its competitive position precisely.
thesis.main_shareholders: The Caille family holds approximately 54.46% of Soditech's share capital; a BFM Bourse disclosure separately noted that Madenn Caillé's holding rose above 25% of capital at one point. [BFM Bourse: Soditech shareholding disclosures](https://www.tradingsat.com/soditech-ing-FR0000078321/actualites/soditech-ing-m-caille-au-dessus-des-25-du-capital-404857.html)
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider/founder-family ownership is high: founder Maurice Caille's family, now led by Madenn Caillé (Chairman & CEO), collectively holds approximately 54.46% of the company. [BFM Bourse shareholder data](https://www.tradingsat.com/soditech-ing-FR0000078321/actionnariat.html)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources searched.

name: Centrale d'Achat Française pour l'Outre-Mer Société Anonyme

thesis.business_description: Centrale d'Achat Française pour l'Outre-Mer (CAFOM) is a French distribution group specializing in home furnishings and household goods, operating retail stores in France's overseas territories (West Indies, French Guiana, Réunion, New Caledonia) under the But, Darty, Habitat, Nature & Découvertes and Music & Sound brand licenses/franchises, plus e-commerce sites vente-unique.com and directlowcost.com.
thesis.competitive_position: CAFOM holds a strong regional niche as a leading household-goods and furniture retailer in France's overseas departments/territories (DOM-TOM), a geographically isolated market with limited large-scale competition, operating roughly 23 physical stores alongside online retail arms; its moat rests more on logistics/franchise relationships and incumbency in these insular markets than on brand ownership, since several of its retail banners (But, Darty, Habitat, Nature & Découvertes) are licensed rather than proprietary. [Wikipedia - CAFOM](https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/CAFOM); [Yahoo Finance - CAFOM company profile](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/CAFO.PA/profile/).
thesis.main_shareholders: Per shareholder-structure data, the main holders are Financière HG (~24.80%), SAS Pleiade Investissement (~15.20%), free float (~10.70%), Evelyne Sztark-Wormser (~10.30%), Denis Wormser (~10.30%), SC Gavalak (~10.00%), Global Investissement/SC SPB (~7.20%), and treasury shares (~2.10%). [Tradingsat/BFM Bourse - CAFOM shareholding structure](https://www.tradingsat.com/cafom-FR0010151589/actionnariat.html).
thesis.insider_ownership: Members of the Wormser family are both significant shareholders and board members: Evelyne Sztark-Wormser (~10.30% stake) has served as a Board Director since 2017, and Denis Wormser holds a comparable ~10.30% stake, indicating meaningful family/insider board representation alongside the holding entities Financière HG and SAS Pleiade Investissement. [Tradingsat - CAFOM shareholding structure](https://www.tradingsat.com/cafom-FR0010151589/actionnariat.html).
thesis.red_flags: CAFOM's own annual financial reports disclose ongoing commercial litigation for which management has recorded related provisions; however, no specific detail on the nature, scale, or outcome of these disputes was found in available search results, and no auditor dispute or fraud allegation was identified. This should be treated as an item to verify directly in the latest annual report rather than a confirmed major red flag. [CAFOM - Annual Financial Report (official PDF)](https://cafom.com/ashymuzu/2020/12/20170202_cafom_rfa.pdf).

thesis.business_description: Pandora Investments Public Limited is a Cyprus-based company, part of the Leptos Group of Companies, primarily engaged in property development and trading, and in investing in securities of listed companies, with subsidiaries active in land investment, real estate development, and tourism. [Pandora Investments company profile](https://www.dnb.com/business-directory/company-profiles.pandora_investments_public_limited.77fe7da635e720b019cbce04d7dd8bdd.html)
thesis.competitive_position: Pandora Investments operates as a listed property/investment arm of the larger, privately-held Leptos Group, one of Cyprus's major real-estate and tourism developers; its competitive position largely derives from the broader Leptos Group's scale in Cyprus property development rather than independent market leadership. [Leptos Estates - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leptos_Estates)
thesis.main_shareholders: As of 2023 data, major shareholders were Pantelis Leptos (Board Member, ~37.50%) and Giorgos Leptos (Chairman, ~37.49%), with the remaining ~24.05% held by the general public. [CBN: major shareholders of 35 listed companies in Cyprus](https://www.cbn.com.cy/article/113087/the-major-shareholders-of-35-listed-companies-in-cyprus)
thesis.insider_ownership: Ownership is very highly concentrated in the founding Leptos family: Giorgos and Pantelis Leptos together hold roughly 75% of the company, with Michalakis G. Leptos chairing the broader board. [CBN major shareholders listing](https://www.cbn.com.cy/article/113087/the-major-shareholders-of-35-listed-companies-in-cyprus)
thesis.red_flags: The broader Leptos Group (Pandora's parent group) has faced significant reputational scrutiny: a 2020 Al Jazeera undercover investigation implicated Leptos Estates in Cyprus's 'golden passport' (citizenship-by-investment) scheme facilitation, and separate reporting has raised concerns about layered Cypriot entity ownership potentially used by politically exposed persons (including Russian buyers) in real estate tied to the golden-visa program; Leptos Estates also withdrew a libel suit against property-news outlets in 2010 after allegations of buyer mistreatment. These are serious, named reputational/regulatory red flags associated with the controlling family and group. [AML Network: Leptos Estates](https://amlnetwork.org/watchdog-database/real-estate-laundering/leptos-estates/)
